During my recent business trip to Manesar, I stayed at the only hotel available in Sector 8 nearby location, as there were no other options nearby. My overall experience at this hotel was just average, and there were several aspects that left me wanting more. Firstly, the D' Meridien hotel's location on a main road seemed convenient, but it became a challenge due to Google Maps directing me through a crowded market via side streets. Navigating through the crowded streets was not only time-consuming but also frustrating, as only a single vehicle could pass through at a time. The hotel management should consider providing clear directions to avoid such inconveniences for guests. Upon arriving at the hotel, I found the front desk assistant to be a bit harsh in their communication. A warm and welcoming approach from the staff can make a significant difference in a guest's perception of the hotel. The food served at the hotel's restaurant was average in taste and lacked variety. It would be beneficial for the hotel to elevate the quality of their menu and offer a more diverse selection of dishes to cater to different preferences. One major issue I encountered was the limited parking space for four-wheelers. Furthermore, I was taken aback to discover that the hotel gates closed at 10:00 ~ 11:00 PM, and after that, there was no one available to open the gate for late-arriving guests. This lack of 24-hour accessibility can be problematic, especially for guests arriving late in the night. Lastly, Even though this Hotel ties with several corporate houses but they need to improving their standards, amenities, and services, they can position themselves as a preferred choice for corporate guests visiting the area. In conclusion, my stay at the hotel in Manesar Sector 8 was average, with several areas that require improvement. I hope the hotel management takes these feedback points into consideration to enhance the overall guest experience. With some improvements, the hotel has the potential to become a more attractive and guest-friendly accommodation option for future travelers.

A Royal Escape: My Stay at Heritage Village Resort & Spa, Manesar ​If you’re looking to swap the Delhi-NCR traffic for some Rajasthani grandeur without the long drive, this spot is a gem. I recently spent some time here, and it was a thoroughly pleasant stay from start to finish. ​The Vibe ​The resort is designed like a traditional haveli, and the sprawling greenery immediately makes you forget you're just off the NH8. The architecture is stunning—think ornate arches, cobblestone paths, and expansive lawns that are perfect for a morning stroll. ​The Highlights ​The Food: This was a major winner. The buffet spreads offered excellent variety, ranging from authentic local flavors to well-executed international dishes. Whether it was the breakfast spread or the dinner service, the quality remained consistently high. ​Ambiance: It strikes a great balance between "family-friendly" and "peaceful retreat." ​Service: The staff was attentive and warm, adding to the overall "heritage" hospitality experience. Final Verdict: Whether you're lounging by the pool or enjoying a massive dinner spread, it’s a fantastic place to hit the reset button. Highly recommended for anyone needing a quick but luxurious "staycation."

If you're looking for alternatives in the same price range, I'd highly recommend Holiday Inn Sector 90 and Hyatt Regency Sector 83 for an unforgettable dining experience. Hope Ramada takes this feedback constructively and works on improving their offerings. Unfortunately, my experience was a letdown, which is why I'm sharing this review.

review_text: Terrible experience — would not recommend. Stayed here for 5 days and faced nonstop issues. The laundry staff lost one of my clothes, which I reported on day 2. The front desk staff and managers did absolutely nothing meaningful to resolve the issue. No follow-ups, no urgency, no responsibility. By the time I checked out, the item was still missing, and to make matters worse, they flatly refused to compensate me, claiming it “wasn’t their fault.” Losing a guest’s belongings and then washing your hands of it is unacceptable. Room service was consistently poor — food arrived cold or barely warm, especially bad during winter. Transport coordination was equally bad. Hotel transport was often unavailable or late, causing delays for me and my colleagues. We ended up managing transport ourselves for first few days. Overall, extremely unprofessional with zero accountability. Avoid this hotel.

I stayed here for nearly two weeks and had a genuinely wonderful experience. Since this is a brand-new hotel, I was a little apprehensive at the time of booking and wasn’t quite sure what to expect. Those concerns disappeared very quickly — from the moment I arrived, everything felt smooth, welcoming, and thoughtfully done. The room was serviced daily and always kept fresh and clean, and the overall experience was completely seamless. While the property itself is excellent, what truly made the stay was the staff. You can really feel the effort of everyone working quietly behind the scenes — from housekeeping to food services, from laundry to the many other support teams — all working together to make guests comfortable. It’s that collective effort that truly defines a stay, and I genuinely felt at home here. I also really appreciated that an air purifier was provided in the room at my request. I’ve stayed at several other hotels across Delhi, and it’s not something I’ve really seen being offered on request. I think this is a thoughtful and progressive initiative, and I genuinely hope more hotels take note and do the same. There are many people who deserve thanks, but a special mention to Aman, who was particularly helpful and made the stay even more pleasant. Overall, an excellent experience at Lemon Tree Suites. I would happily return whenever needed and highly recommend it, especially for longer stays.

A special mention to Aman and Zain, who went above and beyond to ensure we were comfortable and well taken care of, along with all the accompanying staff who were consistently warm and supportive. The head chef also deserves special appreciation for being so considerate—personally offering to prepare any food or drinks that might help us recover. That level of thoughtfulness truly sets this hotel apart. Thank you to the entire Lemon Tree Suites team for turning a stressful situation into such a positive experience. We would not hesitate to stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Gurugram. P.S. would recommend their masala porridge and the special sweetcorn soup the Chef kindly made for us

This was our second visit to Karma Lakelands within three months, and that itself says a lot. The first time didn’t feel like enough, and we already know we’ll keep coming back. Just 20–30 minutes from Gurgaon, yet it feels miles away from the city chaos… With a no-honking zone, abundant greenery, minimal construction, and open spaces, the air feels noticeably fresher… even during NCR winters. It’s incredibly peaceful and quiet inside. The property is vast and thoughtfully designed, with golf greens, walking tracks, a serene lake with boating, and experiential tours that help you explore different villas and spaces within Karma. A special mention to Mr. Nikesh, our buggy driver, who was extremely warm and helpful and even went out of his way to arrange a boat ride for us… The staff overall is welcoming and pleasant. We also loved Under the Neem, a beautiful café with unique dishes that’s popular even with visitors from outside… The Karma Club area, children’s play zones, and walking tracks make the experience feel wholesome and enriching. Highly recommend Karma Lakelands if you’re looking for a peaceful, refreshing escape close to Gurgaon.

There’s a certain kind of place that doesn’t try too hard to impress but ends up doing just that. You walk in expecting a typical stay, but there’s something about the way the staff greets you—not overly formal, not indifferent—just the right balance of warmth and efficiency. It’s the kind of place where things work the way they should, where you don’t have to ask twice for something, and where comfort is not an afterthought but a quiet assurance. The rooms have a certain simplicity to them, no unnecessary extravagance, but everything is where it needs to be. A bed that makes you feel at home, a space that doesn’t feel too cramped, and a window that lets in just enough of the city to remind you that you’re still connected to the world outside. It’s not about grand views or luxury, but about the subtle details that make a space feel like it was prepared with care. There’s always a moment in a stay when you realize whether a place understands its guests or not. Maybe it’s when you ask for something and it arrives before you’ve had a chance to check your phone again, or when the people at the desk remember your face, not as a duty but as a natural part of their work. It’s in these small things that a place sets itself apart. Not everything is perfect, of course. There are things one could nitpick—maybe a meal that took a little longer than expected, or a corner that could use a bit more attention. But does it matter when the overall experience leaves you feeling like you made the right choice? Some places offer more than what’s written in their descriptions. They offer a sense of ease, a feeling that you weren’t just passing through, but that for a brief time, you belonged. If you understand what I mean, then you know exactly the kind of place I’m talking about.

I recently hosted a family function at Clay Inn, Sector 49, and while the event was successful overall, there are a few things future hosts should keep in mind. The Highlights: Space and Setup Ideal for Mid-Sized Parties: We hosted around 200 guests, and the hall felt comfortable and well-organized. It’s a great fit for that guest count without feeling crowded. Prime Corner Plot: Being located on a corner plot gives the venue a more open and premium feel. The layout is practical for hosting and flow. Ample Parking: One of the biggest wins here is the parking space. Unlike many other venues in Gurgaon, they have a good dedicated area for vehicles, which made it very easy for our guests to arrive and park without stress. Nice Facilities: The overall ambiance and the maintenance of the banquet hall were impressive. It’s a solid choice for family gatherings and celebrations. The Challenges: Service and Accessibility Slow Service & Understaffed: The main area where they need to improve is their service speed. We found the staff to be a bit thin on the ground, and service was slow at times. I often had to "chase" the staff to get basic tasks done or to ensure things were moving on schedule. Walking Distance: The venue is located within a residential colony (Uppal Southend). If your guests are coming by public transport and plan to walk from the main road, be aware that it’s about a 500–700 meter walk. This can be a bit difficult for elderly guests or those dressed in heavy formal wear. Final Verdict Rating: 3.5/5 Clay Inn is a fantastic venue in terms of infrastructure and parking, making it a stress-free choice for the "hosting" side of things. However, you will need to be a very proactive host and keep a close eye on the service team to ensure your guests are attended to on time.

Review for Posh Suites, Gurgaon – Extremely Disappointing Stay I recently stayed at Posh Suites in Gurgaon for 5 days, and my experience was far from pleasant. The property is nowhere close to what is shown in the photos on booking platforms. Those pictures are either very old or taken right after construction or renovation. The current condition of the property is extremely poor and does not justify the name “Posh” in any sense. Room Condition: The walls are stained and clearly need repainting or restructuring. The furniture is damaged, poorly maintained, and in dire need of repair. The chairs and bed were not clean, and I even found hair follicles on the bedsheet, which was unacceptable. Hygiene was severely lacking. Bathroom Issues: The washroom was a disaster – with leaking pipes, a constant foul smell, and a complete lack of upkeep. The geyser was not installed in the room, and I was told that the common geyser on the rooftop wasn't functional either due to leakage issues. So hot water was simply not available. Reception and Service: The receptionist was extremely unresponsive and full of excuses. Any issue reported was either brushed aside or blamed on construction delays. There is no intercom or room phone, so you're forced to call the receptionist on his personal number, which rarely connects in the first few attempts due to poor network. Even basic requests like drinking water took over 30–60 minutes, and only after repeated follow-ups. Any complaints were never followed through. When confronted later, the receptionist would conveniently blame someone else – a shift manager, a waiter, or a repair guy. It was clear that accountability and service are non-existent here. Lift and Safety Concerns: The lift has no light, and riding in it at night felt unsafe and eerie. For a place that advertises itself as a suite or luxury stay, this is completely unacceptable. Lost Item Incident: To make matters worse, I forgot my Google Pixel earphones (worth ₹10,000) in the room. When I called to check, the staff outright denied finding them, which leads me to question the honesty and integrity of the staff. --- Final Verdict: My overall experience was pathetic, and I would strongly advise against staying at Posh Suites unless they undergo a major overhaul in both infrastructure and service. The name and pictures are misleading, and the lack of hygiene, basic amenities, responsiveness, and safety make this place a big no.

hotel_name: Doubletree By Hilton Hotel Gurgaon - New Delhi Ncr
review_text: Staying at the Hilton DoubleTree Gurgaon feels like observing a well-functioning ecosystem in which hospitality, logistics, and human attentiveness have reached a pleasing equilibrium. What truly elevated our stay was the exceptional customer service. A special note of appreciation to Shivani Mishra, Manthan Agarwal, and Janaki Thapa, whose attention to detail and genuine warmth transformed routine interactions into memorable moments. Their hospitality was not performative, but precise and thoughtful, the kind that quietly reassures you that everything is under control. Breakfast deserves its own paragraph, if not a short essay. The spread was an impressive blend of à la carte options, Indian specialties, and Western favorites, offering something for every palate. What stood out was the sheer geographic ambition of the menu. From Gujarati kachoris to South Indian idlis, dosas, and pongal, from Mumbai’s pav bhaji to classic North Indian aloo paratha, it felt as though the entire subcontinent had been thoughtfully represented on a single buffet. Each dish was flavorful, well executed, and deeply satisfying. A sincere thank you to Rahul at the breakfast buffet for his attentiveness and warm service, and to Pushparaj at the dosa station, whose skill and consistency turned each dosa into an edible triumph. The hotel’s location adds another layer of convenience, making it easy to reach major attractions or the airport with minimal effort. We visited during winter, and the festive décor added a delightful seasonal charm. Christmas decorations were thoughtfully placed throughout, and the reception desks, designed as gingerbread houses, added a playful yet elegant touch that reflected careful planning rather than excess. Overall, this was a thoroughly enjoyable stay. The Hilton DoubleTree Gurgaon succeeds by combining attentive service, excellent food, smart location, and a sense of occasion. I would happily recommend it and would not hesitate to return.

Always have been a fan of the Citadines chain and seeing that the hotel was quite newly built in 2024, I took a chance on a stay. Location was definitely out of the way from most places as it currently stands in the middle of nowhere, but most places are pretty easily accessible by an Uber. Hotel felt definitely secure with very friendly security and hotel staff with its welcome lobby at level 14. Views are definitely amazing. The rooms are definitely up to standard and very comfortable for my stay, notably for the price paid. Facilities wise, it is definitely quite limited. I was upgraded to a One Bedroom Executive on my first night stay and was pleasantly surprised how spacious the room was and the appliances that came with the room! Really happy with a fridge that actually worked! On a return trip, I was housed in a Studio Deluxe room, and the amenities were sufficient and comfortable for my stay! Especially loved a hot water system that is consistent! I would like to express thanks to Ms. Shruti who has been very attentive and helpful towards my entire stay on both occasions and had graciously remembered me as well, and would love to commend her service in making my administrative stuff a breeze! Highly recommended if you are here for a short stay or a longer one with needs of a washing machine. Will definitely come back on another visit if I'm around the area!

Besides, there was minimal greeting on arrival or a thank you at departure- it was transactional at best. Lots of construction on the area makes the whole place dusty. Last stretch of road non existent as many noted. There are better options at this price, which I will explore next time.

review_text: Room and bathroom was clean. Bed was not enough size for 2 adults and 1 child (10yrs). Additional mattress made movement inconvenient in the room. hotel_name: Aravali Marriott Resort & Spa, Delhi Ncr
review_text: This property has rated itself as a 5-star establishment/ luxe property in booking sites, which raises a serious question for the management: are you truly aware of the standards, facilities, and hospitality expected from a 5-star property? 1. Corporate Events vs. Family Guests If there is a corporate event scheduled, families should not be made to suffer because of it. Loud DJ music continued until 12:15 AM, and it was only after I called the reception at least five times that the volume was addressed. I am not against corporate events, but there should be proper planning. If a property is reserved for corporate gatherings on a particular day or during certain hours, then families with children should either be informed in advance or such bookings should be avoided during that time. 2. Midnight Menu Service The service was extremely slow, and the food quality was average at best (5/10). The response I received was simply: “Sorry sir, there are multiple orders, please manage.” This is not the level of service one expects from a 5-star property. 3. Dining Service Around 10 PM, a large family group of about 20 people arrived, and the staff completely forgot about my order. I had to wait 20 minutes, after which my request was finally served with a brief apology. 4. Premium Room with Private Sit-Out The room advertised as premium came with several shortcomings: - No bathtub, which is usually standard in premium rooms. - No exhaust ventilation in the bathroom, causing it to become unpleasant after a few hours. - The private sit-out was practically unusable due to monkeys roaming around. 5. Indoor Kids’ Play Area The kids’ indoor play area was unclean and poorly maintained, with floor mats visibly dirty and blackened. Initially, to compensate for the inconvenience caused by the corporate event, the staff offered a room upgrade. However, the real question is — is that enough to justify the overall experience? Dear Management, not every guest can simply forget their experience in exchange for an upgrade or a few complimentary gestures. Guest experience and family comfort are non-negotiable, especially when you claim to operate as a 5-star property.

I recently stayed for one night at Ginger Faridabad and overall, the experience was average and did not quite justify the room tariff charged. While I understand that business hotels in this area can be priced on the higher side, the facilities and service standards should match the cost, which unfortunately was not the case during my stay. The room itself was fairly basic and average in terms of comfort and maintenance. Cleanliness could definitely be improved. There were no towels available in the bathroom upon check-in, which was inconvenient. Additionally, the bathroom drains were clogged, leading to water accumulation during bathing and creating an unpleasant experience. Such issues should ideally be checked and resolved before allotting the room to guests. Another concern was that the television in the room was not working. When I informed the service team, the response was quite slow. While the staff was polite, the delay in addressing these basic issues affected the overall comfort of the stay. On a positive note, the restaurant food was not bad. The taste and quality were decent, and that was one aspect that met expectations. Overall, the property has potential, but improvements in maintenance, room readiness, and service responsiveness are necessary to truly match the tariff being charged.

If you plan to stay here, I recommend requesting a room on the 4th floor. Overall, a comfortable stay with room for improvement in room upgrades and breakfast variety.

review_text: I stayed in this hotel for 2 nights . The rooms are small and congested and the bathroom is also small. The rooms are not well maintained. Park Plaza Faridabad is a solid choice for both business and leisure travelers looking for an upscale, convenient stay. Highlights: Excellent Service: The staff is consistently highlighted as being extremely courteous, friendly, and prompt, ensuring a welcoming and pleasant experience. Convenient Location: It is centrally located in Faridabad's Sector 21C, offering easy access to the industrial hub, nearby markets, and business areas. Great Dining: The hotel offers multiple dining options, and the breakfast buffet is frequently praised for its variety and quality. Comfort & Amenities: Rooms are clean, spacious, and comfortable. Guests also appreciate the on-site spa, fitness center, and pool. While some older reviews occasionally mention minor maintenance issues in the bathrooms, the overall consensus is that the hotel delivers excellent hospitality and comfort, making it one of the better options in Faridabad. Recommended for: Business trips and travelers prioritizing top-notch service and a central location.

I recently visited Yaduvanshi Farm & Resort and had an amazing experience! The place is surrounded by beautiful greenery and offers a very peaceful environment away from the city rush. The resort is well-maintained, clean, and perfect for spending quality time with family and friends. The lawns are spacious and great for parties, celebrations, and photoshoots. The swimming pool and activity areas make the experience even more enjoyable. The staff was very polite and helpful, and the food was delicious with great quality. If you are looking for a perfect place for a weekend getaway, family picnic, birthday party, or pre-wedding shoot, I highly recommend Yaduvanshi Farm & Resort. It’s a great destination to relax, celebrate, and create wonderful memories. Definitely worth visiting!

We went to Yaduvanshi for a day outing and honestly had a great time. The welcome was warm with a small rajtilak and refreshing drinks. The place has a very rustic, natural vibe — open fields, greenery and a lot of small thoughtful activities that keep everyone engaged. We tried pottery, traditional games, a mud bath session and spent some time in the pool as well. What really stood out was the peaceful environment; you can hear birds, sit under the trees and just slow down a bit. The highlight for us was their long zipline — the view from the top during sunset was amazing and totally worth it. The staff managing the activities was friendly and ensured everything was done safely. Food was homely and good with a huge dinning area, and the overall experience felt relaxed and family-friendly. A nice countryside break if you want to disconnect from the city noise for a day.

Positive Points: The food quality and taste were good. Breakfast, lunch, live snacks, and evening snacks were well prepared and satisfying. The zip line activity was good and properly managed compared to other activities. Negative Points: The staff and manager behavior was very disappointing. Once we entered the resort after making full payment, there was no positive response or proper interaction from anyone. Overall, it was a very bad experience in terms of hospitality. Before making payment, it is very important to enquire whether school student groups are present or not. If school students are there, you will not enjoy even 10% of your trip due to overcrowding and noise. Kids’ activities and activity areas are very small and outdated, offering very limited engagement. Most activities are only for name sake, such as camel ride, horse ride, and tractor ride — just one very small round. Outside, we can enjoy better rides for ₹50 with more satisfaction. There is no staff available to guide or assist at most activities. Except for the zip line, no one was there to help or manage properly. Final Verdict: We felt that only the food quality and taste justified the amount paid. Apart from that, the overall experience did not meet expectations.

review_text: We had high hopes for our visit, but the experience was nothing short of frustrating. We had placed an order for food while booking, specifically so we wouldn’t have to wait upon arrival. However, when we reached the farm, the staff seemed completely unaware of our order. They casually informed us that nothing had been prepared and they needed to go out and buy ingredients. This alone took nearly two hours, and we were still left waiting for our food. Trying to get updates was another ordeal—calls went unanswered. When I finally found a staff member and asked about our food, his response was, “Jisko order diya hai usse pucho” (ask the person you placed the order with). When we finally got the paneer tikka, we requested mint dip, which took another 30 minutes to arrive. To top it off, we received the wrong dishes for some of our orders. While the food itself was decent and tasty, the overall service was terrible. The worst part? I had an early flight and had booked a cab to leave at 6 AM. Only then did I realize that someone had locked the main gate from the outside. It took me 20-25 minutes to wake up the staff, who then disappeared to find the keys from another servant before finally unlocking the gate. Shockingly, there was no guard on-site. Locking the main entrance without any supervision is not only careless but dangerous. What if there had been a medical emergency? Overall, the mismanagement, lack of basic hospitality, and unresponsive staff made the entire experience incredibly disappointing. Would not recommend until they seriously improve their operations.

Forced into this establishment due to a last-minute cancellation by another hotel – a cancellation apparently triggered by the lack of an Aadhar card, a baffling requirement for tourists – we were greeted with appalling conditions, dismissive service, and dubious costs. Despite providing multiple forms of identification, including my license, marriage certificate, and passport, the check-in process was far from smooth. The room we were given reeked of an unpleasant odor, a clear sign of neglect. It seemed deserted, with no other guests in sight during our stay. The state of the beds and mattresses was abysmal, with visible stains and dirt rendering them unfit for use. Basic amenities like toilet paper and drinking water were luxuries we had to beg for repeatedly. Even when provided, the toilet paper was half-used and clearly recycled. Tap water in a dirty bottle was the closest we got to hydration, a testament to the hotel's disregard for guest comfort and well-being. In addition to the appalling conditions, the costs incurred were dubious at best. Priced at 1500 INR per night (3000 INR for two nights), the value proposition was abysmal considering the substandard accommodations and lackluster service provided. To add insult to injury, the receptionist exhibited a shocking level of rudeness and indifference towards our concerns. It became apparent that guest accommodation and satisfaction were not priorities for this establishment. Even with relatives in the vicinity, we were left to fend for ourselves, as the hotel displayed blatant apathy towards our plight. Constant calls from our relatives were necessary to prompt any semblance of service, highlighting the utter incompetence and neglect rampant at OYO Meghna Residency. In summary, our experience at OYO Meghna Residency was a harrowing ordeal, marred by unsanitary conditions, indifferent service, and dubious costs. I strongly advise against subjecting oneself to such a dismal establishment, and urge prospective guests to seek accommodations elsewhere for a truly pleasant stay in India.

hotel_name: Fabhotel Oyster Villa - Hotel In Sushant Lok 1, Gurgaon
review_text: Excellent location, very close to Paras Hospital and Medanta; so it’s great for families travelling for medical care purposes. It’s a great corporate hotel, for a work stay or with families - good WiFi, good food. Neat and clean, very spacious rooms. They have a small cafe also, that offers lip smacking food.

We checked out from this hotel today (Room no-104), in Gurgaon, Haryana. A good and reasonable hotel, but lack basic amenities also (especially during extreme winters). No room-heaters during winters. They don't change bedsheet, neither ask to change ~ they expect us (customers) to go to them and plea them for changing and cleaning our rooms -- this shows lack of responsibility of them towards customers and lack of their duties. Very Unprofessional, untrained and rude staff. If we ask them to send anything to our room - they will take 1 hour approx to deliver in our room. Kitchen is mostly closed by 10 pm in night. Food is ok and good, but too much costly. They Don't serve tea or breakfast before 8.15 am, if we ask them. Also, we have to opt for breakfast during the booking. They have posted luxurious photos, but actually inside the room it's very low grade hotel and with less space rooms. But YES - what i really appreciated is the best balcony in my room with swing💝 Really love and liked this vibe💚🫡 Also, as per the price ~ its nominal but they should provide basic amenities (especially during extreme winters and fog). Room is equipped with ACs and Geysers and basic toiletries were provided in the bathroom as well. Highly disappointed. But these issues can be fixed, if the hotel owner is ready to rectify these and take in-charge of all this.

I had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The room was spacious, well-maintained, and very clean, which made it extremely comfortable. The staff was also very helpful and courteous throughout my stay. I would definitely recommend this hotel to others.

Best place to stay within a budget of 2400. They provide complimentary breakfast, food is very good. Room is spacious, clean and well organized. bathroom is clean equipped with modern fittings. Balconies available in some rooms. Highly recommended. Only the location is a bit inside the colony, but not an issue.

Very pathetic hotel. Do not have basic amenities. No heater during winter. They don't change bedsheet . Unprofessional and untrained staff. Kitchen is closed by 10 pm in night. Don't serve tea or breakfast before 8.15. They have posted good photos but actually inside the room it's very low grade hotel. Highly disappointed.

Gym,table tennis and snooker is not there as shown in the pictures.They have converted it to a banquet hall.Rooms are small but decent.Balcony view is good.Rate is on the higher side compared to the services offered.Food option is available.

review_text: Cleaning service was good, room cleaning person was so polite that you can ask them to change each and everything in the room. They are sweetest person in the hotel. Hotel is just 2km from the DLF downtown. Autos and Swiggy are easily accessible. Empty plates are chargeable. Enjoyed the stay.

hotel_name: Staayz Premium, Gurugram - Hotel & Studio Apartments
review_text: This is the worst hotel I stayed in. I will never ever recommend it to anyone. I stayed from 14th to 16th July 2025. I was offered a room full of smoke. The doors of the room open and close with huge difficulty. The reception staff are the worst of the lot. On day 1, I requested for sharing the menu on WhatsApp they did not care to do it . I waited for half an hour. After reminding over the phone they took sweet 10 minutes. I had already reached the reception. I was tired and frustrated and wanted to take some rest and have food at the hotel. But this staff had other ideas. They ensured that I should find some good dhaba which I eventually did. I had taken room with complimentary breakfast, next morning I booked breakfast through their whatsapp link , after 10 minutes asked the reception how much time they take to deliver the breakfast. I was told 20-25 minutes. One hour passed , no one came. So , fuming i went to the reception to check the issue. They said I selected the two items but they could not see my order. The reason, they never explained me that I have to add the two items in a cart and from there I should proceed. I asked them many of the guests might be doing the mistake which I did so why they never cared to explain how to order through their link. There was no answer. It was getting clearer and louder they never wanted to serve complimentary breakfast. Same night, i had some issues with the tv but no one acted immediately. Since I had to go out for dinner, so I reminded and requested for it so one guy accompanied and resolved the issue. I asked for the towel, but it never came. My humble request to the owner, how come you are ignorant to all this . How come you have a staff who does not even understand customer or customer service. Only , the cleaning staff is doing their duty well. I had booked my hotel through goibibo. Request them tonot to list such bad hotels. I wish there was 0 or negative rating for service.

hotel_name: Staayz Premium, Gurugram - Hotel & Studio Apartments
review_text: Have stayed multiple times. Quality is going down day by day. Bed bugs, cockroaches in quite a few rooms along with a lot of mould. The staff is nice, but unfortunately things are beyond their control. The wifi is also weird, either signal would be less or there wouldn't be any speed. Room 216 is absolutely filled with cockroaches and bed bugs. Most rooms are always booked because of the location.

hotel_name: Staayz Premium, Gurugram - Hotel & Studio Apartments
review_text: Very bad service and staff, Don't book this hotel as they don't listen or care for the customer, Once you book you are on your own. Also Their rooms have broken door locks, noisy AC and dirty water for bath. So overall a big NO for anyone booking this property.

hotel_name: Staayz Premium, Gurugram - Hotel & Studio Apartments
review_text: Rooms are clean. Location and food is good. Construction is old. A.c. and wifi does not work well. Room service is okay ish.
Rooms are spacious and clean. Hitachi AC's do the job. Service is responsive and food is ok. The breakfast menu is limited. Nothing fancy. The location is very good very near DLF phase 1 rapid metro
Property is old and rooms are smelly. They are not doing proper cleaning of even common areas.

Best place to stay. Good room services.and easily accessible.
Great value for money. Maintains Treebo standards. Very well behaved staff

The hotel is not quite as good as it appears online The location is fine, the room was spacious and comfortable, the water for the shower was only hot in the morning, later in the day it would only come out luke warm. The WiFi worked perfectly and the Ac also The room itself just looked directly onto another building's wall and a service stairway which wasn't very nice as staff were walking past outside the window, very different to images shown when booking Unfortunately the floor in the hallway is extremely squeaky so you can hear squeaky footsteps outside your room whenever someone passes. The breakfast is very basic, not a huge amount of choice and lacking any fruit juice, the omelette was quite dry, coffees and teas etc were just from a flask and not fresh. The staff were very friendly and check-in etc was fine but in the three nights we stayed our room wasn't cleaned or our bins emptied and it is wasn't offered either. We probably would not return to this hotel if given a choice.

I love this hotel so much. This is not a paid review, I booked the hotel with my own money. I have tried several hotels around this price point around Delhi and they were mostly disappointing. But this one is the hotel I'll recommend and go back to again. Room is so clean and fancy and spacious I feel so comfortable, its like a haven in the midst of this polluted city. Food is amazing. The service staff are kind and helpful. As a female traveler I feel safe staying here. After staying in scammy hotels where the pictures didnt match the reality, finding this hotel was such a relief. Thank you to the staff at Woodbury

Great stay. The hotel is very well maintained, gives utmost comfort, service is amazing. There's no reason why you wouldn't choose this as your frequent stay if you are in the vicinity. Peaceful surroundings, silent zone, good food, lovely breakfast.

The stay was quiet and calm, room were neat and clean with decent space, bathrooms were also clean and decently spacious. Only if the price which I got it for is a bit more acc to me rest the stay was overall very good. No disturbance with great service.

It was really a wonderful experience, I stayed for the three nights and staff was loving, caring, & superfast... Hotel rooms are really big and equipped with necessary amenities as per the prices. Recommendation: Need to add few options in the breakfast, & breakfast should be start at 07:00 instead of 08:30.

review_text: Scam Experience. Avoid We booked this property through Booking.com and paid a token amount. review_text: Very disappointing stay. The room had a strong damp smell, poor ventilation, and was not clean. Bedsheets appeared unhygienic, and the overall moisture made the stay uncomfortable. The staff’s behavior was also unsettling. Even after requesting for the room change, I was not provided with a cleaner/better room. Unfortunately, I fell sick afterward, likely due to the unhygienic conditions. Would never recommend this hotel to anyone.

hotel_name: Saltstayz Express - Golf Course Road & Dlf Phase-1
review_text: 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Excellent Stay at SaltStayz Express Keepi! I had an amazing experience staying at SaltStayz Express Sector 28 ! The property was super clean, well-maintained, and had a very welcoming vibe from the moment I checked in. The rooms were spotless, cozy, and equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay. A big shoutout to Manager Suraj and Mukesh — both went above and beyond to make sure my stay was smooth and enjoyable. Their hospitality and attention to detail truly stood out! Whether it was quick room service, helpful local suggestions, or just their friendly attitude, they made the entire experience top-notch. If you’re looking for a place that combines great service, hospitality, and cleanliness, I’d 100% recommend SaltStayz Express near cyber city . Definitely a place I’d love to revisit!

hotel_name: Saltstayz Express - Golf Course Road & Dlf Phase-1
review_text: Here’s a refined, clear, and professional version, keeping the frustration intact but making it impactful: I booked the room for an hourly stay only to freshen up and get ready for the office, but the experience was extremely disappointing. The room and washroom were filthy, with visible marks and stains all over the walls. It took nearly 30 minutes just to get an iron. None of the basic toiletries were provided—no towels, drinking water, toilet paper, dental kit, shower gel, or even handwash. When I turned on the shower, the water sprayed straight onto the roof, making it unusable. I then tried to take a bucket bath, only to find that the mug was missing. In less than an hour, the sheer lack of basic facilities and responsiveness made the stay incredibly irritating and frustrating.

hotel_name: Saltstayz Express - Golf Course Road & Dlf Phase-1
review_text: The manager sahil / suraj was very unprofessional. Had a very wrong attitude. Asked us to get out & have breakfast just because we wanted an extra piece of bread & was more than ready to pay for it. Never coming to salt stays again, neither are my people.

hotel_name: Saltstayz Express - Golf Course Road & Dlf Phase-1
review_text: I was turned off by how bad the rooms were, specially the bedsheets. They showed me two rooms and in one of them there were holes in the bedsheet and the other one had so many spots. They don't really pay attention to cleanliness it seems. The overall vibe wasn't good either. This might be a bit cheaper but definitely not worth it.

Rude staff- they don’t talk to you in a good way at all. And they don’t deliver what they promise. We were told dinner will be available in the restaurant from 8.00 pm to 10.00 pm. When we went to have dinner at 8.45 pm, we were very rudely told that the dinner will be served in the rooms and that too Thalis will be served which will take another 20 mins. What nonsense are these people upto????? Please don’t book here as they are the rudest people. Already we were in stress due to medical emergency and these people just made it worse.

I stayed on this property twice. Both the times I found cockroaches, on first stay i saw cockroach on bed and while on second stay I saw cockroach in almirah. In my second stay there is no exhaust in washroom, the area is covered with tissue. Location is great. Service is ok. I stayed for 4 nights and everyday they forget to put towels. The water bottle is never refilled in my 4 nights stay. If you opt for dinner they will give you veg/nonveg thali which is very boring. I dont eat spicy food instead of requesting for non spicy dal they gave spicy dal everytime. Breakfast is good with many food options.on my second stay i hot torn bedsheet and it was same for all 4 nights. They dont have hair dryer available with them instead of mentioned on their page. Overall i will give 3 rating.

1. Electricity was constantly going. No stable power supply. 2. Room service is extremely slow. I ordered a cold coffee which never arrived. I had to checkout. 3. There was no supply of hot water and the maintenance was clueless as to why is there no hot water supply. 4. They are charging ₹500 per hour for a late checkout which is absurd. This is a 5 star checkout fee and this isnt even a 3 star chain. 5. This is not the Saltstayz standard at all.

Read the reviews before going, some people complaint about the rooms and such as the rooms, Were ok it had stains and cockroaches. It had running hot water. Good view. The service was very good. It's only the rooms. They do not allow outside food.
Good experience, just some cleanliness needed in some areas, apart from very small things all good. Punita has been a great host here. Thanks

I also appreciated the thoughtful touches, like complimentary bottled water, a well-stocked minibar, and a quiet atmosphere that made it easy to relax and unwind. But what really stood out was the food. Whether it was breakfast, room service, or dining at the on-site restaurant, every meal was exceptional. I especially recommend the all food are too delicious Overall, I had a fantastic experience and would highly recommend hotel golf view suits and sakura to anyone looking for a luxurious and comfortable stay with truly memorable dining thanks all staff Thankyou MR.PARVEEN

Located in central gurgaon with easy access to metro as well, yet quite and calm environs. Housekeeping need to buck up to create a better experience. A 3 star hotel and still manage to provide all facilities (even if at a smaller scale) of a 4 star hotel and definitely a good value for money. A special mention of Naresh - a sure asset to the hotel. Always smiling and ready to serve you.

“A Perfect Stay from Start to Finish!” ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ From the moment we arrived, the hospitality was outstanding. The check-in process was smooth, and the staff went out of their way to make us feel welcome. The rooms were spotless, spacious, and thoughtfully designed, with every detail taken care of for comfort. The location is excellent—close to major attractions yet peaceful enough for a relaxing stay. Dining at the hotel was a highlight: the breakfast spread was fresh and varied, and the restaurant offered delicious meals with impeccable service. What truly stood out was the warmth of the team—they were always attentive, courteous, and ready to assist with a smile. It felt less like staying at a hotel and more like being a valued guest in someone’s home. We left with wonderful memories and will definitely be returning. Highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for comfort, convenience, and genuine hospitality!

Restaurant has limited meals. The menu card is just an formality. Steward Mr. Anand will surprise guests on their placed orders. (Kindly give in writing and reconfirm) or be ready to have what is served in your plate.

Had a wonderful stay at Mod Avenue Hotel. The ambience was excellent and the services provided were truly outstanding. Special thanks to Ms. Shipra for her respectful, courteous, and prompt assistance, making our stay truly comfortable and memorable. The food was absolutely amazing—very tasty and reasonably priced. Also, heartfelt thanks to Mr. Balwant and Ms. Hemlata for coordinating so well and ensuring all our requirements were fulfilled during our stay. Highly recommended! 😊

I would like to share my sincere appreciation for the excellent hospitality and service provided during my recent stay at your hotel on MOD Avenue. A special mention goes to Mr. Balwant, whose professionalism, warmth, and attentiveness truly stood out. He was consistently courteous, prompt in addressing requests, and ensured that my stay was comfortable and pleasant throughout. His positive attitude and dedication to guest satisfaction reflect very well on your hotel’s service standards. Please convey my thanks to Mr. Balwant and acknowledge his efforts. Staff members like him make a meaningful difference to the overall guest experience, and I would be happy to recommend your hotel based on the service received.

Mod Avenue: Excellent Value, Stylish Stay, and Surprisingly Good Food My recent stay at Mod Avenue was fantastic, offering a compelling blend of style, comfort, and value. For anyone looking for accommodation in the ₹2500 price range, this hotel is definitely a top contender and highly recommended. The first thing that stood out was the very good interior design. The aesthetic choices throughout the property give the hotel a premium feel that often costs much more. This attention to detail extended right into the rooms. I found my room to be surprisingly spacious, offering plenty of room to relax and work comfortably. Crucially, the hygiene was impeccably maintained—everything felt fresh and clean, which is essential for a worry-free stay. One of the unexpected highlights was the food service. Often, in-room dining can be overpriced or underwhelming, but at Mod Avenue, I was pleasantly surprised. The food prices were well within a reasonable range, and the quality was genuinely good. I especially enjoyed the simple comfort food I tried—both the Maggi and the noodles were prepared perfectly. Overall, Mod Avenue provides exceptional value for money. It couples a stylish environment with clean, comfortable rooms and high-quality, reasonably priced dining, making it a stellar choice in its price segment.

Stayed here recently and had a great experience. The room was spotless, well kept, and really comfortable. The rates were fair, especially for the quality and comfort we got. The staff were friendly and attentive, and I have to give a shoutout to Balawant, who went out of his way to be helpful and made sure all our needs were taken care of quickly. Hospitality like this is hard to find these days. Overall, it’s a clean, cozy, and affordable place with excellent service. Would happily come back anytime.

Nice rooms, stylishly designed, delicious food and well maintained. This is one of the business hotels around the cyber hub which provide nice accomodation with all the basic amenities. Service is decent. Rooms are spacious. Shared balconies was a let off. Limited options for the breakfast menu but otherwise food was decent.

This is my second time staying at Golf View Suites (first time in Nov '25) and both times have been very pleasant stays, mainly in part because of the service provided by Shreenath, one of the managers of the hotel who always went above and beyond with any request I had. I was in Gurugram for work and Golf View Suites had the perfect setup to just get back and relax. I highly recommend it for business travel. On a side note, some of the food on the room service menu was really good. 5 stars for the Chicken Biriyani. The only complaint is that more than half the menu is not available like the burgers, spring rolls, and momos. The same items were missing both times I stayed there. A special shout out to Parvin and Razu who we're very attentive at breakfast on my last day at the hotel and my first time trying the breakfast buffet.

Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5) “We are staying here and had a very pleasant experience. The food quality is excellent—fresh, tasty, and well prepared. The service is also very good; staff is polite, cooperative, and attentive. Special thanks to Prabin and Mohit for being very helpful and ensuring our stay is comfortable. Overall, a great place with good food and excellent service. Highly recommended.”

Really enjoyed my stay at this hotel. The room was neat and well-maintained, the service was excellent, and the staff made us feel very welcome. Food was tasty and hygiene was well taken care of. Would love to stay here again. Thanku parveen feel us special ❤️‍🩹

My experience at Hotel 91 was excellent. The food quality was very good and tasty. I would like to appreciate the staff members Ajay Yadav for their friendly and supportive service. They were attentive and made us feel comfortable. Overall, it was a great stay.

We had a wonderful experience. The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The staff was courteous and ensured everything was perfect. Service was quick, and the ambiance was comfortable and clean. I would definitely visit again and recommend this place to others.thankyou parbeen for take care us thankyou all

The place I can call home away home! Had a chance to stay for four days with full occupancy in December 2025. Nothing felt short of anything to name in regard to services, staff, f&b, and something that need mentioning is the calm, patient and friendly services. The rooms were elegant, clean and comfortable. Food and catering just super delicious. Above all Need to mention the fact that GM Mr Santosh Soni met with all the challenges, provided and provisioned all my needs and requirements. Not only Mr Soni but the MD Mr Rajnikant Gupta too needs to be applauded for his leadership and support. It’s been a privilege staying amongst the best of most capable and talented people and super excited place. I can summarise my stay as lifetime relationship with hotel and its staff at all levels.

This was a very disappointing stay, especially considering it was a corporate booking. We had requested an early check-in in advance and were told it would be arranged, but on arrival we were simply asked to wait, with no proper explanation. At check-in, the staff mentioned providing a balcony view room (initially chargeable, later stated as complimentary), but this was made conditional on giving a positive review immediately, even before seeing the room or experiencing the service. This was highly unprofessional. The room hygiene was poor, with flies present in the room. The Wi-Fi was unreliable and slow, with frequent disconnections and speeds not exceeding 10 Mbps. Anyone coming for office or remote work should be aware that working from the room is extremely difficult. I also found that the online ratings do not reflect the actual experience. I shared my concerns directly with the hotel team, yet even during checkout, the staff continued to ask for reviews. I clearly informed them that I did not wish to leave one. Overall, this was one of the worst hotel stays I’ve experienced. I would strongly advise future guests, especially corporate travelers, to think twice and not rely solely on the ratings.

I am writing to formally report an issue I faced at your property, **Hotel Aldott cyber city, Gurgaon Sector 24 **and to request your approval for hotel-side cancellation, which is required for my refund to be processed by ClearTrip. Booking Details: - Platform: ClearTrip - Hotel: **Aldott cyber city, Gurgaon Sector 24 ** - Check-in date: 2nd February - Time I reached the hotel: 1:30 a.m. on 2nd February When I reached the hotel at 1:30 a.m., the receptionist denied me entry, stating that my booking was for “tomorrow” and that check-in would be allowed only after 2:00 p.m. This was extremely distressing, as early-morning check-ins are commonly considered part of the same night. Immediately after this, I contacted ClearTrip customer support. The ClearTrip executive: 1. Sent an official cancellation approval email to the hotel, requesting acknowledgment 2. Then issued a voucher to change the booking date from 2nd Feb to 1st Feb, as per my request However, the receptionist refused to acknowledge or reply to any email or voucher, stating repeatedly that he “did not have the authority” to do so. Additionally, the receptionist insisted that I pay ₹4,500 in cash to book another room offline, despite the fact that I had already paid ₹4,485 online for the same room. I refused this request, as it was unreasonable and inappropriate. I was clearly informed by the receptionist that a manager would arrive in the morning and would handle the acknowledgment and cancellation. However, later that morning, ClearTrip informed me that the hotel manager has now denied the cancellation, resulting in my refund being put on hold. Due to: - Denial of check-in despite reaching at 1:30 a.m. - Refusal to acknowledge official communication from ClearTrip - Request for additional cash payment - Conflicting statements regarding authority and cancellation I was left stranded at night and unable to avail the booking. I respectfully request you to approve the cancellation from the hotel’s end and acknowledge the cancellation request sent by ClearTrip, so that my rightful refund can be processed immediately. I hope this matter can be resolved amicably and promptly. I am confident that the property management will take this seriously and ensure fair treatment of guests.
It was a pleasant stay. Comfortable rooms, very cordial and accommodating staff and excellent location. Miss Sanjana was especially cooperative and kind to our requests. Would recommend to all.

We organized my brother’s wedding at The Aldott Hotel, and everything was absolutely perfect. From beautiful arrangements to smooth coordination, the staff took great care of every detail. The rooms were clean, food was delicious, and guests were very happy. Truly a memorable experience for our family. Highly recommended for weddings.

We stayed here for one night and honestly, the room was very average considering the price charged. There was no proper heating option, which was quite uncomfortable. The amenities were minimal, and even basic tea and coffee were not stocked properly. The room view was completely blocked by a wall, which made the stay feel even more dull. The interiors looked outdated and the seating appeared worn out. What was most disappointing was the clear preference shown toward Japanese guests. We requested access to the karaoke room but were denied, while it seemed to be available for Japanese guests. If the priority is only for one group of guests, that should be clearly communicated instead of making others feel unwelcome. The only good part of the stay was Ladera restaurant. Unfortunately, overall the experience was disappointing and we would not prefer to return.

We hosted our engagement party at the Ladera outdoor Mediterranean restaurant and the indoor Japanese restaurant, and everything was perfect. The food, service, décor, and ambience were impeccable. Special thanks to Lalit, the banquet manager, for excellent coordination, Mahesh for managing the food service, and Sanjay for the beautiful décor and attention to detail. Highly recommend this venue for special occasions!

If u stay here, get the deluxe rooms. The non -delixe ones face the wall of the Radisson hotel and as a result the windows are blocked so no natural light comes in the room. Stayed for 3 days which felt gloomy. The wardrobe in the these rooms are small and have no shelves. The hotel hosts a technoparty 12am-5am on Fri and Sat and has a karoake room on 5th floor which was my floor so had plenty of noise coming in on those nights. The buffet was nice and the staff is friendly as well. The Ladera restaurant for Italian food is very very nice.
The service was amazing and quick! The team handled our events with utmost professionalism and respect. Highly recommend!
Good parties take place here , heaven for techno crowd. Washroom are small and lots of waiting during gigs

review_text: I recently stayed at Saltstayz and, unfortunately, the experience was far below acceptable hospitality standards. As someone who frequently travels and works closely with real estate and hospitality properties, I truly did not expect this level of negligence from a brand that positions itself as a comfortable and service-oriented stay option. From the moment I checked in, the issues were hard to ignore. • Torn bed sheets that clearly should have been replaced long ago. • Mosquitoes inside the washroom, making it extremely uncomfortable to use. • A TV that wasn’t working, which shows poor room maintenance and lack of basic checks before giving the room to a guest. • Overall, the room felt poorly maintained, lacking the cleanliness and readiness one expects from a hotel. These problems are not minor; they reflect deeper concerns about housekeeping standards, quality control, and management oversight. Guests choose a hotel for comfort, hygiene, and reliability — none of which I experienced during this stay. I sincerely hope the ownership and management look into this seriously. Saltstayz has potential, but without immediate improvement in maintenance, cleanliness, and guest service, the brand risks losing trust and credibility. This review is not to criticise for the sake of criticism, but to highlight real issues that need urgent attention. I hope the team takes this feedback constructively and ensures that no guest faces this kind of experience again.

He is a dominating, greedy individual who has absolutely no regard for his customers. His greed knows no bounds. To give a perfect example: after being a guest here for almost three months, I needed to check out at 3:00 PM due to a late flight, just four hours past the standard 11:00 AM checkout. Instead of showing a shred of humanity or politeness for a long-term guest, the owner flatly refused and demanded extra payment for these few hours. This perfectly illustrates his money-obsessed and uncaring nature. Furthermore, the owner’s language is consistently foul, unprofessional, and degrading. It was shocking to witness him speak this way not only to guests but also to his own staff. He preaches that the “customer is god,” but his actions show this is a hollow and meaningless phrase. He is not a man of his word, and the prices are exploitative; charging 30 INR for a water bottle and 60 INR for a simple cup of tea is outrageous. The only saving grace of this establishment is the staff. They are incredibly supportive, professional, and kind, and they are the only reason this hotel is still in business. The owner’s toxic personality and greed create an awful atmosphere that even the wonderful staff cannot overcome.

Rating: ★☆☆☆☆ I had an extremely disappointing stay at Inde Hotel, Cyber City, Gurugram (Phase 2), which is being marketed as a 4-star property but failed to meet even basic hospitality standards. I booked a stay with breakfast and dinner included. Due to a flight delay, I informed the hotel reception at 9:15 PM that I might arrive a few minutes late and requested them to please arrange dinner. This delay was completely beyond my control. The response from the reception was insensitive and unhelpful. I was clearly told, “We can’t do anything.” The receptionist initially could not even find my booking, despite it being valid for the same date. I offered to share my booking voucher immediately and requested that dinner be kept ready around 10 PM, but this was refused. I repeatedly and politely requested to speak to the manager, but the receptionist declined multiple times and said he had no authority. I reached the hotel at 10:01 PM, just one minute late. After finally showing my booking voucher, I was directed to the restaurant, where I was refused dinner again. I was traveling with children, after a long flight, and yet there was zero empathy or flexibility shown. I even offered to pay separately for dinner, but that was also refused. I was told that all services, including housekeeping, shut down completely after 10:00 PM. This is unacceptable for a so-called 4-star hotel. With no other option, I had to order food online and go to bed extremely dissatisfied. The next morning, the situation was equally poor. During breakfast: • Eggs, fruits, bread, butter were unavailable • Coffee was cold and unattended • Staff said items were unavailable “because of rain,” which is not a valid excuse Later, when I approached reception for Wi-Fi access due to low mobile network connectivity, I was informed that Wi-Fi was also not working. This hotel lacks basic service management, staff empowerment, accountability, and guest empathy. A 4-star rating comes with responsibility, which this property clearly does not uphold. I would strongly not recommend this hotel, especially for families or travelers arriving late due to unavoidable circumstances.

If you’re staying here, definitely ask for a masala dosa from Chef Anuj at the live counter — he makes the best one! Would absolutely recommend this place! 🌿✨ Attaching few images for Proof

Wonderful family-friendly stay at Anya Hotel Gurgaon. Spacious, clean rooms and calm ambience made it very comfortable for us and our 1-year-old child. Courteous staff, good breakfast and convenient location made it a relaxing and enjoyable family getaway.

I had a disappointing experience during my recent stay. At the time of check-in, I clearly mentioned that I would be checking out early and requested a breakfast box accordingly. The staff confirmed this arrangement, and based on that assurance, I booked the room with breakfast included. However, when I called the reception the night before to reconfirm my wake-up call at 5:00 AM and breakfast box at 5:30 AM, I was informed that the morning team had forgotten to note my request. I was then told that since the chef had already left, nothing could be done. When I asked why the guest should suffer due to the hotel’s internal miscommunication—especially after paying for the service—the response was simply, “Sir, I’m just a junior working here.” I find this attitude unprofessional. Regardless of hierarchy, guests deserve a hassle-free experience and proper service as promised. I hope the management addresses this issue seriously and ensures better communication among their staff in the future.

This was our second stay at Anya Hotel, and it was just as good as the first. The rooms were clean and comfortable. The breakfast was delicious with plenty of variety. The staff were polite, helpful, and made us feel very welcome. We’d happily visit again!

Amazing food, amazing location, it’s in a residential area infront of a park, so the environment is also very pleasant, good home like food, and the staff is amazing, very co-operative. I’ve found such a great and budget friendly option 1st time in Gurgaon. 🌺

The room was clean and the food was good, the staff was friendly and was available whenever we needed any help. Highly recommended from our side👍.

Highly recommended!

The propert is very neat and clean and the location is in a serene neighborhood. Just a short walk from the nearest metro station.the staff is very helpful and pleasant thank you Deepak and team for such a lovely and comfortable stay.

Nice place to stay either on day basis or monthly basis if you visiting or working near DLF Cyber City in Gurugram.

hotel_name: Bloom Hotel - Golf Course Road, Sector 43
review_text: We stayed here for a couple of nights because it was super close to our activities. Like anyone, I did read the overwhelmingly positive reviews about this place before booking it. However, I had my doubts after looking checking the price for the suite. But boy was I pleasantly surprised!! From the moment we set foot in the facility, we only saw smiling faces. Everyone was super helpful and the 24*7 manned receiption is excellent for our needs. Nice breakfast, and I like that the amenities and snacks are available at the reception to avoid waste. Excellent Value for money and highly recommend it. Five star experience all around!! Hope to stay with them again.

hotel_name: Bloom Hotel - Golf Course Road, Sector 43
review_text: ​I just finished an absolutely excellent stay at Hotel Bloom in Gurgaon and highly recommend it! ​From the moment I checked in, the staff were incredibly welcoming and professional. The service throughout my stay was truly top-notch. My room was spotlessly clean, very comfortable, and beautifully designed—a real pleasure to return to after a long day. Thank you to the entire team for making my visit so memorable! I will definitely be back.

hotel_name: Bloom Hotel - Golf Course Road, Sector 43
review_text: Great Stay at Bloom. Affordable price, delicious food and thanks to HK team for keeping the room tidy n cozy. Special thanks to Ms Renu at reception for making our stay so comfortable.

I attended an event here and it was a decent experience. Specifically i liked the layout of this hotel the main Hall, the park everything is just where it is supposed to be... The place is nice but there is scope of improvement in staff professionality, No complaints.

The general environment and set up is exceptionally good. The place is neat and clean. Dining is having wide range of food. The staff in particular Shri Vivekanand Chaudhary served and looked after all the guests. I recommend this property needs a visit.

Staying here, by contrast, has been a dream. The roads seem more navigable, the hotel is located in a gated community it seems, and the staff made me feel very safe and were very helpful. Staying here has been a great experience of Delhi, and a very pleasant stay before catching my flight today. I would recommend to all looking for a pleasant and safe stay in Delhi, particularly either arriving from the airport or looking to depart.

Very central for our visit and to ambience mall. The owner and staff are great with kids and accommodations, especially for laundry, extra beds/cots, heaters, and air purifiers. Good wifi for work. There's even a nice park nearby for the kids and walking.

Indiayaah Inn Hotel is a nice and comfortable place to stay. The rooms are clean, the staff is friendly, and the overall experience is pleasant and Near to Shikhanderpur Metro. Good value for money and a convenient choice for travelers.

Nice place and good Service by all staff and owner as well. Highly recommend for stay.

review_text: The food quality is exceptional, and the rooms are impeccably clean. The overall environment of the hotel is warm, comfortable, and welcoming. This is truly a must-visit property. hotel_name: Fortune Select Global, Gurgaon - Member Itc Hotels' Group
review_text: This is a very good hotel. The staff here are extremely nice, especially the Indian cuisine chefs, Chef Narendra and Chef Sachin. Both of them are excellent at Indian cuisine and truly amazing at what they do. The hotel is located just near Guru Dronacharya Metro Station.

hotel_name: Fortune Select Global, Gurgaon - Member Itc Hotels' Group
review_text: It's a very basic hotel, essential items were also missing like shaving kit, toothbrush and paste was provided for only 1 person when we were 2 of us. Breakfast spead was good and tasty. Not value for money.

hotel_name: Fortune Select Global, Gurgaon - Member Itc Hotels' Group
review_text: My stay at Fortune Select Global Hotel was an outstanding experience, thanks to their remarkable hospitality and amazing food. From the moment I arrived, the staff welcomed me with warmth, professionalism, and genuine care. Every interaction—whether at the reception, restaurant, or housekeeping—felt thoughtful and sincere.

hotel_name: Fortune Select Global, Gurgaon - Member Itc Hotels' Group
review_text: My stay at this hotel was truly delightful and comfortable. Team is very caring and providing the home away from home comfort. Neat and clean ambience. Thank you so much team itc Fortnite global for providing excellent service during my stay.

One of the worst services experienced ever. If anyone is planning to host a wedding here, PLEASE DONT. Although the food was delicious, but the service was so delayed and slow. The snacks service started so late and finished in 40-45 minutes only, instead of the promised 2-3 hours. Only thing worst than the service was the decoration and it’s coordination. They don’t have any taste in decoration and the team just wants to do whatever they have been doing for many years. No new taste. They promise to deliver but eventually do only what they have only been doing. I would highly suggest everyone to stay away from the venue if you want to have a hassle free event. A recommendation to the owners - please change the people managing the decorations and handling services. You should outsource these teams since the existing one’s cannot handle it at all. Additionally please maintain your rooms - leaky taps, ACs not working and shower area also leaks. Although Mr. Sachin tried helping us as much as possible. And he was approachable at all times. But he alone does not have much authority to take care of everything.

Hosted my brother's wedding function here for 2 days. The food was good all the arrangements were top notch. The services provided by the team at Fairlie was commendable. They agreed to everything with a smile. Mr Sachin and Mr Negi were approachable and ready to help with all the needs and wants of the families. The halls are beautiful and the only drawback is you can only opt for the vendors in their panel and can not deal with anyone from outside. Room service was swift being a small property of 35 rooms in total and the staff courteous. Keep up the good work 👍

We hosted our wedding celebrations on 26th & 27th November 2025 at Fairlie Resort, Chattarpur, New Delhi, and the experience was outstanding. From haldi to engagement and the wedding, everything was executed smoothly and exactly as planned. A special thanks to Sachin (SPOC) for his excellent coordination and to Praveen and the décor team for the beautiful setups. The rooms were spacious, clean, and very comfortable, making the stay pleasant for our family and guests. The entire staff was courteous and supportive throughout. Fairlie Resort truly made our wedding memorable. Highly recommended!

worst services provided. booked engagement haldi mehendi and wedding on this venue. Food was pathetic, staff was not cooperative, room service is worst they don’t care at all and it took 5-6 hours just to send water in a room. Guest got irritated because of them. Decoration vendor ruined everything, DJ was playing breakup and sad slow songs and making people bore. overall waste of lakhs of money for precious lifetime event like wedding. Rooms are worst no proper lights, ac not cooling in all rooms and when make complaints they don’t care.Not recommended.

Attended my cousin’s wedding here last weekend. The banquet hall was beautifully decorated, and the staff made sure every guest was comfortable. The food was excellent, with a variety of dishes to please everyone. Highly recommend this venue for any big event!

Recently attended an event at The Tivoli, Chattarpur, and the experience was truly impressive. The venue is stunning—spacious, elegant, and beautifully maintained—but the real highlight was the food. Every dish was absolutely delicious, with an impressive variety that catered to all tastes. The staff was equally commendable—professional, attentive, and always ready to assist with a warm smile, ensuring everything was seamless. It’s a fantastic choice for weddings and large gatherings. Highly recommended! Key Highlights: Food: Exceptional taste with a wide and impressive variety. Ambience: Elegant, well-maintained, and expansive—especially the outdoor lawns. Service: Courteous, professional, and highly attentive staff

A perfect place for a grand wedding. Located in the Chattarpur area of South Delhi, this property is a beautiful venue to host any celebration. The moment you enter, you forget the noise of the city and instantly feel the wedding vibe. The hotel has been recently renovated and offers excellent facilities. We hosted my sister’s three-day wedding here, and it truly became a celebration we will always remember. Our family came from Bangalore, and the hotel team made everything very smooth. Most arrangements were handled over phone calls, thanks to their efficient marketing team. A special thank you to Ms. Muskaan for her constant support and dedication throughout the planning. The entertainment and decoration teams arranged by the hotel were also wonderful. Ms. Priya from VD Designs created classy and budget-friendly décor that made every event look beautiful. The special effects managed by Ms. Neha and her team were spot-on and added a lovely touch. The food was delicious, and the hospitality made all our guests feel very comfortable. I would also like to mention that I was eight months pregnant during the wedding, yet everything was handled so well by these amazing ladies that I did not have to worry at all. They truly made the entire event smooth and stress-free. A big thank you to Team Tivoli for their hard work and warm hospitality. I highly recommend this property and would rate it a full 5 stars for any event or celebration.

Had my friend’s engagement in tivoli. So the experience was great. All thanks to Poonam who was very friendly and helpful. Exceptional services with top-notch hospitality. Best part is they have grand venues for all your events with delicious food. Perfect venues for all the functions under one roof.

Hotel services and food was delicious. And there is decor team Priya from VG design. The decor theme was absolutely beautiful and well executed. The color combination, detailing, and overall setup created a perfect ambience for the event. Thank you hotel then decor team also entertainment Rajiv thank you so much for make my day special.

My recent stay at The Tivoli New Delhi was exactly the relaxing escape I needed. I found the staff to be the absolute heroes of my trip. From the moment I checked in, they were so warm, attentive, and genuinely helpful—I felt like they anticipated my needs before I even had to ask! That personalized, five-star touch made the entire experience feel effortless and incredibly welcoming. I absolutely loved my room. It wasn't just big; it was wonderfully spacious and spotlessly clean (a huge win in my book!). It served as a bright, peaceful place to crash after a busy day. The hotel's amenities were lovely, too. I enjoyed the great pool and the beautifully kept grounds, which gave the whole property that serene, resort-like vibe. And definitely don't skip the food! The breakfast spread was fantastic, and I found the restaurant service to be absolutely top-notch. Now, for the one thing I had to keep in mind: the location. Since The Tivoli is nestled in Chattarpur, it was a bit of a drive from the main tourist hubs. I definitely had to factor in some extra travel time for sightseeing. But honestly, since my priorities were getting pampered with fantastic service, enjoying a quiet, beautiful hotel, and eating well, The Tivoli offered incredible value. I found it to be a truly comfortable haven for my trip.

Excellent leadership by Rakesh Ji. The hotel is professionally managed, clean, and has a very positive vibe. It’s clear that the staff is motivated under his guidance to provide top-notch service. A 5-star experience in every sense." "I had a wonderful stay at this hotel! The location is absolutely perfect—it's right in the heart of the city and close to all the major attractions, making it very convenient to get around. The staff behavior was exceptional; they were incredibly friendly, professional, and went out of their way to make me feel welcome from the moment I checked in. My room was spotless and very comfortable. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great experience!"

Terrible hospitality overall. The toilet in my room was already broken when I checked in — no prior use from my side. Basic maintenance is clearly ignored. The receptionist had a pure money mindset. On top of that, the hotel has extremely strict rules — it feels more like a hostel with wardens than a proper hotel. No sense of freedom, constant control, and zero warmth from staff. This place looks decent online, but reality is completely different. Helpful tip for travelers: If you care about comfort, honesty, and enjoying your stay freely, avoid this hotel. Definitely not worth the price.

I had a really good experience at Udnam Hotel. The ambiance is pleasant and comfortable, perfect for family as well as friends.
