Hygiene and cleanliness are well maintained throughout the hotel. Service is fast and professional, and prices are reasonable for the quality they offer. Overall, Udnam Hotel is a great place for dining and staying. I would definitely recommend it and would love to visit again.

Based on the reviews, i had booked this hotel during my visit at delhi. Execellent ambience, room is clean and provided non smoking room for me. I booked the room with breakfast and dinner. Restaurant is very neat equivalent to 5 star, delicious food is served. Babu and Ashif have taken care during my 2 days stay here. Very friendly and supportive. Recommending corporate and family to stay here.

Overall, I had a really good experience staying here. The service was highly appreciable, and the rooms were average but comfortable, and ofcourse need more maintenance. Also note that hot water have specific timing which is kind of frustrating. The breakfast was good with multiple options to choose from. Special thanks to Umesh for his excellent service. All the housekeeping and service staff were very supportive and courteous throughout the stay.

Highly, highly recommended!"

Everything is excellent, rooms are clean and hotel staff is available for help any time.

They have a tag line home away from home and I don’t think it’s a lie. It was so well decorated and everything was available. Everything you need at home. I have stayed in other home stays in south Delhi but so far this was the best. If o come back to the City again I will stay here again. It was worth every money. I had a very comfortable stay

My last stay at Divisha Homes was excellent. The rooms were clean, spacious, and very comfortable, making the stay truly relaxing. The host were very friendly, responsive, and always ready to help. The overall atmosphere felt welcoming and homely. I am very satisfied with my experience and would highly recommend Divisha Homes to anyone looking for a pleasant stay.

My stay at Divisha Homes was truly exceptional. The apartment is beautifully designed, clean, and fully equipped with all modern amenities. The front-view balcony was a perfect spot to relax and enjoy fresh air and natural light. The location is peaceful yet easily accessible, making it ideal for both short and long stays. The host was warm, attentive, and ensured every detail was taken care of, which made me feel completely at home. I highly recommend Divisha Homes to anyone looking for comfort, hospitality, and a memorable stay. I will definitely come back again!
Booked this 1bhk apartment for 3 days. Location was great. Rooms were clean. There was cleaning service every morning. Overall very satisfied with our stay. Would return for future visits.
Beautiful homestay at South Delhi property is very specious, clean and fully functional kitchen is also very attractive.

Poor and degraded service by staff. Asked for extra money during checkin and not allowed to checkout at 1230 pm. Worst hotel to stay. Drinking water bottles provided in room has been seen lying in dirt and same given to room when asked for. Poor hygiene.
liked the room and service and very budget friendly didn't expect this type of hotel comes under this budget love to visit again

We recently celebrated our wedding at Delhi Park Boulevard, and it was truly a dream come true. Our guests came from different nationalities and parts of the world, and every single one of them was amazed by the warmth, organization, and beauty of the celebration. The venue provided the perfect setting for our two-day wedding festivities, blending elegance with comfort in a way that made everyone feel special. What made the experience even more exceptional was that everything — from the design to the décor — was handled in-house. The attention to detail was outstanding. Every element was thoughtfully curated and executed flawlessly. The ambiance they created for each event was unique, vibrant, and perfectly aligned with our vision. The coordination throughout the two days was seamless. The team ensured that every function ran smoothly, allowing us and our families to truly enjoy each moment without stress. From the décor arrangements to guest management, everything was perfectly planned and delivered beyond expectations. We are deeply grateful to the entire team for making our wedding so memorable. If you are looking for a venue that offers professionalism, creativity, and a flawless execution, we highly recommend Delhi Park Boulevard.

Had an absolutely blast at Park Boulevard recently! If you’re looking for a spot in Chattarpur that actually lives up to the hype, this is the perfect place to host an event or a wedding!! The hospitality by the top management and staff here is top-notch and actually pays attention to the little things, which we really appreciated. Their in house event/ decor management team of Aayna Events is just amazing, they fully understand the details and requirements of a guest to the core & full-fill it beyond expectations. Now, let’s talk about the food: honestly, everything is delicious, you name it and it tastes yum! The whole vibe of the place is just really welcoming and well-managed. I would say if you’re planning an event or wedding and want a great place to stay/eat and host an event, definitely check this place out. Huge thumbs up team Park Boulevard and absolute special mention to Yogesh Sakhuja, Nipun Sakhuja, Rubal Sakhuja and Govind ji, you all are the best👍

We had the best experience hosting our wedding here. The venue looked stunning, the food was amazing, and everything was so well managed. All our guests had travelled from outside and they genuinely loved every bit of the celebration. We had attended two weddings here before, and that’s when Akshay and I knew this was exactly where we wanted to get married. It honestly turned out even better than we imagined!

This was my second event at this venue and quiet satisfied. Food is amazing by taste and quality both, location is a little inside, so if it is an auspicious day then because of other weddings and events it is treacherous to reach the venue, if coming from Delhi side. Rooms are decent and the venue overall is awesome.

We had the most amazing wedding celebrations at Park Boulevard, and I genuinely can’t thank their team enough for making everything so perfect and seamless. A special shoutout to Mr. Yogesh, Mr. Nipun, Ms. Alka, and Mr. Govind — from our very first discussions to the final execution, everything was handled with professionalism, warmth, and great attention to detail. The entire process was smooth and stress-free, and they were extremely accommodating with all our requests. Our guests were absolutely in awe of the décor and the food arrangements, and we received endless compliments throughout the celebrations. Our stay was also super comfortable, and the hospitality made the entire experience even more memorable. Highly recommended for anyone planning a wedding or special celebration — the Park Boulevard team truly goes above and beyond!

This establishment was clean and neat. Also, the breakfast is very delicious! Above all, the manager Jantis Kumar was very helpful especially with reservation and administration. Even though I had many requests, he was more than willing to help our team. He was informative, kind, and his mannerism was on the point. Strongly recommended!

Going to the hotel, from New Delhi airport Terminal 3 was easy. Took about 15 minutes by taxi, at 22:30 hrs Thankfully no traffic jams in the Mahipalpur main road. Location not very good, away from the main road, in a not so clean street. Rooms are very spacious, clean and well maintained. The signages are in Japanese. review_text: Hosting my sister’s wedding at this hotel turned out to be one of the biggest mistakes we made. We selected the place thinking it would deliver a smooth and pleasant stay for our guests, but the reality was the exact opposite. Right from the moment we arrived, it became clear that the hotel was nowhere near prepared to handle an event. The rooms looked neglected — dusty corners, stained linens, and broken fixtures were just the beginning. Toiletries and other basics that every hotel keeps ready were either missing or provided only after multiple follow-ups. It never felt like we were staying at a property meant for celebrations; it felt more like damage control from day one. The most frustrating part was the management, the food provided was not sufficient it was over before the guests even arrived. Instead of taking initiative and ensuring things were in place, we had to constantly remind them of every single responsibility. There was zero coordination between staff members, and we were the ones juggling between functions and hotel issues, which completely ruined the experience. Weddings are emotional and memorable occasions, and a hotel hosting one should understand that. Unfortunately, this place showed no sense of accountability or ownership. What should have been a joyful time for the entire family turned into unnecessary stress and disappointment because of the hotel’s inefficiency. If you are planning an important family event, I would strongly suggest choosing another venue. This hotel failed us when it mattered the most.

hotel_name: Oyo Kcg Hotels Near Chhatarpur Metro Station
review_text: If chaos had an address, OYO KCG Hotel would proudly claim the pin code We stayed here for three days for a wedding, and honestly, by the end of it, we were convinced the entire place was running a social experiment on how much incompetence a group of people can tolerate. Food: Let’s start with the “creative cuisine.” Rajma without rajma - bold. Dahi vada without vada - avant-garde. Chicken biryani without chicken - truly revolutionary. If only they had mentioned that the theme was “imaginary food,” we would’ve adjusted our expectations accordingly. And the best part? Whatever wasn’t missing was late. Always. To top it off, many guests ended up with stomach issues post-wedding - a memory none of us asked for. 🛏️ Rooms & Stay: The rooms were large, but that’s where the compliments end. From clogged bathrooms to random electricity failures, it felt like the hotel was actively trying to recreate a survival reality show. You don’t just *stay* here — you *endure* it. 👎 Staff & Service: The staff was the cherry on top of this disaster cake. Unprofessional, evasive, and Olympic-level experts in passing responsibility. Need coffee during the wedding event? After three hours of “machine not working,” “please ask that person,” and “we’re looking into it,” you either give up or grow old waiting or even make it yourself 🎪 Event Management: The wedding was scheduled for 7 PM, but clearly, time runs on a different planet here. The stage wasn’t ready until 8 PM. And the manager, Sheetal? Possibly the most unhelpful person in the entire establishment. Rude, dismissive, and allergic to basic courtesy. Every request was treated like we were asking for a miracle. 💡 Bonus Observation: After this experience, it’s hard not to question the glowing reviews online. Because honestly, no person who has actually lived through what we did would willingly give this place even *one* star. The positivity online feels… suspiciously manufactured. --- In summary: If you’re planning a wedding, a holiday, or even a last-minute escape from daily life — do yourself a favor and look elsewhere. This hotel will give you stories, yes… but mostly the kind you’d rather forget.

We were a group of friends from Delhi NCR looking for a quick getaway — something not too far but still giving us a sense of being away from the city. Based on the good reviews and photos, we decided to stay at Sukoon Farms. Positives: • The farmhouse was clean and well-maintained. • The caretakers were friendly and helpful. • The kitchen was accessible with utensils available, which made things convenient. • The pool table was a nice addition to the common hangout space. However, there were some drawbacks: • The design of the common area wasn’t ideal for group gatherings. The sitting area felt closed off, almost like being at home, with no view of the lush green lawn. • The dining table was on the ground floor, away from where we usually gathered, making it slightly inconvenient. • The balcony with a view of the lawn was on the opposite side and not connected to the main common area. Since our plan was to spend most of the time together as a group, these structural aspects made the experience less refreshing than we had hoped. It didn’t provide the sense of openness and change in scenery that we were looking for in a farmhouse stay. This is purely feedback on the property’s design and not on the caretakers or the owner, who were cordial. It would have been much better if the farmhouse had glass doors or large windows opening to the lawn, giving a more open and connected feel. Lastly, given the amenities and the way the property is structured, the charges felt quite high. In our opinion, it wasn’t value for money. Overall: Great staff and cleanliness, but the property’s design and pricing did not meet our expectations.

review_text: Our stay at Taj Surajkund Resort & Spa was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment we arrived, the warmth and professionalism of the staff made us feel genuinely welcomed. The hospitality here truly reflects the signature Taj standard thoughtful, attentive, and effortlessly gracious. The property itself exudes a royal and serene ambiance, blending elegant architecture with lush surroundings. Every corner of the resort gives you a sense of calm luxury, making it a perfect escape from the city while still feeling grand and refined. From flavorful Indian delicacies to beautifully crafted continental dishes, the variety and quality were remarkable. Each meal felt like a celebration of taste, with fresh ingredients and impeccable presentation. What truly elevates the experience is the attention to detail whether it's the courteous staff, the elegant setting, or the thoughtfully curated dining options. hotel_name: Taj Surajkund Resort & Spa, Delhi Ncr
review_text: Exceptional Hospitality at Taj Surajkund Resort & Spa, Our experience at Taj Surajkund Resort & Spa, Faridabad. Our experience at Taj Surajkund Resort & Spa, Faridabad was truly exceptional. From the moment we arrived, the warmth and professionalism shown by the doorman set the perfect tone for our stay. Every team member—from Front Office and Housekeeping to the Restaurant FOH, BOH culinary team, and the In-Room Dining kitchen—worked seamlessly to deliver outstanding hospitality. A special mention to Ayush Sethi, followed by Neeraj, Devesh, Navraj, Rudra, Vikram, Pranami, Rashami, Silky, and Sneh, whose dedication, attentiveness, and genuine care made our experience truly memorable. Each of them went above and beyond to ensure comfort, satisfaction, and a personalised touch throughout our stay. We were especially touched by the thoughtful gestures that made our family stay so special—a beautiful complimentary cake for our daughter’s birthday, a delightful pottery session, a safe and engaging kids’ playing area, and a lovely complimentary high tea in the evening at the lawn. Special appreciation to the In-Room Dining kitchen team for kindly preparing fresh baby food on request, and to the Housekeeping team for maintaining impeccable cleanliness and comfort throughout our stay. The dining experience was outstanding, especially the amazing breakfast buffet with a fulfilling and well-curated variety, offering something for everyone and setting the perfect start to each day. The consistency, passion, and teamwork across all departments truly reflect the timeless Taj ethos. Dinner buffet needs little improvement and more options compared to breakfast menu. Heartfelt thanks to everyone in each department of the hotel for creating such a warm, memorable, and enriching experience. Taj Surajkund truly sets a benchmark for luxury hospitality, and we look forward to returning again soon.

review_text: We recently stayed for two days at Taj Surajkund, and the experience was truly exceptional. Having visited the property barely six months ago, the transformation was striking. Everything appeared refreshed and elevated the dining locations, décor, mannerisms of the staff, and even the underlying themes had evolved beautifully. What impressed us most was the seamless coordination between management and the working team. It was evident that people were performing with commitment and pride, without the need for constant supervision. There was a distinct sense of calm, peace, and tranquility reflected in every corner from the ambience to the smallest details in décor. You lead from the front, and it shows clearly in the spirit and standards of the entire team. Thank you for creating such a memorable and heartwarming experience. Please keep up the excellent work.

review_text: The stay itself was fine, but my check-in experience was frustrating. I had booked two nights, anticipating my early morning arrival by bus, to avoid inconveniencing the staff with an early check-in request. Eventually, they allowed me to check in for the following night, but by then, I had wasted hours on calls and experienced unnecessary stress. The room itself was decent for the price. The AC worked well, and essentials like a toothbrush were available on request. Despite the reasonable price and proximity to Sector 29, the morning check-in ordeal left a lasting negative impression.

hotel_name: Aliste Hotels, Millenium City Centre Gurugram
review_text: My stay at Aliste was truly a wonderful experience. The location is perfect, just a couple of minutes’ walk from the metro station. The room was spacious and thoughtfully designed. There was a separate sofa - table setup, along with a dedicated work desk and chair, which made it easy to relax as well as get some work done. What I appreciated the most was a mini bed-style platform where I could throw my luggage and stuff - a small detail, but very useful. The room also had a locker, fridge and a smart TV which further enhanced the overall experience. The washroom was clean and efficient; the only small suggestion would be to add a glass partition in the shower area to prevent water from spreading. Other than that, everything was excellent. One more thing I loved was the small open cafe-style seating area at the entrance. It has a very nice ambience - perfect for sitting and relaxing - and they even screened live cricket match there. The service deserves special mention. The staff were polite, courteous, and always ready to help. They also provide complimentary on-demand utilities like a hair dryer, clothes iron, and other basic amenities. Dining was another highlight. The in-house restaurant, Shatranj, serves delicious food. The complimentary breakfast had a good variety, including continental options, fruits & potatoes, some Indian dishes, and beverages. Lunch and dinner were equally tasty and were served in generous portions. One of the biggest conveniences for me was the check-in and check-out timings, which were not very rigid, which made my stay completely stress-free. Overall, it was an excellent experience, and I would happily recommend staying at Aliste!

Even with navigation, I had to ask multiple people to finally locate the place. A well-known hotel should have better signage and visibility to make it easier for guests. Rooms – Below Expectations The rooms were far from what I expected. The wallpapers were peeling off, making the entire space look unkempt. The bed was not properly cleaned, and the furniture looked like something out of an old, abandoned motel. The overall ambience of the room felt cheap, and I was quite uncomfortable throughout my stay. For the price paid, I expected at least basic cleanliness and decent furnishings, but this was clearly not the case. Service – Poor Assistance One of the most frustrating parts of my stay was the lack of good service. It was incredibly difficult to get any assistance from the staff. Whether it was requesting basic amenities or asking for help, the response was either delayed or completely ignored. A hotel should always prioritize hospitality, but it seemed like customer satisfaction was the least of their concerns. Food – Tasteless and Overpriced If the stay and service were bad, the food was even worse. The meals were completely lacking in taste and felt bland and uninspired. To make things worse, the prices were unreasonably high for the poor quality of food being served. I expected at least a decent dining experience, but this was another area where Rallkmas failed terribly.

The main society gate closes after 10:30 PM, so after that time, use Gate No. 2, opposite Sahara Mall. I recently stayed at Vertu Hotel in Mahipalpur, and my experience was genuinely pleasant. Rooms: The rooms were clean, comfortable, and better maintained compared to many nearby properties. The interiors felt modern, tidy, and well-organised. The bed was comfortable, and overall room quality was impressive for the price. Cleanliness: This was one of the biggest positives. The room, washroom, and linens were all neat and fresh. The hotel clearly pays attention to cleanliness, which made the stay comfortable. Service: The staff were polite, quick to assist, and always helpful — from check-in to room service. They responded promptly when needed and made the stay smooth. Food: The in-room dining was decent and served on time. Breakfast options were simple but good enough for a short stay. Location: Excellent connectivity — the hotel is in the same premises as several other hotels like Viva Palace, but Vertu stands out with better upkeep and overall experience.

I think -10 rating should be there I booked the Park Tree Hotel solely for its advertised proximity to IGI Airport, hoping for a smooth and convenient overnight transit. What I received was one of the most frustrating and unprofessional hotel experiences I have ever encountered. The location is the only thing this hotel has going for it, and it absolutely does not make up for the abysmal staff service and management. The problems began immediately upon arrival. The front desk staff was shockingly unhelpful and borderline rude. Despite arriving well past the designated check-in time, my room was not ready, forcing a lengthy, unacceptable wait in a lobby where the staff seemed more interested in chatting amongst themselves or staring at their phones than attending to waiting guests. There was zero sense of urgency or courtesy, and every interaction felt like an inconvenience to them. This pattern of poor service continued throughout the stay. Simple requests, such as needing an extra towel, required multiple phone calls and over an hour to fulfill. The in-room dining service was slow, and the staff member delivering the food was unresponsive and clearly disgruntled. Management appears to be entirely absent, allowing a culture of neglect and disregard for basic customer hospitality to fester among the team. The room itself was poorly maintained—the advertised pictures were completely misleading. The AC was barely functional, and there were noticeable cleanliness issues that should have been addressed before check-in. This lack of attention to detail, from the room maintenance to the rude staff, signals a fundamental failure in the hotel's operations. I strongly urge fellow travelers to look elsewhere. The slight convenience of being close to the airport is completely negated by the stress and poor treatment you will receive here. Do not waste your money or your time on this place; you deserve a comfortable and respected stay, which the Park Tree Hotel near IGI Airport absolutely fails to provide.

hotel_name: Oyo Hotel Metro Tower Near Ambience Mall
review_text: Good, only if you knew which rooms to ask for (room numbers below) This is a review for the OYO 24947 Hotel Metro Tower. If this isn't the place, please get back and I will remove this review. But if this is the place, here goes. Stayed here in October, 2015 on two occassions. The only reason I give a 4 star review is because of the hospitality, particularly of Sumit at the front desk and the boys of the hotel. As mentioned in the title if you knew which rooms to ask for, staying here is bang for the buck. We checked 4 rooms, one on the first floor (that had a dirty toilet), a cigarette-smelly room on the second floor but finally took one on the third floor, room No.304. This one was clean and neat. We were happy we were allowed to choose in this fashion. Room No. 302, also on the third floor is even superior and it is ideal for three people as it is larger and comes with a study area too. The other plus is the close proximity to the Domestic Airport, just a 15 to 20 minutes drive. Also, you can order food to your room and the quality is pretty decent though the price was a bit on the higher side. Breakfast is included in the day's fare but we didn't have time to sample it. The gripes are the traffic noise outside from the roads, the pollution (so make sure you keep your windows closed) and the exorbitant taxi fare to the airport. Using OLA cab cost us half of what the hotel was charging us. Wifi is slow too. There are no elevators (lifts) to the floors, and so if you are carrying a lot of luggage, make sure you get help. Hot water is supplied only on request. For the third floor room it was easy as turning a tap on but for the lower floors we were told that hot water had to be delivered. We opted for this hotel because we were staying for just a little over half a day. If your stay is longer I would recommend considering other hotels.

review_text: Review for Hotel Trendy Residency, Chhatarpur I stayed at Hotel Trendy Residency recently, and unfortunately, my experience was extremely disappointing. At check-in(19th and 20th November 2026), I was charged ₹1500 per night for two nights (₹3000 total), and additional transaction fees were added for card payment. Later, I discovered that the actual online prices for the same rooms range between ₹700–₹1000 per night. This was the first sign of overcharging and lack of transparency. The room conditions were far below acceptable standards. There was no water supply, the telephone inside the room did not work, the TV was non-functional, and despite being promised complimentary drinking water, none was provided. The mobile network signal inside the room was almost nonexistent, and their Wi-Fi was extremely slow and practically unusable. Throughout the stay, there was no proper assistance from the staff regarding any of these issues. At checkout, I explained everything to the same staff member who handled my booking (Truecaller shows his name as Gopal Gupta). Instead of addressing the problems, he behaved in an unprofessional manner, using inappropriate and abusive language. When I recorded the call, he suddenly changed his tone, which shows a complete lack of responsibility and integrity. Overall, this has been one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve ever had. The service quality, staff behaviour, and basic facilities were extremely poor. I do not recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a comfortable or professional stay.

review_text: We chose this hotel after carefully checking its Google profile. But the moment we stepped inside the room, that hope broke. There was a strange, suffocating smell as soon as the door opened. The bedsheet had visible stains and looked carelessly spread, as if it hadn’t been changed properly. I didn’t even feel comfortable sitting on the bed, let alone sleeping on it. The walls were dirty with marks and peeling paint, giving the room a neglected and depressing feeling. The washroom was the most upsetting part. It smelled bad, the floor had stains, and the sink was unclean. It didn’t feel hygienic or safe. Instead of feeling relaxed after a long journey, we felt stressed and disturbed. When we tried to speak to the staff, there was no empathy — just excuses. It honestly felt like the Google profile was fake or completely misleading. The reality was the opposite of what was shown online. This wasn’t just a bad stay; it felt like our trust was broken. We left feeling disappointed, uncomfortable, and emotionally drained.

Booked a room through booking.com. Called and exchanged emails multiple times to inform that we would be arriving early. We reached after a hectic 11 hour bus ride. 1. The welcome was cold. The supervisor and other personnels didn't even have smiles on their faces. 2. At check in, the supervisor tried to charge us extra 500 rs. because of early check in. On showing him the previous email communication, where it clearly stated that there'll be no extra charge for early check in(we arrived at 8 a.m.), he started arguing that he can't see any email from his end. When I started getting angry, and mentioned giving a bad review, he suddenly changed his tune and started saying that he won't charge the extra money. 3. By this time I had already lost faith in this establishment and demanded to see the room before paying. Just as I was going to check out the room, my mother asked about the breakfast that was included in the price, and the supervisor (who claimed he was the manager as well as the supervisor, when asked to see the manager) said that we would only get breakfast the next day. When we mentioned that we can't have breakfast the next day, as we would be leaving early for the airport, and wanted to use the included breakfast perk on the arrival day, he again refused. This was the last straw. We immediately took a decision and left from there. We quickly called a different hotel, and came here. I would just like to add that we all hear about scams where various establishments pay people to give false reviews. This has become rampant now. An important lesson was reiterated today. We mustn’t try out places with 4+ ratings, unless the number of ratings is above 1500- 2000 people.

review_text: We had a very pleasant stay at the hotel. The rooms were clean, spacious, and well maintained. The staff was polite, helpful, and always ready to assist. review_text: Our stay at the hotel was excellent from start to finish. We also really enjoyed the food: high quality, well presented, and consistently good. A highlight of our stay was a deep tissue massage with Anju. She took the time to understand where I was sore and worked with precision and confidence, applying firm, targeted pressure that provided real relief. It was not just relaxing. More than that, it was genuinely therapeutic. I left feeling significantly better and would highly recommend her. She continued to provide excellent suggestions after the massage to ensure the benefits of the treatment would last longer.

review_text: I recently stayed at Radisson Blu Hotel, Mahipalpur (near Delhi Airport) and it was truly a wonderful experience. From the moment we arrived, everything was handled professionally and smoothly. A special thanks to Shivani and Suraj for their exceptional hospitality. They were extremely polite, attentive, and always ready to help with a smile. Their warm and welcoming attitude really made our stay extra comfortable and memorable. The rooms were clean, spacious, and well-maintained. The ambience of the hotel is elegant, and the overall service standards are impressive. The food was delicious, and the staff ensured that every small detail was taken care of. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Delhi, especially if you’re looking for comfort and top-notch service near the airport. Looking forward to staying here again!

I had a very disappointing experience at this hotel. The rooms are smaller than usual, although the general standard is acceptable. However, the bed in my original room was terrible. It was extremely hard, and I could literally feel the metal springs through the mattress. For a room costing 4,500 INR per night, this is completely unacceptable. When I went to the reception to complain, they first told me the hotel was fully booked. I explained that charging that amount for a room with a broken bed was not reasonable. After some discussion, they eventually assigned me a new room with a proper bed. The hotel also advertises air conditioning in the rooms. This was not the case. The rooms was very hot. When I asked about the AC, I was first told it was turned off because it was winter season. Later, when I asked them to turn it on, I was told it was broken. I had really hoped for a good night’s sleep, especially since I had a flight back to Europe the next morning. Unfortunately, this was difficult due to the heat, and noice from the traffic outside. Additionally, the beds are shorter than normal. Being slightly taller than average, my feet were hanging off the end of the bed. The restaurant experience was even worse. It is located in the basement and felt dirty and poorly ventilated, with a stale and unpleasant smell. There were no other guests dining at the time, which made us somewhat skeptical, but we decided to give it a try. We ordered tandoori chicken tikka (dry, without gravy) and dal. When the food arrived, the chicken did not look as it normally does. There was visible oil and sauce around the pieces, despite requesting it dry. After tasting it, I was shocked — the chicken was cold, although fully cooked. This suggested that it had been prepared earlier and reheated. From a food safety perspective, I did not feel comfortable eating it. At first, the staff tried to convince us to order something else from the menu, but after this experience I did not feel confident about how the rest of the food was prepared. Eventually, the manager came and asked what the issue was. I explained the situation, and he apologized and told us we would not have to pay for the food. However, we were still charged for the drinks, even though we had ordered them to accompany the meal and did not finish them. In the end, we left and went somewhere else for dinner. Overall, this was a very disappointing stay. Based on my experience, I would not recommend this hotel.

Qutub Residency is honestly one of the better budget-friendly stays you can find in this part of Delhi. The location is convenient, especially if you want quick access to Qutub Minar and nearby areas. For short stays, it works perfectly because it’s simple, clean, and has all the basic amenities you would expect. One thing I’d recommend is to book online instead of walking in. The online prices are usually lower and more consistent, whereas walk-in rates can sometimes be higher. If you check ahead, you can save a decent amount, making it even more value-for-money. Rooms are decent in size, well-maintained, and come with the promised amenities — AC, Wi-Fi, clean washrooms, and proper bedding. It’s nothing luxurious, but it delivers exactly what it claims, which is rare for budget properties. The staff are cooperative and try their best to make things comfortable, and that’s always a plus. For travelers who just need a place to rest in between exploring the city, this is a great pick. It’s not overloaded with unnecessary hype or hidden costs, and that makes it reliable. Overall, I’d say Qutub Residency is one of the best budget stays in the area. Affordable, practical, and exactly as advertised. If you’re in Delhi for a short trip, business visit, or just passing through and need a clean and safe place, this is definitely a good choice.

I stayed at King's Court Hotel during my time in Delhi for my Convocation, and despite it being a last-minute booking, this place was one of the best places I stayed. The location was very close to the Panchsheel Park Metro station (roughly 400 metres), which made it very convenient for travel. I believe there was renovation going on at the front of the hotel during my visit, but it wasn't exactly a hurdle because the entrance was still easily accessible, and there was a side entrance too. Similarly, despite not having an elevator, the staff was kind enough to carry my luggage to the third floor and offered me a brief stay in one of their suites until my room (Deluxe) was ready for check-in. They also offered complimentary tea and coffee. The room was also pretty neat and tidy, including the washroom, so there are no complaints per se. Besides, the manager and staff in general were extremely polite and catered to every one of our requirements. I arrived pretty early (around 6 a.m.) and checked out at an unusually early hour (around 4 a.m.) due to my flight timings, and the manager ensured there were no hurdles at check-in or check-out. They truly went above and beyond, which is what struck me the most, because at a time when hotel reviews are filled with bad experiences, this one definitely does everything it can to keep those staying happy. I highly recommend this place to anyone travelling to Delhi, as it is one of the best places to stay without pinching your pocket.

The Grand Hotel in Delhi is easily the worst five-star hotel I have ever stayed at. Below are the incidents that contributed to this sentiment: 1. The hotel room air conditioning did not work. This was not limited to our room, as I heard multiple guests complain about the same issue. The rooms were muggy and difficult to breathe in, and the staff did not take action to fix the problem unless guests created a scene at the front desk. 2. The hotel had two elevators, one of which was broken for the entire duration of my six-week stay. I had to take the stairs to and from the fourth floor multiple times a day, and the hotel made no apparent effort to repair the elevator. 3. The toilet flushes did not function properly. 4. Housekeeping did not clean rooms thoroughly, failed to restock toiletries, and frequently ignored the “Do Not Disturb” sign. 5. Hotel staff were extremely slow in completing requests. I needed an extra bed placed in a room, but despite calling four times, I ultimately had to go downstairs and insist on action before my parents confirmed the bed had been delivered. I also requested assistance with luggage, but no one arrived, so I handled it myself. These are just two examples among many. 6. The room phones on the entire fourth floor did not work. 7. We requested air purifiers for the room; however, broken units were delivered, and the staff did not replace or repair them. 8. The staff were incredibly rude. When I went downstairs to report issues, staff members looked at guests dismissively and appeared to treat hospitality concerns as a joke. 9. Nearly every time I passed through the lobby, another guest was arguing with staff about a complaint. This seemed commonplace, and staff appeared trained to dismiss issues by offering a free meal or coffee rather than addressing root problems. 10. There was a clear lack of internal communication among staff. When requesting a manager, I had to spend significant time re-explaining the issue. After checking out of one room, the hotel attempted to charge me for an additional night because staff had not communicated internally that my family had consolidated into one room after refusing to pay for two.

review_text: I stayed here for 3 nights while I was on business, and was in a King-size bedroom on a higher floor. Imagine being in a so-called 5 star paying 35k per night and they have to check for Rs. 2 bandaid!! Also, the decorative pillows were not at all cleaned. I found some white spots on them and didn't use it at all. When I arrived in the room, iron box was missing and I had to call up and ask for it. I ordered for room service from the In-room Dining. It was better than average, but could have been better. I was a bit surprised to see the limited items in IRD menu. However, I appreciate that someone from Chaobella restaurant called up, sent me the menu and said they can room deliver - which they did. The IRD folks, in one instance, were a bit careless about the bill. Even though I had placed a hold for it on my card during checkin, they said it was direct payment and had sent card machine. I had to insist them on checking with the front desk and resolve it. I utilized the spa for a massage. It was hygienic and well maintained. The therapist also gave a good massage. The cost was also reasonable. I appreciate the experience there. Overall, it was the experience of a 3 star hotel for me but with a 5 star price. So if the room rates match that of a 3 star hotel, go for it. It's definitely not worth a 5 star tag or a 5 star cost

⭐☆☆☆☆ I had one of the worst experiences staying at Hotel Rampal Palace. The condition of the property is far below acceptable standards. Room & Cleanliness: The room allotted was in a very bad state. The bedsheets were dirty, torn, and clearly not changed for new guests. All the linen looked unhygienic, and the towels provided were old, rough, and in extremely poor condition. The room also had a strong foul smell, and despite raising the issue with reception, no proper solution was given. They just sent a housekeeping boy with a fragrance spray, which only masked the odor for a few minutes instead of fixing the root problem. Hygiene & Maintenance: The hotel shows no sense of cleanliness or hygiene. Dust and dirt were visible in corners, the washroom was not properly cleaned, and basic maintenance seemed completely ignored. Even outside the hotel, the surroundings were dirty and unkempt, creating a very unpleasant atmosphere before even stepping inside. Staff Behavior: The reception staff was unhelpful and unfriendly. Rather than showing concern for guest comfort, they almost ignored my complaints. The attitude towards guests felt careless and unprofessional, which made the overall stay even worse. Location & Clientele: Most of the hotel’s clientele is linked to Apollo Hospital, which makes hygiene and cleanliness even more important. Patients and their families often stay here, and one would expect the property to maintain the highest standards of hygiene. Unfortunately, that is not the case. The lack of proper care and cleanliness is shocking, especially considering the type of guests who rely on this hotel. Overall Experience: This hotel fails to meet even the most basic standards of hospitality. Poor hygiene, lack of proper maintenance, unclean surroundings, and rude staff make it a place I would never recommend. Guests deserve respect, cleanliness, and comfort—unfortunately, Hotel Rampal Palace provides none of these. Very bad experience overall.

hotel_name: Radisson Blu Hotel, New Delhi Dwarka
review_text: I recently stayed at Radisson Blu Dwarka, and unfortunately, it did not live up to the brand’s reputation or the premium price point. While the property looks grand, the experience was marred by poor maintenance and sub-par dining. The Issues: Dining Disappointment: As someone from South India, I found the breakfast spread quite a letdown. The chutneys were poorly prepared and lacked any authentic taste. Even the basics were off—the omelette served to me was completely bland and lacked salt. Room Maintenance: The room felt neglected. The bathroom taps were loose and practically coming out of the wall. Lack of Instructions: There were no clear instructions on how to operate the bathtub/hand shower, which led to unnecessary frustration during what should have been a relaxing stay. The Silver Lining: The only highlight of the stay was the quality of the toiletries, which were excellent. Verdict: Overall, the service and maintenance are not up to the standards one expects from a Radisson property. For the price paid, guests deserve better attention to detail in both the kitchen and room upkeep. I hope the management looks into these basic snags.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express New Delhi Int'L Airport T3
review_text: Our stay at Holiday Inn Express New Delhi Airport Terminal 3 was truly wonderful and exceeded all our expectations. From the very first moment, we felt welcomed, comfortable, and genuinely cared for. The location is incredibly convenient for travelers, especially after a long flight, and the hotel itself is spotless, modern, and very well organized. The rooms were quiet, cozy, and perfectly prepared, allowing us to rest and recharge in complete comfort. What made our experience truly special, however, was the exceptional kindness of the staff. We would especially like to express our heartfelt gratitude to Deepak, the waiter at the restaurant. He was one of the kindest and most attentive people we met during our trip. Always smiling, polite, and thoughtful, he made sure we felt comfortable at every moment. His warm attitude and genuine care turned every meal into a lovely experience. It’s rare to meet someone who serves not just with professionalism, but with heart. Thank you to the entire team for your hospitality and for creating such a positive and memorable stay. We will always remember your kindness and look forward to coming back again.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express New Delhi Int'L Airport T3
review_text: This is an amazing experience - its like a secret hotel. The check in was tricky to find for us - it is located with the car hire desks in the domestic terminal and you cant go to the hotel on your own. You need to be taken there by airport staff - you cant access it directly. Your luggage goes through security. Dont book the international section if you are not able to check your international bags before you check into the hotel- we had to use the domestic section for this reason. Before you can be taken up, all your bags go through security check and scan. The loft you go up in to the hotel is very small, it basically takes one luggage trolley plus 2 people. You get 2 free bottles of water in the room. Its in a part of the airport which is administrative- there were no windows in the room we stayed in but we were not bothered. There is an office and some kind of relaxation zone but we just wanted to go to sleep. The beds are comfortable , you get a shower room with shampoo and shower gel. This was best way to arrive for 3am check in and we were very grateful to them for looking after us. I would say it takes approx 45 mins to get to the hotel after your flight has landed.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express New Delhi Int'L Airport T3
review_text: DO NOT BOOK FOR A STAY AT THIS HOTEL. YOU WILL NOT GET A REFUND. The hotel will not allow you check in; even though, you have paid for the hotel. Let's say that you book a stay depart from Terminal 3 and the Airline change the departure to Terminal 2. The hotel requires you must depart from T3. review_text: This hotel is not worth your time or money, especially if you’re coming from Europe and have basic expectations around transparency and cleanliness. When the clothes were returned-over an hour late-the price suddenly became 60 rupees per item. The same thing happened with airport transport: the evening before, we were told the taxi would cost 600 rupees total. In the morning, that turned into 600 rupees per person. To make it worse, they simply ordered an Uber, which we later saw would have cost around 300 rupees if booked directly. The rooms were another major issue. There were no windows, a strong unpleasant smell, and visible mold. The shower head wasn’t working, and the carpets, decorative pillows, and blankets were clearly dirty. The only positive was the breakfast, which was tasty- but even that was poorly managed. Thats the only reason for 2 starts vs 1. Breakfast is supposedly served until 10:30, yet when we came at 10:00 on our second day, they were not serving anything. Overall, the experience felt misleading and poorly maintained. I would not recommend staying here.

Final Verdict: If you need a quiet, spacious place to sleep near Yashobhoomi or the airport without the highway noise, this is a solid choice. The property has a classic, PSU-era hotel feel — functional rather than luxurious, and very much like a classic airport hotel, which aligns with its role as a legacy airport property. Overall, it’s a decent and comfortable choice for hosting large gatherings. The service was generally good and the food tasted nice. There were a few moments when plates and food took time to be replenished, but otherwise the arrangements were managed fairly well.

The oldest airport hotel managed by govt. And you can feel so when you arrive there. It's not at all visible form the road. No sign boards. Only Google can take you there. Lobby is big and beautiful but not well maintained. Rooms are very basic. Food also very average kind. There are four lifts out of which only one was working. That too was stuck for 20 minutes with guests inside. Not a good option.

DONT COME!! So my friend booked me this place since I had to stay one day in Delhi and we thought it would be good since it is close to the airport. It was even hard to get there from the airport, easiest was to get a cab from the airport again. After reaching at around 12:30, they gave me a room. It was nice that they let me in earlier, but I didn’t want to stay one second longer when I see the room. There were roaches, purgent smell and very old carpet. Bedsheets were also not clean. Elevators are not running and the room electricity is broken. So i asked for another room. It was renovated and acceptable in terms of cleanliness, but I would definitely not come again. The service was okay, when you talk to them they usually help, but you have to request it. Also the whole hotel is rundown and far away from the pictures advertised with. Unfortunately, i was so in rage that i didn’t take pics of the 1st room. So overall, i would definitely stay away and try another place, even though in the end the stay was acceptable after putting in the effort as a guest.

Worst Hotel Experience – Avoid at All Costs My stay at Centaur Hotel, New Delhi Airport was absolutely horrible and one of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had. This property is completely mismanaged and shockingly poorly maintained. The rooms were dirty, outdated, and unhygienic. Basic facilities were either broken or not working, and housekeeping standards were unacceptable. The bathrooms were in terrible condition and clearly not cleaned properly before check-in. The staff was unhelpful, indifferent, and extremely unprofessional. Despite multiple complaints, no action was taken to resolve the issues. Customer service here is practically non-existent. Calling this an “airport hotel” is misleading. Instead of comfort and convenience, this hotel offers frustration, discomfort, and complete disregard for guests. The stay was absolutely not worth the price and felt like a total waste of money. I strongly warn travelers to stay away from this hotel. If you value cleanliness, basic hospitality, and peace of mind, do not book Centaur Hotel. There are many better and safer options nearby.

The rooms at Hotel Earth were very poorly maintained. The room was not cleaned properly, with dirty pillows and an unwashed bedsheet. The air conditioner and bathroom heater were not working, there was leakage from the bathroom roof, and the taps were faulty. When I complained, the staff said they could not fix the issues due to a lack of technicians, which was very irresponsible. Considering the price paid, this hotel provided extremely poor service and a disappointing experience.

Horrible hotel, filthy Sheet, they should introduce -ve rating for this. Not suitable for humans. Feels like insects live in there. No one should book this hotel. Tooo Spicy food. Worst experience in my life. Even a hut is better then this.......

Don't get deceived by the images. Its in the worst condition you can ever imagine. The bedsheets stinked & were dirty. Flush wasn't working & the bathroom was utterly disgusting. Please save your money & ignore this hotel.

hotel_name: Hotel Mayda Inn- A Boutique Hotel By Mayda Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.
review_text: The room is good and very spacious, in fact I have stayed in the past here without any issues. But in my recent experience I had an uncomfortable stay with cockroaches all around the room and even though this was conveyed to the staff nothing was done.In addition to it the kettle was rusted. The only thing good about the hotel is the price and the space. If they could sort the pests the room is really good.

hotel_name: Hotel Mayda Inn- A Boutique Hotel By Mayda Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.
review_text: A true 5-star experience that exceeded all expectations! ​From the moment we checked in, our stay at HOTEL MAYDA PRIME Near Delhi Airport was simply awesome. This hotel is a fantastic choice for anyone seeking luxury, convenience, and impeccable service near the airport. ​🍽️ The Culinary Delight (Good Food Serving in Room) ​The highlight of our stay was the absolutely delicious food and the excellent in-room dining service. ​Gourmet In-Room Dining: The menu offered a wonderful variety of cuisines, and every dish we ordered for room service was delivered promptly, piping hot, and beautifully presented. It was a genuine pleasure to enjoy restaurant-quality meals in the comfort of our own room. ​Quality and Taste: The ingredients were fresh, and the flavors were outstanding. They truly went above and beyond to cater to our preferences, making every meal a memorable part of our trip. ​ 🛌 Awesome Stay: Comfort, Cleanliness, and Service ​The overall stay was nothing short of awesome, thanks to the high standards of the property and the dedicated staff. ​Comfortable & Clean Rooms: Our room was spacious, immaculately clean, and featured premium bedding that guaranteed a restful night's sleep. The modern amenities and quiet ambiance provided a perfect retreat from the city's hustle. ​Impeccable Service: The staff were polite, attentive, and incredibly helpful throughout our stay. Their efficiency and warm hospitality made us feel truly valued as guests. From check-in to check-out, every request was handled with professionalism and a genuine smile. ​Location: Being so close to the Delhi Airport (IGI) made our travel logistics stress-free and convenient. ​In summary, if you are looking for an airport hotel that delivers a stellar experience with fantastic, high-quality food served right to your room, look no further than Hotel Mayda Prime. Highly, highly recommended!

hotel_name: Hotel Mayda Inn- A Boutique Hotel By Mayda Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.
review_text: Such a disgusting place. The hotel is not clean at all, especially the rooms. The bed sheets were not washed properly, and there were yellow stain marks all over the blankets. I didn’t feel comfortable sleeping on the bed. On top of that, there were no heaters, and it was extremely cold. I would not recommend this place to anyone.

hotel_name: Hotel Mayda Inn- A Boutique Hotel By Mayda Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.
review_text: Stayed here with my family at the end of Jan, 2026. The room was quite dirty, could feel debris on the floor when we walked. The mattresses were very old and brown, the bedding had a stale smell. You could tell the room was cleaned in a hurry. Wallpaper was peeling above the headboard. You can tell the rooms need mantenace. The staff was kind, and breakfast in the morning was tasty however not a lot of options.

hotel_name: Hotel Mayda Inn- A Boutique Hotel By Mayda Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.
review_text: I stayed a month in that hotel and the staff are very helpful as well as managers thank to Ali,i Tanya, and Surya who always made sure we had everything we need and made our stay memorable we cant thank you enough

hotel_name: Hotel Pearl Mahipalpur Delhi Airport @ 05 Minutes Walk To Aero City Metro Station
review_text: Staying at Hotel Pearl was a comfortable and convenient experience, especially if you’re looking for a stay close to the airport. The location is a big advantage easily accessible and well-connected, making it ideal for short business trips or layovers. The rooms were neat, well-maintained, and equipped with basic amenities needed for a smooth stay. The bed was comfortable, and housekeeping ensured cleanliness was maintained. While the property isn’t overly luxurious, it offers decent comfort for the price point. The staff was polite and cooperative, assisting with check-in and any small requests promptly. Service felt straightforward and hassle-free, which is important when you’re traveling and just want things to be easy. Overall, Hotel Pearl in Mahipalpur is a practical and budget-friendly option for travelers looking for a clean, accessible place to stay near Delhi Airport.

hotel_name: Hotel Pearl Mahipalpur Delhi Airport @ 05 Minutes Walk To Aero City Metro Station
review_text: I have been here on a business trip and stayed for 5 days in Novemeber 2025. The property is inside of the main road and is very peaceful and clam. Rooms and wash rooms are clean and neat. I had a pleasant stay with the support of Mr. Kapil the front desk team and other staff. Complimentary breakfast was good and food is delicious. This is a very good choice that we made to be here for a week.

hotel_name: Hotel Pearl Mahipalpur Delhi Airport @ 05 Minutes Walk To Aero City Metro Station
review_text: Very good experience at Hotel Pearl near Delhi airport. We booked for just 3 hours before our flight to rest and freshen up. Staff were very professional and welcoming, eager to please. Room was great, we will definitely return for an overnight stay the next time we fly to Delhi. Plenty of shops and restaurants close by. Easy access to Aero City metro station, we walked there from the hotel.

hotel_name: Hotel Pearl Mahipalpur Delhi Airport @ 05 Minutes Walk To Aero City Metro Station
review_text: THEY FORCE YOU TO REVIEW ON THE BOOKING SITE! The rooms are terrible. We had an extra bed booked for the room and they gave us a thin mattress on the floor. The food was so bland - we skipped the dishes to eat fruits. Food: They provided no toiletries - we asked for soap. We had to remind them four times to actually get soap. Location: the street is so narrow and so difficult to get into.

hotel_name: Hotel Pearl Mahipalpur Delhi Airport @ 05 Minutes Walk To Aero City Metro Station
review_text: It was very poor experience and definitely not worth the money. Just the facade of the building is shining. Staffs would look like some premium hotel and talk nicely. Room I stayed was poor. Switch not working not able to turn off the lights in the night, all plug points were full of dust, fan was not fitted properly. It was cold weather so I didn’t use it. Overall, Very bad experience. Just because it is near the airport, doesn’t mean it will be good for lay over. If you think of wasting money, you can book this hotel. Don’t go by the 5 star reviews.

The hotel is nothing like what you see in the pictures. The rooms are like of cheap hotel and really small. The picture they are using are either different property or gotten from internet. If you book room from make my trip, they would option delux and executive, with executive costing more money but there is no difference. Both are same. If you are foreigner, or international couple i would recommend to not stay here or around this area. Not very safe. If you can shell out some money i would recommend to check better hotel nearby like le season etc.

I am having a mixed experience. The room which was shown on website was different from they gave. I asked the same to receptionist, the answer was "Do you find any problem in room?". The basic things were fulfilled. But be cautious you might not get what you see. Serving of the food was not that good. Serving tray was very very dirty. After asking another tray which was little better served, but from next time onward similar thing started coming. Preparation time of food was little longer, but tastes good. Except that rest of the things were alright. I got my suit ironed on time. Construction work on other floor was in progress.

Very bad experience.” From Delhi airport terminal 1, we reached the hotel at about 1.00 am. Before starting my trip, I had called the property two-three times to confirm a pleasant stay. When we reached here we found that some renovation work was going on and no rooms were available for stay. After repeated requests, they arranged a room in a hotel about half a km away. We had a bad experience that we had to walk this distance with all our luggages. The room provided was not at all good. Agoda, please make sure that the property exists in good condition before confirming our reservation.

It's not a good hotel for families. The area is unsafe especially during night hours. Lots of suspicious activities can be seen occurring in and around the hotel. I had booked it through MMT and was non refundable. Upon reaching the hotel I realised to shift to some other hotel on the highway nearby. I wrote to MMT about the same. Nil response and no refund. Humble requests to persons with families to strictly avoid.

Big spacious rooms. Big spacious newly refurbished toilets.. The building is old and has no elevator, but it is just 3 flights of stairs so hardly matters. They supply RO water, they have a kitchen which serves decent food At a reasonable price. Check all your apps for a better price on the rooms.. For the price I paid, this room was a steal.

We are a family of four and stayed at the hotel for 4 days. Overall, it was a pleasant experience. The food was tasty and had good variety, the service staff were attentive and helpful, and the room was comfortable and well-maintained. I would rate the food, service, and room a solid 4 out of 5. This hotel made our family stay enjoyable, and we would consider coming back again.

The Hotel has hired professional staff to give good reviews so that their rating does not get affected. They should instead focus on customer service. If the lift is not working, should a person stay at their place. FYI they have only one lift and the parking is the basement. I had to climb the ramp to get back to the Hotel after parking my car. Inconsiderate Hotel. Please do not try. Tomorrow you will see two or three good reviews after this is posted — Dhalvinder Singh Basra

I had recommended this hotel to a friend of mine based on my earlier impression, but unfortunately his experience turned out to be extremely disappointing. My friend has a knee problem and cannot climb stairs. When he arrived, the hotel’s elevator was not working. Considering his medical condition, using the stairs was not possible for him. When he informed the hotel staff about the issue, they told him on the spot that he could check into another hotel and that they would refund the amount. However, after he arranged another hotel and requested the refund, the management completely stopped responding to emails and calls. This behavior is very unprofessional and disappointing. If the elevator was not operational, the hotel should have informed guests in advance or handled the refund properly as promised. Ignoring communication after making a commitment is not acceptable. I hope the management addresses this issue seriously and improves their customer service so other guests do not face similar problems. ⭐ Very disappointing experience.

I booked an executive suite for three nights, but unfortunately, I didn’t get to stay in it on the first night because the lock wasn’t working. This feel like something that should have been checked and fixed before my arrival. I did pay for a suite that I never actually got to stay in and the hotel staff didn’t offer any solution or compensation for that. The hotel definitely needs some improvements. The rooms felt dusty and old and could really use some repair or a makeover to bring them up to standard. On the brighter side, I found the night staff to be much more helpful and friendly than the day staff. During the day, I felt like one of the staff members wasn’t really interested in assisting guests, which goes against what you expect from good hospitality. The gate men were pleasant and welcoming, though. Overall, while there were some good points the experience left me feeling that the hotel has a lot of room for improvement.

I had a pleasant stay at Foxoso Hotel near Delhi Airport. Overall, the hotel experience was good and comfortable. The housekeeping was satisfactory, with rooms generally clean and well-maintained. Basic amenities were available, and the hotel environment was decent for a short stay, especially due to its convenient location close to the airport. While there is scope for improvement in service consistency, the hotel offers good value for money and a comfortable stay for travelers.

hotel_name: Hotel Mayda Prime By Mayda Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.
review_text: I booked this hotel for a daytime stay as we had a late-night flight. It was our first visit to Delhi, and due to heavy traffic, we were delayed by about two hours for checkout. The hotel charged us ₹1,500 for the booking and an additional ₹700 for the late checkout. We requested some flexibility considering the situation, but the staff did not accommodate our request. Regarding the room, it was not well-maintained the walls had damp patches, there was no space to open the window, and the overall cleanliness was below expectations. The TV and telephone were not working, which added to the inconvenience. Despite these issues, we did not complain during the stay, but it certainly impacted the experience. The stay served its purpose, but the lack of flexibility, poor maintenance, and non-functional amenities left us disappointed. Improving room conditions and customer service would make a significant difference

hotel_name: Hotel Mayda Prime By Mayda Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.
review_text: We stayed at this hotel for few days, and my experience was very disappointing. Every time I went out, the staff kept stopping me and asking how many people were going with me. Even if someone was just walking next to me, they would suddenly stop us and question it. This felt uncomfortable and unnecessary. The room quality was very poor. The bed condition was terrible, and overall cleanliness and comfort were not up to standard. The reception staff do not know how to talk to or behave with customers. Their attitude was rude and unprofessional throughout my stay. Because of this experience, I will never stay at this hotel again and do not recommend it to others.

hotel_name: Hotel Mayda Prime By Mayda Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.
review_text: Very nice place to stay. They provide prompt and fine services. I and family fully satisfied.

hotel_name: Hotel Mayda Prime By Mayda Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.
review_text: The place is nice but the way i left was really not nice... I booked with the reception prepaid taxi at night to the airport... I waited 20 min and it never arrived Seems like the staff awake at the moment didn't know what was going on... luckily I got an uber. but if I didn't know better I might would have missed my flight. 4 min before my uber came I asked the staff if I can get my money back... seems like the taxi didn't pick up the phone. At start it looked like they don't know if I paid or not. I practically needed to beg them to get my money back to pay the uber taxi..and in general it didn't feel like they understood the urgency if getting to airport in time.

hotel_name: Hotel Mayda Prime By Mayda Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.
review_text: This is by far the worst hotel I’ve ever seen. The place is extremely unsafe, especially for women. There is no proper security, anyone can walk in and out of the premises without being checked. The corridors are dark and poorly lit, creating a very uncomfortable environment. The staff is unprofessional and careless – instead of making guests feel secure, they make things worse by ignoring complaints. I personally felt unsafe the entire time I stayed here, and I would never recommend this place to any woman traveling alone or with friends. The management does not take guest safety seriously. There are no CCTV cameras in important areas, the locks on the doors are weak, and the surroundings outside the hotel feel very unsafe after dark. If you value your safety and peace of mind, please avoid this hotel at all costs. There are many better and safer options nearby.

Place is shut down . Full scam . I booked room in Agoda . Booking confirmed . When i reached location . hotel is shutdown . The Securitty near hotel tried pitching me another room in parallel road inside shady area . Don’t fall for this Trap

Not worth the price we paid. Pros: ✔️ The person at the reception was cooperative. Cons: ❌ Rooms are extremely noisy—you can hear outside noise, even footsteps. ❌ The rooms were small and had an unpleasant smell. ❌ They didn’t provide room keys, so every time we went out, we had to ask the reception to open the room. ❌ Very few restaurants nearby, making it difficult to find good dining options. Overall, a disappointing experience. Would not recommend.

We had booked a suite for four people, in what we believed to be a four star hotel. When we arrived in the early evening we realized that our room was dirty with dust, Several issues made my stay uncomfortable: DO NOT STAY WITH FAMILY NOT RECOMENDED Toilet Flush Issues: The toilet flush didn’t work properly throughout my stay, which was incredibly frustrating and unhygienic. Hand Shower Problems: The hand shower was either broken or malfunctioning, making it difficult to use. It was an inconvenience that could have been easily avoided with proper maintenance. Lack of Cleanliness: The overall cleanliness of the room left much to be desired. The bathroom and floors didn’t seem like they had been thoroughly cleaned, and there were unpleasant odors throughout the space. Unpleasant Atmosphere: There were drunk and noisy people in the hotel late at night, making it hard to relax or get a good night's sleep. The management didn’t seem to address this issue, which greatly affected the atmosphere. No Hot Shower: To top it off, there was no hot water in the shower, which was extremely disappointing, especially after a long day of travel. Every day i have to request for hot water Overall, the experience was quite negative, and I would not recommend this hotel. Basic amenities.

The hotel location is strategic. It is close to the airport. If you have a morning flight, this hotel should be your option. The staff is good. The room is big. But, the light inside the room is dim. The heater did not work optimally. The bed is soft, clean and out of date.

Overall a worst experience ever. The room was poorly maintained and the toilet was broken. The staffs were rude. The food was really worst which gave me food poisoning, the menu showed 300 but they have charged me 450. I regret my stay there. Really really worst place to stay

hotel_name: Hotel Good Luck By Jmd Group
review_text: I recently stayed at Hotel Good Luck near IGI Airport, Delhi, and had a very comfortable experience. The best part of this hotel is its excellent location, just a few minutes away from the airport — perfect for travellers with early morning or late-night flights. The check-in was smooth and quick, and the staff were polite, friendly, and always ready to help with luggage and travel needs. The rooms were spacious, air-conditioned, and well-equipped with TV, Wi-Fi, hot water, and all basic amenities. The beds were comfortable, and I had a peaceful night’s sleep. The hotel offers great value for money, especially for short stays or transit guests. It’s ideal for families or solo travellers who want a safe, convenient, and budget-friendly place near the airport. The food service was good, and the staff made sure everything was served on time. Overall, Hotel Good Luck lives up to its name – it’s a good choice for travellers who want comfort, convenience, and warm hospitality without spending too much. I’ll definitely recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a pleasant and reliable stay near Delhi Airport. ⭐ Rating: 4.5 / 5 ✅ Location – Excellent ✅ Staff – Friendly & Helpful ✅ Cleanliness – Good ✅ Value for Money – Great

hotel_name: Hotel Good Luck By Jmd Group
review_text: I had such a fantastic experience in this hotel. The services provided by the staff named Mr. Laxman, Mr. Prem and the GM named Mrs. Prema was outstanding and beyond the benchmark. I look forward to book at this place again. Thank you very much for the services again.

hotel_name: Hotel Good Luck By Jmd Group
review_text: Good hotel with very helpful and friendly staff. The room was quite cold with no heating, but they kindly provided extra blankets. Bedsheets seemed a bit old and not very well maintained, but overall the staff made the stay comfortable with their support.

hotel_name: Hotel Good Luck By Jmd Group
review_text: Very affordable hotel with pretty nice arrangement in the room. Specially the behaviour of the staff starting from the reception to catering to housekeeping, everyone tried their level best to make my stay comfortable. Thank you for such hospitality. Hope to visit again in future.

hotel_name: Hotel Good Luck By Jmd Group
review_text: After 22 hrs continue journey Planned to take a break at this place for further trip. But couldn't get a sleep at all. Too noisy. Even we were on 4th floor.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn New Delhi Int'L Airport, An Ihg Hotel
review_text: Great location with amazingly friendly and helpful staff. The hotel is gorgeous and the room is lovely and spacious. The only reason it’s not 5 stars is because unfortunately the room reeked of cigarette smoke, even though I had a non-smoking room. It’s a shame because the amenities, location and staff were top notch

hotel_name: Holiday Inn New Delhi Int'L Airport, An Ihg Hotel
review_text: Extremly friendly service! Roshni is an intelligent and engaged person with a welcoming way to interact and communicate. Congratulation to educate such valuable employees. The rooms are super clean, spacious and with highly comfortable beds and pure natural linen. The late check out is a highly appreciated extra service. The best Hotel I stayed in India and will surely chose it again!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn New Delhi Int'L Airport, An Ihg Hotel
review_text: I love the breakfast. Especially the chef Rajendra is very warm kind heart to ask me if I would like some healthy food when he saw my plate was full of fruits. He wants to design special granola yogurt parfait for me, I feel warmed by his kindness. The parfait was excellent and fresh. It’s yummy. This is my fabulous experience staying here.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn New Delhi Int'L Airport, An Ihg Hotel
review_text: Staff were friendly although the person I had on check in seemed inexperienced and should've been trained better. He wasn't aware of the perks I get as a diamond elite member although did notice that I was one. Bar on site had live sports which was good but limited drinks options in my opinion. Better off going out to nearby bars which are walking distance in Aerocity. Restaurant downstairs was good and offered discount as a diamond member. Not a fan of the service charge automatically added, however, although restaurant staff were nice, friendly. I stayed twice (first stay two nights second stay one night) but on the second stay there was only one bottle of water in my room. My first stay the shower head was very dirty so I requested it to be cleaned but was instead offered a change of shower head which was fine.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn New Delhi Int'L Airport, An Ihg Hotel
review_text: Really enjoyed staying here. The service was warm and attentive, and the rooms were designed for comfort. The food offerings were consistently good throughout the stay. Its location close to the airport is extremely helpful, especially for early flights or late arrivals. This hotel offers a great balance of comfort and convenience. The staff was welcoming and helpful, the rooms were well maintained, and the food was of high quality. Being located near the airport makes travel easy and stress-free.

I'm extremely disappointed with my recent stay at this hotel. The room and overall hotel hygiene were appalling. Walls had stains, bedsheets had cigarette burns, and the bathroom was smelly. The washbasin tap was too high, and the sink was too small, causing water to splash everywhere. Only the breakfast was decent. 😔 Rating: 1/5 stars Wouldn't recommend due to poor maintenance and cleanliness. 🚫

The actual rooms are completely different from what is shown in the app. I strongly advise not to trust online photos and not to make full payment online. If anyone still plans to stay here, please pay only at check-in after physically verifying the room. The hotel staff behavior is also not good and unprofessional. Additionally, Goibibo’s reviews seem to be fake and paid reviews. It looks like they are only focused on business, not customer trust. Because I trusted both the hotel and Goibibo, I lost ₹11,500. Important Note: This hotel is not a safe and secure place, especially for families. Both the hotel and Goibibo are misleading customers. Please be careful. They goibio please stoped or lock my review block also kindly became full

The tap in the bathroom is broken. The bathroom was absolutely wet when we enetered the room. The sofa was an absolute disaster, I haven't seen a dirtier sofa in a hotel before. Water Kettle had dirt marks in it. Not at all sound proof, you can hear everything. The room isn't isolated properly with inside room temperatures falling as per outside temperature. PLEASE DONT GO BY THE GOOD RATINGS THIS PLACE HAS GOT. (CONSIDER IT 2.5/5 LEVEL) I have seen the other reviews where this hotel has apologised for the bad experience, I am requesting the hotel to not apologise to me because its unforgivable.

I was extremely dissatisfied with my stay due to poor service, including not being provided breakfast, and an unprofessional, unresponsive management team. I had booked a room in this hotel through booking.com. When I arrived at the hotel, they said that they didn't have my reservation even though I had booked the room many days in advance. On showing the booking proof, they said they don't have any available rooms and took me to another hotel nearby (Hotel King's plaza). This other hotel (King's plaza), seeing my booking, asked me to pay more than 3x the amount shown on the booking confirmation if I wanted to stay there. On refusing, they took my phone and cancelled the booking from my end so as to not face issues on their end. Would absolutely not recommend anyone stay with them.

I had a very disappointing stay at this hotel. The room was dirty, the sheets had stains, and the bathroom smelled bad. The staff was unhelpful and unfriendly when we reported the issues. I would not stay here again. Breakfast was very very bad🤯

I had a very negative and concerning experience at this property. At check-in, the receptionist took my phone under the pretext of checking my reservation and then claimed that the price shown on Booking.com was valid for only one night and that I would need to pay double for the full stay. I refused, as this was not what I had booked. While I was speaking with Booking.com support to resolve the issue, the receptionist used the confirmation number and PIN from my reservation—information he had seen on my phone—to cancel my booking without my consent. This felt extremely deceptive and unprofessional. The photos shown online do not accurately represent the property, and the overall handling of the situation was unacceptable. I also experienced discriminatory and intolerant language regarding religion, which made the stay feel uncomfortable and unwelcoming. I would strongly advise future guests to be cautious and to avoid sharing their phone or reservation PIN with staff
