I booked Zed Hotel through Booking.com, but when I arrived, they told me no rooms were available and shifted me to another property. The alternate hotel was of very poor quality, not like what I had booked, and they even overcharged for food. When I called Zed Hotel to report the issue, they simply disconnected my call. Very disappointing experience — not recommended at all.

If you’re even thinking about booking a room at Hotel Z — don’t. Trust me, I’ve been traveling for over 5 years now, and this is hands down the worst hotel room I’ve ever stayed in. Sure, the room might look okay when you enter and the staff may act polite, but the problems start hitting you one by one. I asked the staff to turn on the AC — he did, and took the remote with him. When I went to use the washroom, the jet spray was completely broken — spraying water everywhere except where it should. I had to use a mug instead. Then when I tried to wash my hands, the handwash dispenser was completely empty. I had to use my own face wash just to clean my hands. Looked for a towel — none provided. Not even a basic hand towel. When I finally settled in, I realized the AC wasn’t cooling at all. I had to call the staff twice just to get the remote. Even after that, it felt no different from a non-AC room. As if that wasn’t enough, the ceiling fan was rotating in reverse, literally blowing air upward toward the ceiling instead of down. So no fan, no AC — just sweat and frustration all night. Then came the food — totally overpriced. I ordered just a plate of veg fried rice for ₹350, and what I got wouldn’t even be worth ₹150. Cheap quality, small portion, and zero value for money. I honestly felt scammed. This was a complete waste of my time, money, and peace of mind. May God return the owner all the money he’s taken from people like me — in the form of karma. Avoid this place at all costs. Not worth a single rupee.

1. I stayed in this hotel for 4 nights and had no issues with cleanliness, food, or laundry. 2. Thank you for the excellent service, it was really good. 3. The rooms are clean and the service is great. As a solo female traveler, I felt safe because of the 24-hour security and supportive reception staff.

Exceptional Stay Amidst Comfort Our recent stay in January early 2026,at Hotel The Paramont was nothing short of spectacular. Perfectly located just off the highway, a few miles before Air port the hotel offers both convenience and serenity—ideal for travellers who want easy access without compromising on peace and privacy. Cleanliness was impeccable across all areas, from the sparkling bathrooms to the well-maintained common spaces and rooms. You can tell the staff takes genuine pride in upkeep. The hospitality deserves a special mention. Warm, attentive, and always ready to go the extra mile, the team made us feel like valued guests from the moment we arrived.unforgettable experience Meals served there were not only beautifully presented but also rich in local flavors. The taste of the food was consistently excellent, with a mix of authentic regional cuisine and comforting classics. Lastly, the pricing felt well-balanced. For the quality of service, location, and amenities provided, the rates were more than fair—offering true value for money. Highly recommended for couples, families looking for a peaceful yet well-connected retreat. We left refreshed, recharged, and already planning our return!

I had a really good stay at paramont. 1. The room was clean, comfortable, & perfect for relaxing. 2. The best part was the food, especially the dinner & breakfast—it was delicious & memorable. 3. The staff were kind and helpful, always making sure I was comfortable. 4. The hotel has a nice, cozy feel along with great service with great view. I would love to come back again and surely recommend paramont to others.

I had a wonderful experience at Hotel The Paramont, and the biggest reason is the amazing staff. A special and heartfelt thanks to Ashutosh, whose kindness, warmth, and willingness to help truly stood out. He went above and beyond to make sure everything was comfortable and smooth, and his attitude alone makes this hotel special. All the other staff members were also extremely friendly, polite, and helpful at every moment. You really feel welcomed and cared for here. Honestly, I would visit this hotel again just because of the staff. Their hospitality made my stay memorable. Highly recommended! Thank you

1. Had a nice stay here. Check-in was smooth, the room was comfortable, and the overall environment was pleasant. 2. Staff were friendly and helpful. The hotel is clean, well maintained, and in a convenient location.

Bedsheets were very dirty. Also filthy room with damp smell all around hotel. Food quality was bad. On top of that hotel mansger was forcing us to give 4 star rating. Never go to this hotel. Its really really dirty and bad.

I stayed at your property with my family from 20th September to 23rd September and booked three rooms. Overall, we were very satisfied with the food, rooms, service, and location. All the staff members were very helpful and courteous, especially Mr. Baljeet Singh, who was extremely polite and always ready to assist us. However, I would like to share my concern regarding the behavior of one staff member, Mr. Khushi Singh (Operation Manager). During dinner, I politely requested two extra empty plates. Instead of assisting, He responded rudely, asking me why I needed them and whether I had ordered food from the restaurant. Although plates were available right in front of him, he refused to provide them and waited for another staff member to handle it. The next day, I approached the restaurant again to request hot water, and unfortunately, I was insulted in front of other hotel staff. He asked inappropriate questions like, “What are you doing here? Are you working here? Why are you standing here like this?” Such behavior was unprofessional and disrespectful, especially towards a guest. I believe Mr. Khushi Singh would greatly benefit from training in guest relations and professional behavior. Apart from this issue, our overall stay was pleasant, and we truly appreciate the efforts of the rest of the staff.

We booked a premium suite at this hotel. The room was quite big, but the bathroom was terrible. Water used to accumulate all over the bathroom floor, and it became very dirty. We ate at there restaurant there chef make excellent food we never get tired of the food anything that we ordered was amazingly good 👍
Hotel is really good. They took care of me well. Breakfast is good too

Very Bad and Disrespectful Experience – Not Recommended We booked through Booking.com. At the time of booking, the price shown was ₹757. However, when we reached the hotel and checked in, the front office staff suddenly added another ₹700+ and said it was Booking.com commission. This is completely unacceptable. If there are extra charges, they must be clearly mentioned during booking, not forced on guests at the counter. The way this was handled was very disrespectful. We were already tired and did not have time to argue, so we had no choice but to take the room. The room was just okay, nothing special. The AC was not working properly, and to make it worse, there was no battery in the AC remote. This shows very poor maintenance and care. This hotel is not suitable for families at all. The staff behavior was rude and unhelpful. They did not try to solve any issues or speak politely. The worst part was during breakfast. Even though breakfast was included in our room tariff, the staff kept asking how many breads we were eating. This was extremely uncomfortable and embarrassing. I don’t understand why guests are questioned like this when breakfast is already paid for. Overall, this was a very bad experience. Poor service, hidden charges, bad attitude, and lack of basic hospitality. Absolutely not recommended. I will never stay here again and would strongly advise others to avoid this hotel.

Had the worst experience ever. Same as others. When we reached the reception the receptionist Disha asked us to pay twice the booking price. Very bad experience. There are many reviews already saying that staff charge extra by changing bookings, and unfortunately I faced the same issue — I am not the first. I booked a 2-bed room for ₹1207 because I was traveling with my family. Facilities were poor: • No proper hot water in the shower • No hot water bottle • No hair dryer • No toilet paper • Breakfast was useless • Very noisy at night Overall, dishonest billing, poor facilities, and bad service. Don’t go there. Avoid at any cost.

I had a terrible experience at this hotel. First of all, the location shown online is completely misleading — the property is actually in a not-so-good area, which felt unsafe and inconvenient. Despite booking in advance, I was given a lower category room than what I had paid for. The room itself was in poor condition, with dirty bedsheets, dusty surfaces, and an overall lack of cleanliness. To make things worse, the management’s behavior was extremely unprofessional. Instead of helping resolve the issues, they were rude and dismissive. Overall, this was one of the worst hotel stays I’ve had. I definitely do not recommend this place.

Perfect stay and service. Wow respect that you support and have employees whom are less abled. I am so so proud that you are giving every person a chance to have a equal work chance to everyone. A good hotel for a short stay or layover. Staff were helpful and kind. The entire hotel is kept clean and tidy. Check in process was fast. However, do keep in mind that the basic rooms are quite small(as shown on their website). More than 2 people cannot stay there. The showers and toilets in the room are very clean and well maintained. The breakfast/lunch and dinner buffet have a decent selection of veg and Non veg items to eat. Certain items like dosa, roti etc can be ordered to be made fresh. Room service is quite fast as well. Takes around 25-30 mins. There are multiple restaurants and bars close to the hotel as well, if you want to go out and eat. Remember not to get confused with this hotel and the Lemon Tree Premier which is facing the front. The Premier is more expensive whereas this one is more budget friendly( for Delhi) Now the cons, The Internet is an issue here. Throughout my entire stay, I had connectivity issues with the Internet every hour. It kept going off every now and then, which can get quite irritating. This causes a problem with the TV since all rooms have a smart TV and they cannot function without Internet. Another issue is the hallways can get quite loud during the Check-in and Check-out window. I would recommend the management to consider installing carpets in the hallways. Overall, I had a good stay here. I stayed for about 12 days here and other than the noise and Internet issue everything else was good.

I had an excellent experience at this hotel in New Delhi. During my journey through India, I stayed here twice, and on both occasions the service was consistently warm, attentive, and highly professional The staff genuinely care about their guests. On one occasion, I raised a minor observation and it was addressed immediately. I confidently award this hotel an excellent rating.

I had a very good stay at Lemon Tree Hotel. The rooms were clean and comfortable, and the overall atmosphere was pleasant. Special thanks to the in-house keeping OM, who was extremely helpful and supportive throughout my stay. His service made my experience even better. I would definitely recommend Lemon Tree Hotel and would love to stay here again.

I stayed at this hotel for a week, and it honestly felt like a home away from home. The staff were incredibly kind, gentle, and well behaved throughout my stay. A special mention to Neeraj for his politeness, warmth, and helpful nature truly stood out and made my experience even better. The ambience of the hotel was calm and welcoming, perfect for relaxing after a long day. I stayed both solo and with friends during my time there, and each stay felt equally comfortable and safe. The rooms were cozy, clean, and beautifully maintained, and the hotel offered great value for the price. Everything about the stay was smooth and pleasant from the hospitality to the atmosphere. I genuinely appreciated the effort the staff put into making guests feel cared for. Definitely a lovely, budget friendly place that I’d be happy to return to.

Amazing hospitality! The host allowed us to check in early since we had a long wait before our next flight, gave us a free meal, and even arranged free transport to the terminal. Truly appreciated! Very satisfied guests from the Philippines 🇵🇭

Includes breakfast - which looked ok but didn’t have the appetite so early to eat 5 minutes drive to T1- this was important coming from T3 and leaving early from T1 Complimentary airport pick up and drop off 24 hour desk Clean and respectable entrance and very professional staff. Room was ok, bed hard but ok for a quick rest. Bathroom looked new and functioned very well, for me that was very good. Our room was ok, not as nice as the pictures but it was clean and everything worked. Surprisingly quiet too, was expecting it to be noisy outside but only got louder in the morning, which was expected. Good enough choice if you want to be close to T1 and felt very safe, even as a solo female traveller.

The staff members are polite, updated and always ready to help with a smile. Rooms are neat, spacious and the overall cleanliness is admirable. The reception team- Gaurav is approachable and easy to discuss your requirements with, they truly care about guest comfort. Location is also convenient for travellers right next to T1 airport Much love from Prabhjot. Definitely coming again soon

review_text: Toilets are completely non functional. Flush does not work. No water in wash basin when you need it in the morning. Rude hotel reception staff. Take it or leave it. Airport shuttle service not complementary. It is at Rs 500 when Uber will take you for 100-150 Rs. Rooms are small. All electrical lights switch on with a single button. Who made that! All roads leading to hotel are full of filth and mud. Plenty of options around. This one's definitely a miss you will never regret.

Decent Budget Stay but Needs Improvement My husband and I stayed at this hotel for two nights during our visit to Delhi, India. On arrival, we were given a very small room with a full-size bed, and we didn’t sleep well the first night. The next morning, I requested a room change, and the staff kindly moved us to a larger room with a king bed. Unfortunately, that room had quite a few tiny black flies, and the TV didn’t work. Although I asked for it to be fixed, nothing was done except that they took the remote. The bathroom was fine and had consistent hot water. The bed was clean, and the Wi-Fi worked well throughout our stay, which we really appreciated. Our room included breakfast — the buffet was okay, though limited for foreigners who prefer non-spicy options like my husband. There were boiled eggs and cereal available, which helped. We also ate dinner at the hotel’s restaurant; the food was tasty but quite spicy. Overall, it’s a decent option if you’re on a budget and just need a clean place to rest for the night. The staff were polite and helpful, but the hotel could definitely improve cleanliness and room maintenance.

This hotel is a FRAUD. There is a big scam going on. I booked an executive room much in advance and paid in full but when I checked in late at night (flight arrival) I was checked in the a dingy small room. I question the manager at reception and he threatened that this is the only option available and it’s my choice if I want to stay here or leave. They provided other options around the hotel but those were even worse. The bed was a tiny bed ad i couldn’t even fit myself in unless I lie down diagonally on the bed. Room wasn’t cleaned, line was not refreshed and there were staff noises outside in the corridor throughout the night and I couldn’t sleep at all despite being so tired from the journey. It appears that they prioritise the demand and sell the rooms for higher prices and don’t give a damn about online bookings. I checked out 7am in the morning the next day. WORSE place to stay, I would not recommend this place at all. NO ETHICS, NO CONCERNS. Just the audacity to mention that it’s my fault that I paid in full before arrival and that I should have checked the room first before paying. How’s that guarantee that they will even give a room in this case. Booked it through MMT and they are investigating the matter (that’s what they told me).

Worst hotel experience ever. Stayed here for 5 days and booked 2 suite rooms, but the service was absolutely pathetic. Every order—food or even drinking water—took more than 1 hour, every single time. We called multiple times and informed the manager, but his only response was “No staff is available, what can I do?” This clearly shows poor management and zero concern for guests. Third-class service at premium prices. No professionalism, no hospitality, and no accountability. DO NOT stay here. Please don’t waste your money.

Hotel International Inn, Mahipalpur is a decent mid-range option conveniently located near IGI Airport, making it suitable for short stays or early-morning flights. The staff is generally polite and cooperative, and airport shuttle service is available on request (though not always prompt). Rooms are compact and equipped with basic amenities like Wi-Fi, TV, and air-conditioning, but cleanliness and maintenance can be inconsistent. The in-house food service is average; fine for a quick meal. Though better dining options are available nearby. Overall, a value-for-money stay if you prioritize location and transit convenience over luxury or premium comfort.

Dear all, The overall condition of the room was highly unsatisfactory. I had booked a family room for ₹7,000, but the facilities provided were not even worth ₹2,000. The air conditioner was not functioning, and the cupboard was broken. When I requested tissue paper, the staff were reluctant to provide it. The room also lacked sufficient lighting; at the very least, a bedside lamp should have been available for the price charged. Additionally, an international multi-socket was not provided, which is quite disappointing for a hotel located near the airport. Overall, it was a very poor experience, and I would not recommend this hotel.

When I questioned this, she stated that the amount shown on Agoda was only for the “booking” and that I would need to pay extra directly to the hotel. This was never mentioned during the booking process, and there was no transparency about any additional charges. It felt misleading and unfair. I ended up wasting my time and energy traveling to the property, only to face this situation. I would strongly recommend future guests to be cautious before booking here. It may be better to choose a more reputable and transparent hotel to avoid unnecessary inconvenience.

The hotel maintained good hygiene, and the overall cleanliness was impressive. The staff was polite and supportive, and the service quality was good. However, the service time can be improved, as it was slightly delayed. Additionally, electrical appliances in the rooms should be checked regularly to ensure they are in proper working condition. Overall, a pleasant stay with scope for improvement.

I strongly advise anyone looking for a stay in Delhi to avoid this hotel. Do not be misled by the ratings; my experience was highly unprofessional from start to finish. The Main Issues: The Staff: Unwelcoming and frankly hostile. The receptionist (a bald man) was particularly rude and has no sense of hospitality or customer service. Facilities: The geyser/hot water does not work. When you complain, they promise to send someone in 30 minutes, but you’ll be left waiting for 5–6 hours. They simply do not care about your comfort. Food & Water: While the food itself tastes okay, the service is a nightmare. You have to order 2 hours in advance just to eat. Even getting basic bottled water (Bisleri) requires a long wait. Final Verdict: This hotel is managed by people who are unprofessional and talk to guests very poorly. Save your money and your peace of mind—stay somewhere else.

The main issue was staff’s attitude. The receptionist was extremely unwelcoming and at times openly hostile. There was a clear lack of basic courtesy, hospitality, and customer service. What stood out most was the complete absence of empathy. Instead of showing understanding of the situation, policies were used as a shield to justify rude behavior. It felt as though the rules were applied selectively rather than fairly and professionally. Overall, it was a very disappointing and unpleasant experience.

I stayed at Hotel Olivia for almost four months, from September to January, during a business trip, and it was truly a pleasure staying here. I would especially like to mention Mr. Suresh, Mr. Anil, and Mr. Govind for their professionalism and courteous nature, which made the stay smooth and enjoyable. I would definitely recommend Hotel Olivia for both short-term and long-term business stays.
Stayed here with my father for work-related travel and had a great experience. Affordable rates, good service, and nice food. Would definitely recommend.

The only good thing about this hotel is that it is only 20 min away from Delhi Airport. Otherwise everything else was disappointing. Their staffs lack courtesy and they lack sense of how to behave responsibly in a hospitality industry. They never said sorry inspite of committing mistakes. The on-site dining as well as breakfast is decent. I found the quality of the Indian dishes at the breakfast to be quite flavorful and sufficient variety for continental options as well. Be aware that dining in the hotel can be a little pricey compared to local restaurants. Overall, if you are looking for an extremely convenient, clean, and reliably comfortable place to crash for an airport layover or a short business trip where proximity to Aerocity and the Metro is key, Le Season delivers. It’s certainly a better value than some of the more expensive Aerocity properties, provided you are willing to overlook the somewhat aging interiors. hotel_name: The Orion - Greater Kailash - 3 Star Hotel In Delhi
review_text: Misleading photos and disappointing stay As an American traveler who has stayed in hotels across both Africa and India—including some at much lower rates—I can honestly say this was one of my most disappointing hotel experiences. Misleading presentation: The photos online were deceiving—either very old or heavily edited. The room we were given smelled terrible. The furniture, especially the chairs and cabinets, had a strong urine odor, and the overall space smelled damp and moldy. The bedding felt moist and unclean, and there was visible water warping on the floor and bathroom door, which made it difficult to open and close. Room and maintenance issues: We initially tried to overlook these problems since we were happy to have a Western toilet and overhead shower, but on the first day, our shower caused the entire bathroom to flood. I had to unplug the hair dryer out of fear of electrocution. When we called for help, the staff discovered the drain was clogged with a thick buildup of hair—clearly not cleaned between guests. On top of that, the drain wasn’t even installed at the low point, so water couldn’t flow out properly. Although staff came promptly, they used a bath towel to mop up the dirty water—without any disinfectant—dragging it across the floor. Later, we realized our refrigerator had not been running while we were out, since power shuts off when you remove the keycard. We had food stored inside, and my husband later became ill. We strongly suspect it was due to the fridge not staying on, which feels like a cost-cutting measure on the hotel’s part. From that point on, we wore our shoes inside because the floor no longer felt clean. Sanitation and plumbing problems: Two days later, dirty toilet water began seeping from around the base of the toilet. The staff initially dismissed it, took a long coffee break, and only later came to address the issue. Again, the floor was “cleaned” with a bath towel and no disinfectant. Every time we requested clean towels, we only received part of what we asked for. The soap provided was from a push-style dispenser attached to the wall, filled with low-quality liquid soap that felt diluted and had an unpleasant scent. Room change: After repeated complaints, we were finally moved to a much nicer room—but by then, the frustration had overshadowed the gesture. Other observations: The elevator (lift) was also malfunctioning during our stay. I understand that the building is older, but proper upkeep and small improvements could easily maintain its quality and justify its rating. We didn’t try the hotel restaurant due to multiple reviews mentioning food poisoning. Another couple in our group did eat there; while they didn’t get sick, they said the menu was limited. Positives: The Blue Tokai coffee shop downstairs was excellent—great service and quality coffee. The security guards were also very kind and professional. The neighborhood felt safe, though the hotel’s location is quite far from most Delhi attractions. Overall: For the price, the value did not align at all. The hotel’s appearance online does not match reality, and the lack of basic cleanliness, maintenance, and hygiene standards makes it impossible for me to recommend—especially at its current rate.

Very comfortable stay,, Service is good,, Mr Avanish is attending the guests very politely and pleasantly. Happy to stay here for 3 days

We had come for an official event at AIIMS Delhi, and we chose this because of its proximity to the institute. It was actually mentioned as a 3-star hotel. But after our stay, I would say the hotel did not disappoint us even in a single aspect. Rooms were clean and food was very nice. The staff were very friendly and kind. We were really happy that we could get south indian food like idly in the morning. And other things like linen, toiletry, room service and what not - everything was perfect. I will definitely stay here if I come again to Delhi and would also highly recommend it for anyone who has an event at AIIMS delhi. The institute is just 5 minutes away from this hotel. The Clay Oven restuarant attached to the hotel is by itself a very good one serving north indian, south indian, and chinese cuisine.

In the heart of the city in a residential area. Market was near by. . With elderly parents it felt safer. Food was very tasty. Staff was very helpful. There was a minor issue with the shower in the room they fixed . Its a little old property but rooms are nice. Overall a great experience will visit again.

Price is five star Service is zero star Think twice before you go, Night reception is rude as hell. Omlet takes an hour to come Everything is charged to bill. First time in life asked for a match box But only got match sticks got to know match stick Are put safely without the box
The room was terrible, shared with cockroaches. The staff was uncooperative and displayed unnecessary rude and arrogant behavior. The food prices were excessively high and not worth the money.

The restaurant offers a peaceful and elegant atmosphere. The seating is comfortable, and the decor is tasteful. Whether dining alone, with family, or friends, the environment feels warm and welcoming. Service: The staff is polite, attentive, and professional. Orders are taken promptly, and special requests are handled with care. The hospitality feels genuine and consistent throughout the experience. Food Quality: The food is delicious and beautifully presented. Starters are fresh, main courses are rich in flavor and well-portioned, and desserts are satisfying. Everything tastes fresh and made with quality ingredients. Variety: The menu features a good mix of Indian, Continental, and Asian cuisines. There are plenty of options for both vegetarian and non-vegetarian guests, including some creative fusion dishes. Cleanliness & Hygiene: The restaurant is well-maintained with clean tables and sanitized utensils. Hygiene standards appear high, and even the kitchen (if visible) looks neat and organized. Pricing: Prices are slightly premium but fair, considering the quality of food, service, and overall experience. Final Verdict: An ideal place for a relaxed meal, business lunch, or special dinner. Highly recommended for those who value taste, service, and a calm dining experience.

hotel_name: Mauryan Express Hotel @ Hauz Khas Fort
review_text: I had a very disappointing experience at this hotel. The service was extremely poor, and the rooms lacked even basic amenities. The bathroom was unhygienic, with dirty taps, no proper shower facilities, and a non-functional hand shower. To make matters worse, in the middle of the night, people were coming in and the hotel staff members appeared to be showing them the hotel rooms, creating constant noise by talking loudly and walking through the corridors. The hotel staff members were repeatedly opening and closing the hotel room doors, which caused extreme noise due to the poor condition of the doors. The disturbance made it impossible to sleep, and I was genuinely frightened, not knowing who these people were coming in at such odd hours. The location is also not good at all, which further added to the inconvenience. This is definitely not a family-friendly hotel. Additionally, the pictures of the rooms shown on Google are highly misleading and do not reflect the actual condition of the property. In a place like Hauz Khas, this was completely unexpected. Overall, the stay was highly unsatisfactory and far below expected standards. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a comfortable and peaceful stay.

hotel_name: Mauryan Express Hotel @ Hauz Khas Fort
review_text: Let me clarify. I went there for a cheap stay. I was already living in delhi for many years before going there. My requirements were less and hence I am okay with this. However, if youre okay with: 1. Not having a heater in winter days at delhi, 2. Cigarette burnt bedsheets, 3. Order from swiggy for every meal, 4. Receive minimal toilet kit, then you can stay there. However, they will change damaged things and provide kit/water etc once you ask for it. Further, this place is at backside of the hauz khas village parking. If youre calling a cab/auto, you have to walk around 500 Mt from the entrance. However, the location is perfect as hauz khas village is one of the happening areas of Delhi. Also, it allows free entry of swiggy/zomato delivery executives. In summary: its perfect for a short term/ emergency stay at cheap rate near AIIMS/green park/hauz khas/deer park area.

hotel_name: Mauryan Express Hotel @ Hauz Khas Fort
review_text: Not at all a good hotel to stay in Delhi.... particularly in winter no room heater...also no maintenance too....so not recommending to stay there.....

hotel_name: Mauryan Express Hotel @ Hauz Khas Fort
review_text: This Hotel is 100% fraud. 1. They have purposely misled the public by claiming that they are located in Deer Park, New Delhi. They are actually in Hauz Khas Village, and not accessible by road. Who will go to a hotel not accessible by road in a metro like New Delhi?!! By walking half a KM. 2. The shown photos apparently are not the real photos, it is manipulated, the property is in a very narrow and dirty lane. Not at all good for family, or anyone looking for a decent accommodation. 3. As said in many reviews a hotel is not booked just for the good behaviour of few staff. A hotel is booked for a pleasant stay in a neat and clean place. If you have to stay in a filthy place why to book a hotel?! Stay on the street.

hotel_name: Mauryan Express Hotel @ Hauz Khas Fort
review_text: The staff is really kind and helpful. The location is great. But the rooms are so dirty. Never had dirty room like that in 9 months in India !

Nice hotel and rooms breakfast is delicious. Stay is also good. We stayed in the hotel for one night. It has a great location, close to the embassy area in New Delhi. The rooms were nice and clean. I personally like the rooms, makes the areas nice and causy, I would say, only this common area as in the sitting area in the hotel needs a bit of improvement, otherwise all was well and we had a pleasant stay. The staff was polite and helpful.

This hotel offers a comfortable and hassle-free stay. The rooms were clean, the service was good, and the staff was friendly and cooperative. I also appreciated the peaceful environment and convenient location. Everything was well organized, making the experience smooth. Overall, I had a positive experience here It's a good option for anyone looking for a pleasant stay.

The hotel is good and cheap, the food was awesome and the ambience is great the luxury of room is great and the service is pretty much good and fine. A beautiful place for family or solo traveler for good service and food is also good Hotel is neat and clean i also recommend to friends and family members. Much Appreciation To Manager Mr Prem . Thanks For Making The Event A Rememberable.

such a shabby, unclean place. Building is so old, furniture and wood is ruined. Toilets are ok. There is cigarette smell inside. Not recommeded for families at all. No lift. It's very shady also. Someone was sleeping and they randomly showed us the room for us to have a look at the layout. Poor ventilation. Avoid Avoid if you can get a hotel
Very decent and helpful staff thank you for peaceful stay. I will come again to this place. I will recommend to my family and friends to book this hotel in delhi

Pathetic. No cleanliness, poor old unclean torn linens and beds. The linen isnt changed after the previous guests checkout, it is just re arranged. The rooms reek of dirty smell, im unsure whether its due to smoking/alcohol but its just masked with some cheap room freshener. No hot water facility. No proper service. FULL OF COCKROACHES.

Worst hotel ever. Stayed here for 2 days and it was a horrible experience. Rooms were dirty, bathroom hand shower was broken, and there was a bad smell in the room. Cockroaches were present which is completely unacceptable. No proper facilities or basic maintenance. Totally unhygienic and not worth the money. Do not recommend at all.

Absolutely Appalling – A Nightmare Stay You Should Avoid at All Costs This has been, without a doubt, the worst hotel experience we’ve had in decades, and that's saying a lot. From the moment we checked in, it was a disaster in every sense. • The beds were infested with cockroaches, crawling through torn mattresses with stuffing spilling out — it felt like staying in a pest-ridden storage unit rather than a hotel room. • The air conditioning was completely non-functional, leaving the room humid, suffocating, and impossible to rest in — especially for a family traveling with children. • There was no hot water in the bathrooms, making even basic hygiene a struggle. • To make matters worse, there is no restaurant on-site, and the hotel offers no proper food service despite being advertised as a full-service facility. • The staff was extremely unprofessional, rude, and combative — rather than addressing our concerns, they responded with arguments and complete indifference. • We had paid extra for a “breakfast included” option, only to be told we’re allowed a single cold sandwich while everything else is chargeable — an absolute scam and false advertising. • TV switches didn’t work, most amenities were broken or in disrepair, and the room itself was in shambles. This wasn’t just disappointing — it was borderline uninhabitable and a health hazard. I would never recommend this property to anyone. It was humiliating and distressing to subject my family to such conditions on what was supposed to be a relaxing trip. Avoid this place at all costs — the management is careless, the facilities are deteriorated beyond repair, and it’s an outright disgrace to the hospitality industry.

This is one of the worst hotel in that area I had a very bad experience over there the room was not properly cleaner even there's no proper controller for fan even electric appliances over there was dying badly and the worst part was there that bathroom was poorly cleared there were stains all around the floor. Avoid to such hotel
Gloomy and smelly room. Not very clean. Bathroom and bed sheets dirty. They use the same bed spreads after the previous occupant vacates. Bugs and Cockroach.

We hosted our Engagement, Haldi, and Mehndi ceremonies, and the experience was excellent. The service was outstanding, and the staff was very cooperative and attentive during all the events. A special thank you to Muskan from the management team for her sincere, responsible, and active support. She ensured everything was well managed and stress-free. The food was delicious and well appreciated by all our guests. Special compliments to Chef Pardeep for maintaining great taste and quality throughout the functions. Overall, the beautiful arrangements, great food, and exceptional service made all our celebrations truly memorable.

The stay was peaceful, the staff is very helpful in nature. I was new to the city, so they helped me with bags, and booking a cab and everything else. Didn't get the time to taste their food but the in-house cafe had a very cozy vibe. Overall amazing. The rooms were clean, the washrooms were a bit I'll maintained though, but they were hygienic.

This hotel is definitly the best price- quality for a hotel in delhi. The room and the beds were very comfortable, spacious, and clean and there is hot water. Last but not least, the staff is very nice and comprehensive. We had a great stay at this hotel. Thank you !! 🙌

Stayed three nights staff were wonderful and nothing too much trouble. Rooms seem to be in the middle of an upgrade . Towels and bed linen could do with replacing but we were reassured by staff that this is ongoing. Good location, no problem with transport links . Overall not a bad place

The hotel is located in a good area and is easily accessible. The staff were courteous and helpful special thanks to Vishal, Krishna, Suraj, and the café staff for their excellent service. Incharge Mr Tripathi Ji. The rooms were clean, spacious, and comfortable. Highly recommended.

This hotel is situated just on walking distance from lajpat nagar market. I stayed with my wife and i really liked this property. This hotel is couple friendly . Room is very neat and clean . Washroom is also very spacious and clean . I highly recommend this hotel. Have good parking space. Staff is very polite.
Very good hotel. It was nice stay. Very well maintained. Service was good. Only drawback room has no window else everything was perfect.
Old world charm within this hotel tucked in Lajpat Nagar. Amenities are basic and the staff is courteous. Ideal for a short stay during transit.

Had a wonderful stay at Hotel Residency! The rooms were clean, spacious, and well-maintained, providing a comfortable and relaxing experience. The staff was incredibly hospitable and always ready to assist with any requests. The hotel’s location is convenient, making it easy to explore the city. The food at the in-house restaurant was delicious, with a great variety of options. Overall, a fantastic stay with excellent service—I would highly recommend Hotel Residency for both business and leisure.

A very good business hotel with clean rooms and well decorated interiors. There is an old world charm in the decor. The complimentary breakfast spread every morning is varied and though the items are limited, the food is good. There is no restaurant in this hotel but you can order outside food to your room and the hotel provides plates and cuttlery. Some rooms have bathtubs, viz 201 and 208.

Location is good but rooms are small and noisy. No ventilation. Quality is not good. Advance payment needed. Basic amenities like water bottle is also not included. List stopped working from 2nd day. Each floor has different hotel. Using starts when lift is not working is quite challenging with all the luggage specially because they use it for storage as well. No safe emergency exit as such.

This is the hotel you will find reasonable and value for money hotel. It is situated second floor of the building so you directly go to Comfy stay hotels at second floor via lift. There are other touts around parking area of the same buliding and they will try to divert you but don't listen to them and go to the hotel reception directly at second floor. Highly recommended !
Satisfied with rooms and service. Excellent customer service and support by the hotel staff. Recommended for Delhi visit.
Very nice and best in this segment of small hotel chain. Truly happy with the hotel and it's facilities.

If you are travelling alone, this hotel is a great base. You will feel safe, and you will be safe. The rooms are simple and clean. Air con, tea and coffee, private bathroom. The Managers of this Hotel actually care about their guests. And it shows. It is literally across the road from M Block markets, where there are loads of food choices and services. Location is absolutely amazing, with 3 or 4 temples nearby. All the staff were considerate and excellent. Budget friendly, brilliant location and you are 100% safe and cared for, without being intrusive. You won't regret booking this Hotel.

Only good thing in this hotel is that the locaton of the hotel is near metro station. The rooms are full of smell. the behaviour of staff is also not good as when i compain about the TV they didnot resolve it untill a checked out afer 3 days. After my visit I came to know that many silmilar range hotles are available in this locality with more quality services and less cost.

The banquet hall in basement is sized for a small gathering of 50 people. The decor and service was decent. But be privy to the invoice they share and the GST they charge. They do not give proper bill, don't accept a print out sheet.

Room price are very high as per the service provided by the Hotel. Dust over the electric jug, unbalanced table top etc. Google map shows wrong location during cab booking. Ola driver argued to drop under a tree in nearby residential area.
One of the best business hotel in South Delhi location.

hotel_name: Hotel Exotica - Hotel In Green Park, New Delhi
review_text: “I recently stayed at this hotel and my overall experience was quite good. The rooms were clean, the bed was comfortable, and all the basic amenities like AC and lighting worked perfectly. The staff was polite, friendly, and always ready to help whenever needed. The location of the hotel is also convenient—markets and transport facilities are easily accessible. The food quality was impressive as well; the breakfast was fresh and tasted great. Overall, this hotel is value for money. If you are looking for a clean, comfortable, and peaceful place to stay, I would definitely recommend this hotel.”

hotel_name: Hotel Exotica - Hotel In Green Park, New Delhi
review_text: Tiny space, tiny rooms, thin walls so every conversation at the reception comes through to the room. This is a small 7 or 8 room property - the location is the best part. The room was clean and functional, but really compact. The biggest issue I had was the constant noise coming in from the reception area. A whole day of the manager taking his staff and vendors to task (justifiable I'm sure), but I don't want to hear every single thing. My room was just past the reception, there was no way to skip the reception and it's noise levels.

hotel_name: Hotel Exotica - Hotel In Green Park, New Delhi
review_text: Guys, if anyone is planning to book this property, please save your money and choose another place — even if it’s cheaper. The service is extremely poor. The bed sheets were not changed from the previous guest, and we were given used towels. The hygiene standards are unacceptable. The bathrooms were dirty, and overall cleanliness was very disappointing. This is based on my personal experience. I genuinely suggest looking for better options instead of wasting your money here.

hotel_name: Hotel Exotica - Hotel In Green Park, New Delhi
review_text: It was pleasant stay amid posh locality. Easy and quick access to market and metro. Polite staff. Good food.

hotel_name: Hotel Exotica - Hotel In Green Park, New Delhi
review_text: I had a great time staying here. Perks of staying here include the really good location, easy connectivity to Metro and other important parts of the city , lots of eateries etc. The rooms in general were clean including the bathrooms and the customer service is really unparalleled, they even help you late at night.

⭐ Rating: -10/5 (If possible) Hotel O Green Park Residency – Worst Experience Ever We stayed here for only 1 hour, and even that felt unbearable. This is by far the most unhygienic and poorly managed property I have ever come across. 1. Cheating at Check-in My booking amount was ₹901 (inclusive of taxes), but at the time of check-in they suddenly increased it to ₹1237. When I informed the receptionist about my original booking, he fiddled with his mobile for a while, and the price magically changed to ₹1237. Still, we agreed to pay just to avoid an argument. 2. Shifted to Another Property Instead of giving a room in the booked hotel, they took us to a different building two blocks away, which clearly did not look like an OYO-authorised property in any manner. 3. Horrible Room Condition The moment we entered, it felt like stepping into a slum or jhopdi. The room was extremely dirty and dusty. A strong bad smell was everywhere. Bedsheets were dirty, full of stains. The washroom was filthy and unhygienic. Instead of a proper mattress, there was a plastic foam sheet. No drinking water was provided despite asking multiple times. They even said it would be chargeable, which is unbelievable. I am attaching photos so you can see how bad the condition actually was. Honestly, I doubt that the positive reviews online are real because this place does not deserve even a single star. Final Verdict: If I could, I would rate this property -10. Please avoid this hotel completely. It is a total waste of money, extremely unhygienic, and a horrible experience overall.

Had a worst experience staying here. We booked room for just the luggage keepsake purpose and room smelled like something died ... Definitely a rat died there and no one cleaned it. Even the rooms don't have attached washroom and rooms are very unclean and it stinks. Better stay on the road than book a room in this. Don't waste your money.

This hotel seriously disappointed me. They overcharged compared to the online booking price, which feels like a dishonest practice. Even after showing the online price, they refused to match it. On top of that, the room was not clean, poorly maintained, and uncomfortable. For the amount charged, the quality was far below expectations. Definitely not recommended.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at the hotel o green park residency,and I must say it exceeded my expectations! From the moment I checked in,the staff were warm, welcoming,and super helpful. My room was spacious,clean,and had an amazing view of the city...

hotel_name: The Saga Hotel, Green Park | New Delhi
review_text: The occasion was Pearl Marriage Anniversary of Dear Neeraj and his better half as well as Release of An Autobiography of Shri Ramesh Chand Jain in which he has shared his pieces of vast experience spreading over Ninety Five years!!!! A fine rejiocing banquet at basement of Hotel with a lift facility.Space is short but has been maintained well. Staff is courteous and helpful Valet parking is available. Food is of good Quality and served well with professional flavour staff.

hotel_name: The Saga Hotel, Green Park | New Delhi
review_text: Worst maintenance Housekeeping staff are not working properly Unhygienic Uncleaned rooms Very bad complementary breakfast Dim lit rooms No ventilation I Don't recommend this hotel at all I think management is least bothered to attend to these recurring issues. They seem to be ignoring the issues highlighted by the hotel guests constantly. Owners of this property are least bothered with these reviews putting safety & hygiene of guests at risk. Consistent poor reviews by others as well. Accomodation lodge type but price 3 star hotel type.

hotel_name: The Saga Hotel, Green Park | New Delhi
review_text: Had a very pleasant stay at the hotel. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and the overall atmosphere was great. The staff was polite and supportive throughout the stay. Special thanks to Karan Chhetri from the Front Office for his excellent hospitality, professionalism, and helpful attitude. He made the check-in process smooth and ensured everything was well managed.

hotel_name: The Saga Hotel, Green Park | New Delhi
review_text: The room can definitely be better. The cleanliness is not up to the mark and it’s very annoying that they have timings for putting on their boiler??? Especially when it’s winter outside. And the staff is very rude. He had the audacity to tell me that they can’t run the hot water for 24 hours?!

hotel_name: The Saga Hotel, Green Park | New Delhi
review_text: Our stay at Hotel Saga was quite disappointing. The property was advertised as having free parking, but there is actually no dedicated parking facility. Cars are parked on the road in front of the hotel, and when we arrived, even that space was unavailable. We had to hand over our car keys to the guard, who parked it later. The check-in process was delayed due to a technical glitch in their system, which added to the inconvenience. The room condition was poor — shabby and ill-equipped. Only one glass, one towel, and minimal essentials were provided, even though the booking was for a couple. After multiple follow-ups, the missing items were finally arranged. The bathroom lighting was very dim, the taps were in bad condition, and there was no hot water supply. We even spotted several cockroaches in the room, which made the stay quite uncomfortable. On the positive side, the security guard (Ravi) was polite and helpful. The buffet breakfast was good, and the lunch ordered to the room was served quickly and tasted delicious. The staff handling the breakfast area were courteous and attentive. Despite a few positives, the poor room maintenance, lack of amenities, and misleading parking information made this a rather unpleasant experience. The hotel needs serious improvements in cleanliness, facilities, and overall upkeep.

Excellent location . Close to multiple consulates. Rooms are huge, clean and looks up market with a lot of wood. A bit old though. Don't have a fully functioning restaurant but room service is quite good. Breakfast also was very good. They have security screening which is very good. At this price , this is the place to be in

There are sections of this Hotel undergoing renovation, rooms were clean. Toiletries were premium and other amenities there were functioning well. House keeping staff was swift with their work. Breakfast was very good.

This was by far the most disappointing five-star hotel experience I’ve had. The only saving grace was the breakfast, although the options were limited, the items available were quite good. The room itself was extremely outdated and poorly maintained. We were given what felt like the worst room possible. I’ve attached images of the broken cupboard, and unfortunately, the rest of the furniture was in a similar condition. The extra bed was also of very poor quality, making loud creaking noises every time someone sat, got up, or even turned while sleeping. The receptionist (the lady at the front desk) was surprisingly rude and completely inflexible. Thankfully, the male reception staff were much more polite, accommodating, and helpful. Overall, this hotel is not worth considering if you’re expecting a true five-star experience, especially for the price. There are plenty of much better options around Connaught Place that offer superior quality at a lower cost.

The only advantage for this is the location closer to various embassies. Not at all a 5 star hotel. Pricing does not justify the experience. Old and poorly maintained. Terrible Wifi, even network reception in hotel was horrible.

Unprofessionalism at peak. The hotel and it's staff are not client oriented. I booked hotel through trivago upon reaching there they said there is no booking under my name and they didn't have any kind of tie-up with these apps/agency.

hotel_name: Park Inn By Radisson New Delhi Lajpat Nagar
review_text: During my frequent business travel to Delhi, I generally used to stay in this Hotel due to its locational advantage. However, after my experience of stay this time I will make sure that I always stay here for my next trips. Shikha and Sunil was so helpful and exceptional in service that I must recognise them. I had a fast for a day during my stay and I had requested the chef whether he can prepare breakfast for me accordingly. Though it was out of their menu, he took special care in preparing that and Sunil personally served me with full respect and care - it felt very satisfying. During the breakfast the next day, Shikha guided me to choose special Paratha and got it served with due care. Overall, excellent experience to make me decide to always stay here in future.

hotel_name: Park Inn By Radisson New Delhi Lajpat Nagar
review_text: We stayed at this hotel with family and had a comfortable and peaceful experience. The rooms were clean, the environment was calm, and the staff was very supportive. It felt safe and relaxing. Breakfast was amazing and thanks to ‘’Ms: Shikha kumari’’she was so kind and helping. Thank you for the great service

hotel_name: Park Inn By Radisson New Delhi Lajpat Nagar
review_text: Had a very pleasant stay at this hotel. The location is extremely convenient, the rooms were clean, and all the amenities were well maintained. ATUL GAUR at the reception was very accommodating and pleasant, which made the experience even better. The check-in and check-out process was smooth and hassle-free. Breakfast was excellent, with an immense variety of options to choose from. Overall, a great stay and I would definitely recommend this hotel.

hotel_name: Park Inn By Radisson New Delhi Lajpat Nagar
review_text: I stayed for a few nights and couldn’t have been more satisfied with my experience at Park Inn by Radisson. The beds were very comfortable, the rooms were clean, and the service was excellent. The only thing I would recommend is adding more equipment to the gym, as it is quite basic. The limited space probably makes this difficult. Other than that, it was a great experience. Special thanks to Raj Kumar for his excellent hospitality at the restaurant!

hotel_name: Park Inn By Radisson New Delhi Lajpat Nagar
review_text: Stayed twice at this hotel in December 2025. Both times I stayed in the Junior suite. I found the service, hospitality, food at breakfast and also few times when we ordered for lunch, dinner or room service to be very good. I really enjoyed my stay at this hotel. The staff were absolutely wonderful.

Don't get fooled by photos and the Google location !! Yes it's in GK. But total waste of money. "ROOMS ARE IN BASEMENT WITH POOR VENTILATION. BE AWARE OF IT !!" Family suite is OK. Deluxe room had terrible smell coming in washrooms. Despite asking the staff repeated times, no action was taken. Coming to service..it's worst. No proper receptionist who can communicate professionally. There are 2 service boys who don't take any request seriously. Despite our request to get us the breakfast early so that we can leave airport on time, when we woke at 8am, they were still sleeping. Breakfast service is terrible !!

I had such a relaxing and enjoyable stay at this hotel! From the moment I arrived, the staff made me feel welcome and taken care of. The room was super clean, cozy, and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. I especially loved the peaceful atmosphere and how quiet it was at night perfect for a good night’s sleep. The location was also really convenient, with easy access to nearby attractions and restaurants. The hotel team was always smiling and ready to help, which made the whole experience even better. Honestly, it felt like a home away from home. I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and friendly stay. Can’t wait to come back again

This place is so nice and beautiful I'm visiting this beautiful hotel since 2022 and their service superbly amazing and the staff is so cooperative and nice specially Mt Rohit host of this property is so nice and gentleman Thank you team jpm for welcoming me everytime

Best hotel in this beautiful area of kailash colony very near to metro station and staff is super amazing specially the host Rohit he is superly amazing and very kind and helpful toward guest Must recommend Thank you team Jpm
The hotel is located in very beautiful place of kailash colony everything is perfect staff was very kind and helpful and rooms were very clean and tidy Will visit again thank you team Jpm

The single room had all the basic comforts for a short stay. It as not spectacular but what made the experience of staying at Minimalist poshtel was the smiling faces, friendly service and effort the staff went to to make me comfortable. Also the breakfast at the partner business was delicious I tried all the Indian options on the menu. Hauz Khas is also a charming village. I would highly recommend this hotel for short stays in South Delhi. Thank you for your hospitality and kindness.

DO NOT STAY HERE. IT IS A SCAM. I visited in January 2026 after booking online, only to arrive and find a cockroach-infested room that looked completely different to the one in the photos! If I were to give the benefit of the doubt to the company then I would say that it's possible that, when it originally opened, it slightly resembled its photos; after having the bathroom extractor fan nearly fall on me while washing (leaving an exposed electrical wire next to a running shower), and feeling cockroaches run over my fingers whilst using my laptop on my desk, I'm much more inclined to believe that the run-down, grotty, and ironically-named "Minimalist Poshtel & Suites" has never resembled the photoshopped pictures on its website, and exists only as an avenue through which to scam unsuspecting tourists with their strict no-refunds policy. I cut my 7-day stay short, and found another hostel nearby after 2 days; there are infinitely better options at the same price-point, and you won't have difficulty finding somewhere nicer at even half the price. Save yourself the time, stress, and money and skip this place entirely.

There is no maintenance. For 13K this is a scam. The property was very dirty, seemed shady and the taps in the shower not working! The furniture in the room was dusty. No iron or room fridge. review_text: Extremely disappointing experience — and unfortunately, not just once. I’ve stayed at Treebo Cabana 4–5 times now, hoping for improvement each time, but the issues remain the same. The bathrooms consistently have empty bottles — no shampoo or body wash provided. The rooms suffer from poor construction quality, with dampness and seepage in every one I’ve stayed in (a total of 6 different rooms). There's a persistent, unpleasant smell. The linens and pillows are in terrible condition — stained and unhygienic. If you remove the covers, you’ll see what I mean. It’s off-putting enough to make anyone feel sick. The front desk staff is rude and unhelpful. The manager, in particular, comes across as inexperienced and lacking basic hospitality training. It’s clear that the owner is banking on the location and not investing anything into the upkeep of the property. To add to the frustration, they are very strict about check-out — expect multiple calls pushing you to leave by 11 AM. Yet, check-in isn’t allowed until 3 PM. If you request a late checkout (say, until 6 PM), they demand ₹2,000 extra — which is absurd considering the night stay itself costs ₹2,300. I usually don’t go into this much detail, but I feel compelled to warn others: this is not a hotel I would recommend. Avoid it if you’re looking for a clean, comfortable, and respectful experience.

hotel_name: Hotel O By Oyo Kanak Palace
review_text: Extremely Disappointing Experience – Avoid at All Costs We booked an OYO room with the understanding that complimentary check-in between 10–12 p.m. is allowed, as per OYO’s stated policy. However, upon arrival, we were denied early check-in and were instead told to cancel our prepaid booking and rebook the same room offline for early access — essentially being forced to pay more for what should’ve been complimentary. When we returned at the official check-in time of 12:00 p.m., the manager still refused to give us the room. Shockingly, the app now showed an extra charge of ₹650, claiming that the number of guests had been changed from 2 to 3 — which was done by the manager without our knowledge or consent. This was in addition to the ₹720 we had already paid. I contacted OYO customer support multiple times — spoke with at least 5 to 6 representatives — yet no one could resolve the issue. Eventually, someone who claimed to be the area manager asked us to wait for 30 minutes. After nearly an hour (at 12:50 p.m.), the reception finally agreed to give us the room. However, the most humiliating part was overhearing the manager laughing during a call with OYO and mocking us, saying: “Customer bhi waisa hi, Pandey ji bhi waisa hi.” I don’t know who "Pandey ji" is, but the disrespect was unacceptable. After wasting hours, I had no choice but to leave the property — exhausted, disrespected, and without any refund. OYO’s response? They refused a refund on the grounds that "check-in was offered" — completely ignoring the hour-long wait, the manipulation of the guest count, and the unacceptable behaviour of their on-ground staff. The property itself looked hastily constructed and poorly maintained. Absolutely no support from OYO, and the hotel staff were beyond rude. Final verdict: Stay far away. This place will cost you more than money — it’ll cost you your time, energy, and self-respect.

The Ashok – A Grand Hotel That Hasn’t Kept Up With Time The Ashok certainly makes a strong first impression. The building is grand, the architecture has real character, and the staff are genuinely warm and attentive. Unfortunately, that initial excitement fades quickly once you look past the façade. The hotel feels trapped in a bygone era. Many details reveal how urgently it needs a full renovation. While the rooms are spacious and generally comfortable, the age is impossible to ignore—worn furniture, outdated fixtures, and a general lack of upkeep. The Wi‑Fi was especially disappointing; the connection dropped constantly, and even though the staff tried to help, it never became reliable. Breakfast was acceptable, but the lack of Wi‑Fi in the coffee shop meant I had to work from my room instead of enjoying the hotel’s common areas. It’s a small thing, but it adds up and makes the stay feel less convenient than it should be. What truly stands out, though, is the staff. They were consistently kind, helpful, and professional, and that does make a difference. Still, despite their efforts, the overall experience didn’t match the expectations set by the hotel’s impressive exterior. In the end, while I appreciated the hospitality, I would likely choose a more modern and better‑maintained hotel on my next visit.

The Ashok is a visually impressive hotel with beautiful, old colonial-style architecture and a real sense of grandeur. The building itself has character, the public spaces feel historic, and the room sizes are excellent — very large, comfortable, and generous by modern standards. However, the experience falls well short of what you’d expect from a five-star hotel. While the rooms appear clean, they are noticeably dated. Details like mould in the silicone around the shower undermine the overall presentation and suggest maintenance hasn’t kept pace with the hotel’s positioning. The biggest disappointment was service. Every interaction at the front desk felt rushed and disengaged. On more than one occasion, staff walked away mid-conversation, including while I was speaking about my room key. A sense of welcome or warmth — something fundamental at this level — was completely absent. My room key (5th floor) failed four separate times, requiring repeated trips back to reception just to access my room. Using the gym or pool was also surprisingly inconvenient. The pool is not integrated into the hotel experience, requiring a separate registration process with ID, taking around 15 minutes simply to "register" to go for a swim or workout. That kind of friction is the opposite of the seamless experience expected at a five-star property. In summary: Beautiful architecture and generous rooms, but dated facilities, poor service engagement, and fragmented amenities make the overall experience feel far below five-star standards. With investment in staff training, maintenance, and guest experience, this could be a truly outstanding hotel — but right now, it isn’t there.

hotel_name: Eros Hotel New Delhi Nehru Place
review_text: I'm writing this from Room #702, on the last of what has been an incredibly disappointing three-night stay (7th–10th October 2025). And honestly, I couldn’t be more relieved to be checking out. At first glance, the hotel tries to impress with an old-world charm — but don't be fooled. Beneath the vintage veneer lies a crumbling, outdated property that seems stuck in a time warp. Everything feels aged beyond comfort, and not in a charming, nostalgic way — in a neglected, worn-out, why-is-this-still-operating sort of way. The location? Smack in the middle of Nehru Place, one of the busiest electronics markets in Delhi. That means relentless honking, chaotic traffic, and a soundtrack of city noise that follows you right into your room, day and night. If sleep is what you're after, prepare for a battle. But the real horror show began when I was first given a room on the 4th floor. The moment I stepped out of the elevator, I was hit by the overpowering stench of stale cigarette smoke — the entire floor reeked like an old ashtray. This, after I’d clearly requested a non-smoking room and was told I had one. I informed the front desk I would cancel my entire stay if not shifted immediately. Only then was I grudgingly moved to the 7th floor. But the worst — and I mean truly revolting — moment came during breakfast. I asked for a simple black coffee. What I received was served in a mug so filthy, it could have been pulled out of a dumpster. Sticky residue coated the inside and outside, and mysterious debris floated in the coffee itself. I showed it to the staff, expecting outrage, urgency — anything. Their response? A casual, "Sorry, let me get you another coffee." No concern, no apology worth the name. Honestly, it was a health hazard in plain sight. For the price they’re charging, this place is a joke. The service is apathetic, the hygiene appalling, and the ambiance far from what a five-star experience should be. There are far better hotels in Delhi — cleaner, quieter, and infinitely more professional. Today, as I pack my bags, I leave not just disappointed, but genuinely baffled that this hotel dares to call itself a luxury property.

Review: A Comfortable Stay in the Heart of New Friends Colony I recently stayed at the Rose Mallow Hotel in New Friends Colony. It is a solid choice for anyone looking for a comfortable stay in South Delhi, offering a great balance of service and convenience. The Highlights: Excellent Location: The hotel’s position in New Friends Colony is perfect. It is situated in a nice, upscale neighborhood that is central enough to access the rest of Delhi easily, yet feels a bit more relaxed than the city center. Warm Hospitality: The staff here are truly a credit to the hotel. They were incredibly friendly and went out of their way to ensure I had everything I needed during my stay. Fantastic Food: One of the best parts of the experience was the food. Everything I ordered was fresh and flavorful—the kitchen team clearly takes pride in their work. Room for Improvement: The only reason I’m not giving a full five stars is the check-in process. Even though I had opted for an express check-in, it didn't quite work out as planned. Despite the pre-registration, the rooms were still only allotted at the standard check-in time. It felt like the "express" benefit wasn't fully utilized by the front desk, and I ended up waiting just like a regular walk-in. Streamlining this to honor the express option would make a big difference. Final Thoughts: Once I was in the room, the experience was flawless. If you value good food and a helpful team, Rose Mallow is a great pick—just don't expect an early entry even if you've pre-booked the express service.

review_text: I had an extremely disappointing experience with Tom & Jerry Hotel in Bhogal, New Delhi. Despite making a confirmed reservation through Booking.com, the hotel completely refused to honor it. On arrival, I was told that they do not care about the Booking.com confirmation and that such platforms are only meant to "lure customers" to the hotel. This is absolutely unprofessional, misleading, and unacceptable. Guests trust booking platforms for genuine reservations, and to be treated in such a manner is outrageous. I strongly advise others not to waste their time and money with this property.

hotel_name: Oyo Tom & Jerry Near Lotus Temple
review_text: Worst Stay Ever – Avoid This Place I booked this property because it was close to Nizamuddin station (within 2 km) and seemed decent in the photos. Unfortunately, the reality was nothing short of a nightmare. • The photos shown online and the real rooms have absolutely no match. The pictures must have been taken 10 years ago. • At check-in, the staff first showed us a room that looked straight out of a horror movie. Only after insisting and paying extra did they “upgrade” us to a room slightly better, but still terrible. • The false ceiling was broken and pieces of paint actually fell onto the floor while we were inside. • Electrical switches were broken, and the TV did not work. • The entire room had a strong smell of tobacco. • Bed bugs were crawling behind pillows and along the bedlines – I had to use my Ladakh sleeping bag just to protect myself from the itchy mattress. Even then, I couldn’t get proper sleep. • The bathroom was disgusting: hair strands left behind, ceiling in a horrific state, and generally unhygienic. • Burnt matchsticks were scattered on the floor. • The main door had a huge gap through which all the noise from outside came in. I’ve stayed in rooms for ₹850 that felt far better and cleaner than this one. For the price charged here, it felt alien to expect such poor standards. To the owner/management – you are sitting on a property in a really good neighbourhood with greenery, peace, and limited competition nearby. The location has great potential to be developed into a premium stay. But right now, it’s being run into the ground with false advertising, poor maintenance, and complete lack of hygiene.

I stayed at Hotel River View in a deluxe room from October 7 to 10, 2025. Room 404 was clean enough and very quiet. The ac and ceiling fan kept the room cool. Each day I received a complimentary breakfast and two bottles of Bisleri water. This hotel is in Jamia Nagar, the safest part of Delhi. So the overall quality of the room and its location make me recommend it to travellers.

Disappointing Experience -Would Not Recommend I had a very unpleasant stay at this hotel. The room had a serious hygiene issue — there were insects, especially small cockroaches, which made it very uncomfortable. The air conditioning was not cooling properly, making the room stuffy and hard to sleep in. What was even more frustrating was the apparent attempt to overcharge when they found out I was an OCI holder. This kind of discriminatory pricing is completely unacceptable. Booking on-site was also a hassle — the server was constantly down, and the process felt unnecessarily difficult. On top of all that, the reception staff were rude and unhelpful, which only added to the negative experience. Overall, I would not recommend staying here, especially if you’re expecting basic cleanliness, fair treatment, and professional service.
The best thing is that hotel is at good location. Where you can park your vehicle. Room is good.

Extremely Disappointing Experience – Not Recommended I had a deeply unpleasant stay at this hotel. Despite confirming the availability of an in-house kitchen, they served us stale, roadside-quality food after we placed our dinner order. When I raised concerns about the food, the staff responded rudely, questioning why we ate it if it wasn’t good. To make matters worse, they charged ₹1000 for the meal, despite its compromised quality and hygiene. We had to leave some of the food untouched. The dinner took nearly two hours to arrive, and the overall service was shockingly poor. I decided to check out immediately after this incident due to the unacceptable treatment and lack of professionalism. The staff was not only untrained but also disrespectful, unethical, and completely lacking basic courtesy. No refund was offered, and the entire experience felt like a deliberate act of negligence. I strongly advise others to avoid this hotel if they value decent service, hygiene, and respectful treatment. No guest deserves such a distressing and unethical experience.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn New Delhi Mayur Vihar Noida, An Ihg Hotel
review_text: I recently had breakfast at the Holiday Inn in Mayur Vihar, and it was easily the highlight of my morning. The meal was served at Café on 3, which has a lovely, upscale ambiance with peaceful views of the outdoor pool. The breakfast buffet is incredibly expansive and caters to every palate. What truly stood out was the hospitality. The staff was attentive without being intrusive; special thanks to the team for their polite and helpful service throughout the meal. The restaurant was clean, well-organized, and provided a very relaxing environment to start the day.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn New Delhi Mayur Vihar Noida, An Ihg Hotel
review_text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Wonderful Buffet Experience at Holiday Inn Had a great time at the Holiday Inn buffet! The spread was impressive with a wide variety of dishes catering to different tastes, from fresh salads and appetizers to delicious main courses and desserts. Everything was well-presented and tasted fresh. The live counters were a highlight — the chefs were friendly and prepared the food perfectly. The ambience was calm, clean, and comfortable, making it a great place for both family dinners and casual outings. Special mention to the staff for their hospitality. They were attentive, polite, and ensured everything was replenished on time. Overall, it was a satisfying and value-for-money buffet experience. Would definitely visit again and recommend it to others!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn New Delhi Mayur Vihar Noida, An Ihg Hotel
review_text: I had a very pleasant stay at Holiday Inn Mayur Vihar. I would especially like to appreciate the Housekeeping Department for their excellent service. Kabir did a wonderful job in maintaining my room. The room was always very clean, well-organized, and comfortable. His attention to detail and dedication to cleanliness really made my stay enjoyable. I would also like to thank Supervisor Kamal for managing the housekeeping team so efficiently. His supervision and support clearly reflect in the high standards of service provided. Overall, I am very satisfied with the housekeeping services and truly appreciate the hard work of Kabir and Supervisor Kamal.
