I had a very pleasant stay at Hotel Aarkay Place. The hotel offers a perfect combination of comfort, cleanliness, and convenience — especially for travelers visiting South Delhi. The rooms were neat, well-maintained, and equipped with all essential amenities. The staff was polite, responsive, and always ready to help, which made the experience even smoother. Check-in and check-out were hassle-free. The location is another big advantage — well connected to key areas, markets, and metro stations, making travel around Noida quite easy. Overall, it’s a reliable and comfortable option for business trips as well as short family stays. Definitely recommended for anyone looking for a value-for-money stay in Noid.

I had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The rooms were spotless, well-designed, and very comfortable. The staff was extremely courteous and always ready to help. Food quality was excellent, and the location made it easy to travel around. Truly value for money—would love to stay here again.

Amazing view from the hotel balcony and gallery. All rooms are properly ventilated with balcony and gallery/corridor with awesome view. I had booked the hotel along with its banquet, lawn and pool area for my haldi, mehendi, sangeet and wedding. Highly satisfied with what they delivered.

I recently stayed at Hotel Aarkay Palace and overall, it was a pleasant experience. I really like the design of the hotel, as every room comes with a balcony, which adds a lot of charm to the stay. The location is excellent, being nearest to Sector 94 and Botanical Garden metro station, making it very convenient. The breakfast has improved a lot compared to my previous visit in July. During my September stay, I found the breakfast spread much better with more variety. The dinner was also very good – the taste stood out, and I would give full 5 stars to the kitchen staff for the quality and flavor of the food. Room service is fine – not very good, but not bad either. There is definitely some scope for improvement in service quality. I also feel that the rooms could benefit from a deep cleaning, and the appliances should be repaired and serviced on time to maintain comfort standards. That being said, I would still recommend Hotel Aarkay Palace for its: Good location (nearest to Sector 94, Botanical Garden station) Spacious rooms with balconies Good breakfast and excellent dinner quality Friendly kitchen staff delivering tasty food With a little more attention to housekeeping and service improvements, this hotel can truly become an outstanding place to stay.

I had a very disappointing stay at this hotel. The room was in a terrible condition. There was a bad smell the moment I entered. The bed was extremely dirty, and the bedsheets did not seem clean at all. The TV was not working, and nothing in the room was functioning properly. Spending even one night here was very difficult. The washroom and bathroom were also not clean, and overall hygiene was very poor. I am highly dissatisfied with the stay and would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

My stay at Saltstayz Select was strictly average. Perhaps below average would be more accurate. The hotel is in severe need of maintenance. The lift buttons are broken, the charging point in my room was loose, the room itself was cold and the hotel won’t give you a heater. There is a general air of neglect and dereliction about the whole place. Worst of all, they have a bizarre rule about not ordering food from outside. I have stayed in hotels across the country and never have I ever come across a hotel that prohibits ordering food from Zomato or Swiggy. The hotel’s own complimentary dinner included in my reservation was tasteless. The room is decently size if you are travelling solo. The breakfast spread is decent but I don’t know why they claim it’s served from 8 to 10am. In the four days I was there, breakfast was never fully laid out at 8am. It was by 8.30 that all the dishes were brought in. The location of the hotel is good. All in all, not worth the Rs 4,000+ per night you will pay per night if you book this place. A hotel like this should not charge more than 2.5k

The other guest called the reception and then they were informed that there was some water work going on responsible for this disconnection and my sister was not informed in advance, despite you all messaging on her WhatsApp for things like check in, etc. The water did not come for more than another hour at this time. - Water ran yellow and the reception told them that since they had water work, water will run like this for some time. Even this was not informed in advance, had someone been taking a shower or dump and would end up using polluted water. - Hot water did not work at all for an entire day and the water smelled really bad. It made her washroom and room smell like sewage. She was again not informed of hot water not available. Since water itself became polluted, she couldn't use it for anything and couldn't even take a shower. She requested reception to change rooms or make alternate arrangements and none of her requests were entertained and infact, your staff there was completely ignorant and insensitive to difficulties she has had. - For the last two days, the water ran black and smelly in the toilet. The maintenance guys who came to check the issue acknowledged that there is a smell but your own management was dismissive about it. We finally reached out to the corporate office and even they did not care to respond at all. This is when we paid over Rs, 10,000 for 3 nights which is not cheap! My sister even become sick from cold exposure and unhygienic water.

I recently stayed at Mosaic Hotel in Sector 18, Noida, and overall it was a decent experience. The biggest advantage of this property is its location. Being right in the heart of Sector 18, everything is within walking distance — malls, markets, metro, and plenty of food options. For business or short leisure stays, you really can’t ask for a more convenient spot. The food was good — well-prepared, fresh, and satisfying. Breakfast had a reasonable spread and the taste was consistent. Nothing overly fancy, but definitely enjoyable. The service was awesome. The staff was polite, attentive, and quick to respond to requests. Housekeeping was prompt and the front desk was helpful throughout the stay, which definitely added to the comfort factor. The only downside is that the hotel doesn’t have a gym, which can be a drawback for fitness-conscious travellers or longer stays. Overall, it’s a comfortable and well-located hotel with great service and good food. If a gym isn’t a priority for you, it’s a solid choice in Sector 18.

Great place to stay. Extremely polite and reasonable staff members. Location is great aswell.

What a wonderful hotel and staff! I went back to the wrong room after breakfast and found it empty of our belongings. Panic!!! I notified the staff and they were quick to solve the problem and were so pleasant and courteous. A great outcome. The room is comfortable and clean. The breakfast has a huge range of interesting options including a detox water. We are looking forward to dinner!

My recent stay at Surya Hotel in Delhi was truly exceptional. From the moment I arrived, the hospitality and professionalism of the staff stood out. The check-in process was smooth and welcoming, setting the tone for a comfortable and luxurious experience. The rooms were spacious, elegantly designed, and impeccably clean. The bedding was plush and comfortable, ensuring a restful night’s sleep. Modern amenities such as high-speed Wi-Fi, a well-equipped workspace, and a luxurious bathroom added to the convenience and comfort of the stay. The dining experience was equally impressive. The in-house restaurant offered a wide variety of delicious dishes, ranging from authentic Indian cuisine to international favorites. The breakfast buffet was fresh, diverse, and beautifully presented. The hotel’s facilities, including the fitness center and other recreational areas, were well-maintained and added to the overall premium experience. Its location in Delhi makes it convenient for both business and leisure travelers. Overall, Surya Hotel delivers a perfect blend of comfort, luxury, and excellent service. I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Delhi and look forward to staying there again.

I had a very pleasant stay at the hotel. The room was clean, comfortable, and well maintained, and the overall atmosphere was calm and welcoming. All the facilities were in good condition, and the service throughout my stay was smooth and efficient. I would especially like to appreciate Alisha from the Front Office. She was extremely courteous, professional, and helpful. Her warm attitude and prompt assistance made the check-in process easy and left a very positive impression. Staff members like her truly enhance the guest experience. Overall, it was a comfortable and satisfying stay, and I would be happy to recommend this hotel to others.

So far not so good. Arrived early morning, staff we're friendly but thats the bare minimum you expect for a 5 star hotel. Rooms are nice, relatively modern surprisingly compared to rest of the main hotel area, which dated. Came back after a long day in delhi, aiming for drinks and dinner. Had drinks, and my mum and I ended up wearing one of them pre dinner, thanks to the staff member trying to take our payment. It was unintentional and he was apologetic, all fine. None of the 3 staff members who turned up to the commotion offered a napkin, or replacement drink, until prompted despite the fact the near full drink was all over our clothes and bags, along with broken glass by our feet. After dinner we went via reception and were told we'd be "looked after" by the team at the bar so went down and ordered our drinks, 2 plus a replacement of the spilled one. Bill came and we'd been charged for 2 drinks, we queried with the bar tender who confirmed with the "Manager". We called for the "manager" who, following a brief meeting with a small team in front of us(!), confirmed the stance of only covering 1 drink and that to cover anything else he'd need to check with his manager. Im still not clear what "looked after" means as service was actually worse on our second visit. Honestly its day 1 of 5 and I've been left with a sour taste. 5 star service it is not, I'd say no where close. It was the fault of someone in their team that we ended up wearing a drink, with no offer to cover a round of drinks, let alone the laundry. Its not the fact they didnt cover it either, its how the dealt with it, with no regard for the customer Service is usually pretty good in 5 star indian hotels, they usually go above and beyond and this was nowhere close. Disappointed I wish id gone with my gut and stayed elsewhere.

I stayed here on a business trip as a solo female traveller for a week and had a lovely stay, made all the more comfortable by the friendly and attentive staff (both at the restaurant and as part of the housekeeping team). I thought the restaurant food was excellent and varied, so every meal was interesting. The room was comfortable and the housekeeping staff did an excellent job cleaning it every day. The location was convenient for work. There was good security, with incoming cars checked (passengers and boot) and good communication with the staff dealing with cabs, who called drivers with cab number to come in for pick-ups. Overall an excellent experience.

Stayed here recently and overall had a pleasant experience. The hotel’s location in Sector 27 is super convenient — close to shopping, metro, and restaurants, which made getting around Noida easy. Rooms were comfortable and the staff were polite and helpful throughout our stay. The breakfast was nice and the restaurant served good food. While some areas feel a bit dated and could use some renovation, it didn’t take away from a comfortable stay. Good choice if you’re looking for a well-located and affordable hotel in Noida

And worst thing is that if someone is giving genuine review they are blaiming to the reviewer. Overall, this hotel fails to meet even basic hospitality standards. I do not recommend this place to anyone and suggest management take immediate corrective

Our stay at Hotel Meriton was quite disappointing and did not meet expectations. To start with, the check-in time is 2 PM. As per suggestion from our Driver, We ended up having lunch at a nearby restaurant and returned around 2:30 PM. The check-in process then took another 30 minutes, and even after that our room was still not ready and hadn’t been cleaned. To make up for it, we were upgraded from a Junior Suite to the Empress Suite. The Empress Suite was spacious, almost like a 1BHK, but the layout and design were not practical. The TV in the living area is placed so far from the sofa that it’s difficult to operate or watch comfortably. The bedroom TV catches the signal, but the living room TV does not work properly. There is no phone in the hall, so if someone calls the room while you’re in the living area, you cannot hear it. The room also had no proper window or view—it felt very closed and packed. Room service was below expectations. We requested slippers, but they never arrived. The doorbell in the room was non-functional, so when we ordered food and asked for room service, the staff knocked and left because we couldn’t hear them while watching TV in the living room. The food quality and presentation were also disappointing. The aloo kulcha was served without any proper accompaniment. The dal khichdi came without curd or raita. The masala papad was served with the papad and masala separately, so we had to assemble it ourselves. Breakfast the next morning was also not pleasant. Breakfast timing was until 10:30 AM, and we went at 9:45 AM, yet most of the items were already finished and not replenished. The pav for pav bhaji was extremely hard, idli was available but the sambar was finished, poha was cold, and the boiled corn tasted off. It felt like the breakfast service had already wrapped up before time. The hotel entrance is very small and can accommodate only one vehicle at a time, with no proper space to move around. Additionally, the hotel is very close to the metro line, and throughout the day we could constantly hear the sound of trains passing, which made it difficult to relax. Overall, while the room upgrade was appreciated, the lack of readiness at check-in, poor room service, maintenance issues, and disappointing food and breakfast experience made our stay underwhelming. With better service coordination and attention to detail, the hotel could improve significantly.

My stay at IIDL Suites in Mayur Vihar, New Delhi, was marred by a serious invasion of privacy that left me feeling unsafe and disrespected. Although I had deliberately opted out of housekeeping service (no "Clean my room" request selected, and no need for it that day), a male housekeeping staff member entered my occupied room uninvited and without proper announcement. I caught him in the act inside the room and immediately asked him to leave. His lame excuse? He claimed he rang the doorbell three times, got no answer, and decided he had the "right" to let himself in anyway—for housekeeping that I hadn't even requested! This isn't just poor training; it's a blatant disregard for basic guest privacy and boundaries. No waiting for permission and just assuming entry is fine because the guest didn't respond. In what world does that make sense for a supposed "luxury" serviced apartment? When I reported this disturbing incident to the front desk receptionist, their response was infuriating: they shrugged it off as "routine" practice. No apology, no concern for my discomfort, no assurance that it wouldn't happen again or that the staff would be corrected. Instead, they defended the behavior as normal! It's shocking that the management at IIDL Suites allows—and even normalizes—such intrusions, treating a paying guest's explicit preference for privacy as "optional". Shame on the management for cultivating this cavalier attitude toward guest safety and respect. In any professional hotel, especially one rebranded from Fraser Suites and trying to position itself as upscale, staff should never enter an occupied room without clear permission, particularly when service hasn't been requested. A simple acknowledgment of the mistake and an apology could have salvaged the situation, but their indifference speaks volumes about their priorities: apparently, "routine" violations trump customer comfort. This property's history of rebranding (from Fraser Suites to IIDL) suggests ongoing issues, and if they continue tolerating this kind of incompetent, boundary-ignoring staff without accountability, it's no wonder they struggle to maintain a strong reputation. If you prioritize your personal privacy, feeling secure in your room, and being treated with basic courtesy, strongly avoid IIDL Suites. There are far better hotels in Delhi that actually understand hospitality and respect guest requests. Save yourself the frustration and book elsewhere!

hotel_name: Hotel O Om Villa Residency Near Lotus Temple
review_text: Honestly, Om Villa Residency is one of those places that looks good in photos and on booking sites—but when you dig deeper, it disappoints more than it satisfies. Location is decent—you get close to Lotus Temple, East of Kailash/Sant Nagar, Garhi Village area. That’s a plus. But that’s pretty much where the positives end for me. First problem: what you see online vs what you get in person. The rooms are far from the clean, spacious, well-kept pictures. On my last visit, the frontage looked okay, but once inside, there were signs of neglect—paint peeling, fixtures loose, cleanliness not maintained to things you expect at that price. Second: staff and service feel inconsistent. Sometimes they act helpful, but more often they seem uninterested. When asked about basic things—extra towels, cleaning, water pressure—it took too long or was met with excuses. It gives the impression that once you check in, their energy and care drops. Third: cost surprises. Even if you book online, confirmed price, sometimes on arrival they try to add extra charges for “service,” “housekeeping,” “security,” or claim certain amenities are extra. That feels unfair. If I book, I shouldn’t have to fight to get what was promised or be charged extra without clear explanation. Fourth: amenities are over-promised. Free WiFi—is there, but often weak. AC may struggle. The room sizes are smaller than expected. What is shown as modern features or comforts don’t always perform well. It doesn’t feel like value for what they charge. Lastly: the overall vibe is underwhelming. For the price and their branding, I expected better maintenance, better hospitality, less of that “bare minimum” feel. Might be okay if you just need a cheap place to crash for a night, but if you expect comfort or reliability, this place lags. But i think that's what we get @ that price in delhi 😅

Stayed at Hyatt Centric Janakpuri New Delhi and it was a genuinely comfortable, well-run experience with a nice balance of “business hotel efficient” and “weekend stay cozy.” The location in Janakpuri worked well for west Delhi plans, and getting around was fairly easy with malls, cafés, and metro access nearby. Check-in was smooth and the staff came across as professional, quick, and actually attentive instead of rehearsed. The room was clean, quiet, and well maintained. Bedding was comfortable, the bathroom felt modern, and housekeeping was consistent. I also liked the little practical touches: enough charging points, good lighting for work, and solid Wi-Fi that didn’t behave like it was doing you a favor. Soundproofing was decent too, which matters in New Delhi. Breakfast was a highlight: a good spread with both Indian and continental options, and the service stayed steady even during the busy rush. I tried a couple of meals beyond breakfast as well and found the food quality reliable, with portions that felt fair for a five-star property. The lounge and common areas were pleasant for short meetings or just winding down. If I had to nitpick, peak-hour traffic around the area can add time to your commute, so plan accordingly. Overall, it’s a strong option if you want comfort, great service, and a polished stay without unnecessary drama. Would happily stay again.

The rooms were spotless, linens were perfectly arranged, and common areas were consistently clean throughout the day. What truly stood out was the attention to detail and quiet efficiency of the housekeeping team. India Trip Reviews 11/many Trip detail- Gate 1 Travels' 12 Day Golden Triangle of India with Varanasi Located near the airport, this was the second hotel we stayed at, the other being the much nicer, but much further away, Eros Hotel in Nehru Place. The lobby was modern-looking with friendly enough staff. There is a gift shop in front, though no ATMs, so if you need cash, you have to go to the ATM outside in a non-air-conditioned space. The room we stayed in was a bit smaller than the rooms at the other hotels we stayed at, but it worked for being an airport hotel. The shower pressure was decent, and the internet connection was pretty solid. They had a surprisingly large number of restaurants here. There was a Chinese place called Pinch, which we would have tried if we weren't with a group. The main dining room was buffet-style and the largest we visited at any hotel. While it was the largest, the food quality wasn't as good as our hotel in Agra, but it was still better than Eros or the hotel in Jaipur. Regarding the food, I would recommend ordering more appetizers and small plates, since the curries and other main dishes aren't the best. A good example would be Sarson ka Saag, which was bland and had way too much ghee. For dessert, there's a nice selection of ice cream, along with pretty solid Seviyan Kheer, cakes, and other treats.

The only point that needs attention is cleanliness — during the first few days, I developed a strong allergy due to the noticeable amount of dust. The floor tiles make loud noises whenever you walk. The washroom was in terrible condition — the toilet seat was leaking, and the washbasin tap was completely broken. review_text: We hosted our wedding at Orana Aurnum. About 10–12 days before the event, we visited the venue and sat down with Robin, the manager. During that meeting, we finalized all the elements for the bridal entry—like smoke bubbles, a glass walkway, and a few other details—and clearly confirmed everything from our side. At that point, it was the manager’s responsibility to record everything accurately and inform us of any extra charges (which he did mention, and we agreed to). However, on the wedding day, none of the things we had discussed were arranged. When we contacted the manager, he shifted the blame onto us, claiming we hadn’t confirmed or paid for any additional services. This was extremely disappointing, especially because we had already given our approval. Expecting WhatsApp confirmation—something he never communicated to us—is not a professional way to handle clients, and using that excuse on the wedding day felt unacceptable. The only reason I’m giving 2 stars is because the food was excellent and the staff was polite. Otherwise, please be extremely cautious when planning your special day here.

hotel_name: Hotel Amrapali Grand - New Delhi , Patel Nagar , 4 Star Hotels
review_text: Decent Stay with Scope for Improvement Stayed at Hotel Amrapali Grand, Patel Nagar from 25th to 28th October 2025. It’s a decent hotel with basic amenities and a good location right on the main road, close to Rajendra Place Metro Station (Blue Line). Public transport — bus, taxi, auto, and metro — is easily accessible. Pros: Convenient location with easy connectivity. Housekeeping staff (especially on the first floor) were prompt and kept the rooms clean. Rooms have electric kettle, tea/coffee setup, and bathrooms are equipped with dental kits, soap, and shampoo. Towels changed daily. Breakfast spread is good, and the tea and coffee taste excellent. Cons: Being on the main road, there’s continuous traffic noise. Disturbance from other guests late at night — despite complaining thrice, it wasn’t resolved. Reception staff were not very welcoming and a bit slow to respond. There is no place to sit in the reception, like a couch or a sofa could be better as soon as you enter with luggage. Breakfast quality could be improved — good variety but average taste. Cleanliness and room service could be better. Faced issues with checkout date and advance payment, but staff did rectify both quickly once pointed out. Overall, it’s a reasonably priced hotel suitable for a short 1–2 night stay, especially for those prioritising location and basic comfort over luxury.

Food - complimentary breakfast - nothing tasted good other than poori and sabji. In room dining - food was good, however felt overpriced for the taste and quality. Staff - most of the staff and welcoming and greet you with a smile.

review_text: We recently celebrated a party here and everything was beautifully arranged! The decoration, planning, and coordination were all on point. The food was absolutely awesome tasty, fresh, and enjoyed by everyone. Great service and a perfect venue for special celebrations. Highly recommended!

review_text: Very disappointing experience at Hotel Amrapali Grand. The room was not clean, and we even found cockroaches — totally unacceptable for a place claiming to be a 4-star hotel. The hygiene and maintenance were poor, and the overall service didn’t meet basic standards. Definitely not worth the money.

review_text: Budget hotel with good food and friendly staff. However, the rooms are small and cable TV was not available despite multiple requests. The location was not very convenient for me, though the area felt safe due to nearby hotels.

hotel_name: Hotel Cosmo Near Blk Max Hospital
review_text: DON'T BOOK THIS HOTEL AT ANY COST! I booked this hotel in October 2025 late night because it was near where I was. 1. It's located in a residential area - has no parking and has a public ground next to it. Online they listed the property having parking on premise. 2. The ground had an event going on with a huge gathering and a lot of noise going on. I believe it was a religious gathering of sorts. 3. Hotel listed the rooms incorrectly on online platforms. There was a room listed as 440sq ft. In reality it wasn't even 140sq ft.. The hotel staff agreed to refund and cancel the booking the next morning after my disagreement. The next day they denied to refund the booking amount. I had just made the booking 10 minutes ago and paid online - my mistake to have paid them online before reaching there. Lesson learnt to stay away from these shady lala hotels in Karol Bagh ran by scammers.

hotel_name: Hotel Cosmo Near Blk Max Hospital
review_text: Each and every staff of the hotel are very good and very cooperative. Located in a very proper place. Metro station is near the hotel. The locality is safe and secure at the night time also . Very neat and clean rooms and washrooms. We have stayed twice there and found everything excellent.

What I Loved - Very friendly and helpful staff - They listen and solve problems quickly - Rooms were very clean - Good storage space and safe in the room for valuables Room for Improvement - No information card in the room with WiFi password, front desk number, or hot water timings - Bathroom sink tap had weak water flow Important Note If you book the Superior Room on MakeMyTrip, the bathroom might look different from the photos. I highly recommend this hotel. The location is excellent, and above all, the staff were genuinely polite, sincere, and professional. Unfortunately, I stayed at this hotel at the very end of my India trip, but it more than made up for a very unpleasant experience I had at another hotel in Delhi earlier in the journey, which was in a similar price range. In particular, I was deeply impressed by the receptionist staff, Adnan and Abhinay. Their calm, respectful, and quietly warm manner stood out. After feeling exhausted from constant bargaining, overcharging, and performative friendliness aimed solely at taking money, their attitude allowed me to finally relax. I would say that this sense of emotional relief was a decisive factor in making my stay here truly restful. I would also like to mention the staff members who held the doors and the housekeeping staff—although I regret that I cannot recall their names. Their gentle and courteous demeanour left a very positive impression. The room was clean, comfortable, and very good value for money, with well-maintained amenities. Overall, I was extremely satisfied with the quality of the accommodation. Thanks to this hotel, the frustration and distrust I had developed earlier towards mid-range hotels and service attitudes in Delhi were significantly eased. If I return to Delhi in the future, I will certainly choose to stay here again.

We stayed at The Suncourt Hotel Yatri and overall it fully met our expectations. The hotel is not the newest and you can see that in some details, but everything was clean, functional, and well maintained. The room was comfortable, the staff was helpful, and the location worked well for exploring Delhi. For the price and category, it delivered exactly what we needed — a reliable and comfortable base for our stay.

I had an excellent stay at Suncourt Delhi .The staff were extremely courteous and made me feel very welcome. My room was spotless, spacious. The breakfast was delicious. The hotel’s location is very convenient, and the overall ambiance .Special thanks to the team for their attentive service.

One night is all it takes for me to leave a very good review. Had a good experience with them. The hotel staffs were very accommodating and welcoming. From the front desk to the buffet staff were very friendly. Would recommend it to anyone who is looking for comfortable stay while staying in Delhi. The foods were really good and had both veg and non-veg selection both were delicious.

Very good service all the way from front desk to room service, to catering. The experience was very good and all the staff was very kind. Special mention to Akash, Anil Kumar, Uday and Manoj. Definitely will be coming back. Food was immature too, authentic indian breakfast every morning.

The experience was average — not bad, but not particularly good either. One downside is that as soon as you step outside the hotel, you are immediately approached by beggars, and the security staff don’t seem to make much effort to manage the situation, which can feel uncomfortable for guests. On a positive note, the breakfast was very good. The food was served hot, fresh, and tasty, which was definitely a highlight of the stay.

Extremely Disappointing Stay – Not Safe, Not Worth the Price The room was much smaller than the standard size, yet the charges were higher compared to other hotels. We were three guests, and although an extra mattress was provided, the bed quality was terrible. The bedsheets were smelly as if they had not been changed, and the pillows were dirty with an unpleasant odor. The worst part was the behavior of the reception staff. We had another friend who initially planned to leave the hotel after a few hours and not stay overnight. However, his plans changed around 1:00 a.m., and he decided to stay. The receptionist became extremely irritating, repeatedly calling and disturbing us at night, demanding his ID and insisting on extra payment. Even after we provided the ID, they refused to give an extra mattress but still demanded ₹500 just for him to stay in the room. This constant disturbance made the entire night stressful. It is unacceptable to be charged extra without providing any additional facilities, and the repeated late-night calls showed a complete lack of professionalism and respect for guests’ comfort. Based on my experience, I strongly advise avoiding this hotel. It does not feel safe, the staff are unprofessional, and the service quality is far below the amount they charge.

Staff behavior is so rude, un professional. Charge extra money 500 if some visitors come for meet Room is so small not proper space Swich board not working in room Not provide water bottle Bathroom was unclean with water looking in sink strongly requesting for skip booking

Terrible Experience – Not a Safe or Professional Hotel I had an extremely bad experience at Persona Hotel, Delhi, and I strongly advise against booking this hotel—especially for solo travelers or women. I made a 3-night booking through Agada and paid the full amount in advance. On the morning of my travel (March 8th), I called the hotel to confirm my reservation, and they confirmed that my room was booked under my name (Chetna). I also informed them that I would be arriving late at night, and they assured me there was no issue. However, when I landed in Delhi around 11:30 PM and was heading to the hotel at 1 AM, I had trouble locating it. I called the hotel for guidance, but to my shock, they suddenly claimed there was no booking under my name! I told them I had called earlier, and they had confirmed my booking, but they rudely said there were no rooms available and told me not to come. Stranded in Delhi at 1 AM with nowhere to go, I had no choice but to reach the hotel anyway. When I arrived, they again refused my booking and told me they don’t accept Agada bookings anymore. If that was the case, then why was the hotel still listed on Agoda? The worst part? They demanded extra money for a room despite my full payment already being made. With no other options at that hour, I had to pay them extra just to get a room. Once I reached my room, they pressured me to lie to Agoda, saying I stayed somewhere else so I could get a refund. This shows how dishonest and unprofessional they are. The next morning, they even denied my complimentary breakfast and said I needed to pay extra. When I told them I would vacate the hotel immediately, they suddenly changed their stance and offered me the breakfast. This hotel is not safe for women, highly unprofessional, and a scam. They take bookings, deny them at check-in, and then force guests to pay extra at odd hours when they have no other options. I do NOT recommend this hotel to anyone. If you’re thinking of booking here, avoid it at all costs!
Hotel staff and management are good In service. Want to visit again

The ambience and services are top notch And also Hotel staff special thanks to Chandan Gupta the at the reception and also with the guard who took the luggage And all services including food chef and food are awesome 👍

I would strongly advise against booking this hotel. I suffer from asthma, and the room I was given was damp and smelled strongly of mould. The pillows were also mouldy, and even the slippers provided in the plastic containers were wet and covered in mould. I immediately requested new pillows, but the air quality in the room was still unbearable, so I had to switch rooms with my friend. Unfortunately, even the second room was not much better, and neither of us could sleep comfortably. The food was also disappointing, served from a bain-marie and clearly needed reheating. Overall, this was one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve had, and I do not believe anyone should have to endure such conditions.
Service was top. Staff very cooperative. Walking distance to Karol Bagh. Food in restaurant v nice.

Amazing Stay at Hotel L Affaire. Himangshu Ji from management team is very helpful.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Excellent Stay — Truly Feels Like Home! We stayed here with our family in November–December last year, and it truly felt like home. From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel so welcome — always smiling, polite, and ready to help with anything. The food deserves a special mention — simple, tasty, and just like home-cooked meals. We could happily eat here every day! The rooms were clean, comfortable, and spacious, with daily housekeeping done perfectly. The location is excellent — right on the main road, easy for guests or visitors to reach, and just a short walk from Karol Bagh market where you can find everything from shopping to great eateries. We had such a pleasant experience that we’ve already recommended this hotel to many friends and relatives. Truly a wonderful place for families — safe, friendly, and full of warmth. 💫

Excellent Stay at Sanca International Hotel. I had a great experience at Sanca International Hotel. The room was clean, neat, and well-maintained, with spotless bathrooms and all the basic amenities provided. I really appreciated their flexibility with both late check-in and late check-out, which made my travel schedule much easier. Daily room cleaning was available and done promptly, keeping everything fresh throughout the stay. The staff were polite, helpful, and always had a pleasant attitude. One of the highlights was the location – it’s situated in a quiet and decent area, which felt much more peaceful and safer compared to many other hotels in the city. Overall, it was a comfortable and pleasant experience, and I’d definitely recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a hassle-free stay.
Kundan took complete ownership of every request. His helpful attitude and professionalism made the entire experience smooth and enjoyable. Truly appreciate his exceptional service!
Very big property on the main road opposite to hotel Sidhartha. Luxury & big rooms Nice interior But Charges are very high Arrogant staff

Good wifi. Great location near to bus station. The water worked perfectly, with good pressure and temperature. The food was delicious, and the sheets were clean and fresh. I had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The people here are extremely kind, polite, and always ready to help, which made my experience even more comfortable. The location is perfect — everything is easily accessible and conveniently located nearby. As a girl traveling alone, I felt completely safe and secure throughout my stay. The hotel maintains good security measures, and the environment feels very welcoming and respectful. All services are practically at your fingertips — whether it’s room service, assistance at reception, or any other support, everything is quick and user-friendly. The rooms are comfortable. The overall ambience is pleasant and relaxing. I would definitely recommend this hotel, especially for solo female travelers, families, and business travelers. Looking forward to staying here again!

Our stay at Bloom Hotel Karol Bagh was truly wonderful. I was travelling with my parents, both senior citizens, and the experience was exceptionally comfortable and reassuring. The rooms were clean, well-appointed, and serviced promptly. The in-house restaurant deserves special mention for its delicious food and thoughtful menu. What stood out most was the warm, polite, and genuinely hospitable staff, always ready to help with a smile. From room service to dining, everything was handled with care and professionalism. Overall, a brilliant stay and a hotel I would highly recommend to families and senior travellers.

My stay at Bloom Boutique Karol Bagh was extremely disappointing and far below the expectations created by its popularity. Although the room was clean, the size was very small and quite uncomfortable. The larger concern, however, was the service, which was highly unprofessional. The front office staff appeared uninterested and showed little concern for guest comfort. Room service was painfully slow — my order took almost an hour to arrive, and when it finally did, the food was cold and tasteless. To add to the frustration, the TV in the room was not working as the balance had apparently run out. When I raised these issues, a staff member named Nikhil behaved rudely and did not take the complaint seriously. What was even more surprising was that one of the staff members mentioned they are severely short-staffed, and employees are made to do multiple roles — the receptionist acting as a bellboy, and so on — almost like a “carry-on” system rather than a properly managed hotel. For a hotel that is so heavily promoted, the overall experience was extremely poor and the service standards were far from acceptable. Certainly not a place I would recommend.

We were 3 people and I had pre-booked for additional person , still expected I will have to talk to the reception about it during checkin. However it was a seamless comfortable checkin experience. Rooms were clean and good and NO cover up of smell with room freshner. Breakfast is pure veg and modest. However, good hotels are available for swiggy or zomato. Walkable hotels are mostly south cuisine restaurants, both Kerala and Tamil cuisine. Price could be for the brand as facility wise could have been priced 3k to 4k range.

You will see that there are excellent reviews for this hotel. Although there are sometimes reasons to doubt some of the reviews on TripAdvisor – ha ha, the great reviews for the Bloom Hotel are completely well deserved. The hotel is an excellent value because the rooms — and all the hotel is spotlessly clean. The staff is helpful and friendly. The neighborhood is quite lively, it may not be for all types of travelers, but it suited us quite well for a few days. The breakfast is served in a fully functional restaurant next-door, and every day the buffet changed. They serve delicious Indian food, and we were quite happy. I especially appreciated the help of their manager Prahlad, who took care of housekeeping. If we ever needed anything, they always took care of it.

hotel_name: Alaya Stays By Elivaas Emperor Palms - Hotel In Delhi

hotel_name: Hotel Le Roi Express @ Karol Bagh
review_text: Nice hotel for business travelers. I would not recommend for family travelers as the rooms and bathrooms are small. Staff is co-operative. Please not that they do not allow early check in or late checkout if you have not booked them directly. Breakfast is okay. Buffet breakfast is available only if they have sufficient occupancy. But they will serve you well even if the buffet b'fast in not there.

hotel_name: Hotel Le Roi Express @ Karol Bagh
review_text: I initially booked some other hotel but had to cancel it last moment due to unforeseen situations. I booked this hotel in last moment and I must say I was impressed by their service. 1. They cooperated with me without complaints even though I did a late checkin around 8 PM. 2. The rooms were spacious and the space management was done well unlike an another overpriced "Yellow" hotel. 3. The locality was very good, Gaffar market, metro station and lots of good restaurants at walking distance. 4. Foreigner friendly and local ID was acceptable which was great. 5. The staff was very professional and cooperative. They helped book an early morning cab to the airport for me which saved me a lot of hassle in this foggy weather. Overall, one of my best hotel stays so far and I will consider this hotel for my foreign friends and me hereafter.

hotel_name: Hotel Le Roi Express @ Karol Bagh
review_text: The hotel is in a good location. The rooms are clean. The breakfast is delicious and varied. Sumit, Katarya, and Umesh are polite and provide good service. They are very attentive.

hotel_name: Hotel Le Roi Express @ Karol Bagh
review_text: Nice simple hotel! Staff (especially Rahul) made me feel at home! The rooms were small but clean and had all the essentials. Fairly accessible by public and a great market nearby

hotel_name: Hotel Le Roi Express @ Karol Bagh
review_text: It’s a perfect location for people who come for visa interviews. Embassy is 20mins away and it takes only 15mins to Sarai rohilla. It’s in the market so find everything around . Rooms are clean but i found them a little congested. Service is good with polite and cooperative staff. My parents do not eat onion and garlic, so they made few items without onion and garlic in breakfast. easy to find cabs. so altogether my experience was good.

hotel_name: Jaypee Siddharth - 5 Star Luxury Hotels In Delhi

Special Kudos to Mr. Laksham at IRD service, Mr. Rajeev at the restaurant & Mr. Vishal at the Restobar (Tapas).. Would recommend this place to all.. Closer to Metro which has connectivity to all major places in Delhi. Closer to Karol Bagh & other prominent places.

hotel_name: Jaypee Siddharth - 5 Star Luxury Hotels In Delhi
review_text: I stayed a week in India and from these days (the first and the last) in this hotel. I called to bring them to me and the answer was that they have ... run out. The breakfast is aimed at domestic customers and unfortunately not at all for different preferences. Their prices are 5 stars with 2 star services. Compared to other hotels I stayed in India, it was definitely the worst and I would never stay there again

This hotel will definitely be our preferred choice for future meetings and events.

Another thing I didn’t like was only men seemed to work there. However, we had dinner at the restaurant and it was nice. Breakfast was good. A Solid Value-for-Money Stay in the Heart of Karol Bagh Rating: ★★★★☆ (4/5) I recently stayed at the Paradise Inn in Karol Bagh, and it was a pleasant experience that offered great value for the price. Here is a breakdown of my stay: The Highlights Spacious & Comfortable: The rooms are surprisingly big, providing plenty of space to move around. The beds are very comfortable, and I was pleased to find the linen crisp and clean. Storage: The room features a nice wardrobe equipped with enough hangers, which is a small but much-appreciated detail for keeping clothes organized. Exceptional Service: The staff was very accommodative. They went out of their way to help me, even agreeing to provide my next-day breakfast on the first day of my arrival to suit my schedule. Location & Accessibility The hotel is located deep inside a crowded market. The Downside: Cab navigation can be quite difficult due to the narrow, busy lanes. The Upside: If you are a shopping enthusiast, the location is perfect! You are right in the middle of one of Delhi’s most famous shopping hubs, with everything you need just steps away. Room for Improvement The only real drawback was the washroom. While functional, it could definitely be cleaner. The commode and basin felt a bit dated and could use an upgrade to match the quality of the bedroom. Summary: Despite the tricky navigation and the average washroom, the Paradise Inn is a great pick if you want a large, comfortable room and excellent service without breaking the bank.

There was a large gap between the window and the wall, allowing cold air to enter even when everything was closed. Because of this, along with mosquitoes in the room, my family and I fell sick during our stay. Although the staff tried their best and were very polite, the overall condition of the rooms and facilities was not worth the price we paid.

hotel_name: Hotel Sun International- Budget Hotel Near New Delhi Railway Station
review_text: Comfortable and safe stay for families We stayed at Hotel Sun International with our family and had a very pleasant experience. The hotel is easy to reach and located close to New Delhi Railway Station, which made our arrival and travel very convenient. The staff was very polite and supportive. They helped us with extra towels, guidance about local travel, and made check-in smooth even with children. Everyone was respectful and friendly. Everything needed for a family is close by — food outlets, pharmacies, shops, and ATMs are within walking distance. We didn’t have to travel far for daily needs. Tourist attractions, markets, and shopping areas are very close, making it easy to plan outings without long travel. For the price, this hotel is a great choice for families. Clean rooms, safe environment, and helpful staff made our stay comfortable and stress-free. We would definitely recommend Hotel Sun International to families visiting Delhi.

I have attached images as proof of the dirty bed sheets, broken dustbin, filthy slippers, broken flush, window condition, and overall room state. Avoid this hotel at all costs. This place is not worth your money, your time, or your health. One of the worst hotel experiences I’ve ever had.

His support and fast service made the stay smooth and comfortable. Highly recommended.

I had an excellent experience during my stay. MD Manjar Alam provided outstanding service and made sure the hotel room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. His hospitality and attention to detail were truly impressive . All the hotel staff were also very polite, helpful, and professional throughout my stay. Their teamwork and friendly attitude made the experience even better.

The hotel is Good for family amoungest others nearby, safe and nearly walkable Distance from NDLS Railway Station. Both Managers are very cooperative, I travelled here from 2800km away, night shift manager took my prebooking and he promised for what we accepted. Morning and Night House keeping staffs are really excellent. I stayed here for 4days, with my continues changing schedules. Only thing is, it is very crowded as it is near to Railway station. Parking is very difficult. Give respect and take respect policy is nice to be in harmony. My kids enjoyed... Thank you HOTEL SHELTON

The hotel was really great and Mr. Shahid made sure that the checking in process was really smooth. The hotel's location was right in the market so it was really convenient and close to popular fast food places. Will definitely stay here again in the future

Room is very congested no proper ventilation. Room have only that space 2 feet in front of bed so u can go to washroom thats the space in room with bed. If you give this tiny room to someone give it in 1000 to 1200 u charge 1700 for this small room. Room is clean bedsheet is clean, cleanness is good staff is good but for small room 1700 is not worth it. For single person room is good under 1300 but for couple not good or in 1700 not good for single person.

I have been staying at Hotel Hari Piorko from 15th February 2026 and will be checking out on 21st February 2026. My experience here has been extremely pleasant. The hotel maintains a very clean and comfortable ambience, and its location is prime and perfect, just a short walk from R.K. Ashram Metro Station, making travel very convenient. The staff members are courteous, cooperative, and always ready to assist. A special mention must be made of Bablu at the reception, who consistently goes beyond his duty to ensure guests feel comfortable and well taken care of. The food quality is good, and both the restaurant and room service are outstanding. Service is prompt, and the staff respond quickly whenever contacted. Importantly, the hotel respects guests’ privacy and does not disturb unnecessarily. Overall, it has been a highly satisfying stay, and I would certainly recommend this hotel to others looking for comfort, convenience, and excellent service.

The best stay during our short visit in Delhi. It was a moment which we felt like we have been abundant in the streets of Paharganj and finally we found this magical hotel. Event though the hotel located near the dusty main bazaar street the atmosphere inside the hotel was amazing. Their staff was so friendly. Especially front office staff members Roshan and Bubloo were so helpfull. They have a wonderful restaurant which serves outstanding food 24x7. Mohan and Suraj were the most humble and nicest restaurant assistants we have ever seen and we felt them like friends and brothers. This place is a Gem and we are pplanning to visit again soon. Cheers from sri lanka.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent Stay at Hotel Hari Piorko I had a very pleasant experience staying at Hotel Hari Piorko. The biggest advantage of this hotel is its prime location—just a short walk from New Delhi Railway Station and close to the metro, which makes traveling around Delhi extremely easy. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The bed was cozy, the room size was decent, and all basic amenities were provided. Housekeeping did a good job, and the overall hygiene standards were satisfactory. The staff was polite, cooperative, and helpful throughout the stay. From smooth check-in to assisting with queries, their behavior was professional and welcoming. Room service was prompt and reliable. Another highlight is the 24-hour restaurant, which serves tasty food with good variety. The quality of meals was good, and it’s very convenient for late-night or early-morning travelers. Considering the location, service, and comfort, Hotel Hari Piorko offers excellent value for money. It’s a great choice for tourists, business travelers, and anyone looking for a comfortable stay in central Delhi.

Good hotel for a short stay. It is well connected to prime areas of Delhi, making it convenient for travel around the city. The room was clean, and the staff were nice and helpful throughout the stay. The only downside is the surrounding locality, it is located in the center of a market area, which makes the outside quite crowded and busy. Overall, a comfortable stay if you don’t mind the market hustle outside.

I had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The facilities were clean and comfortable, but what really stood out was the service. Bablu at the reception was an exceptional manager-he was incredibly helpful, welcoming, and went out of his way to ensure everything was perfect during my visit. It’s rare to find such attentive service. Highly recommended!

Hotel Pink offers good service and responds quickly. Rooms are small but neat and clean. Only the stairs are not good for the old ages. You won’t face any issues with blankets or hot water. The rates for AC and non-AC rooms are the same. Food, tea, etc. are available at the hotel, but they’re charged separately. The hotel is located right in front of New Delhi Station. There are plenty of other hotels and food stalls in the area. Your safety is in your own hands.

​"Had an excellent stay here! The room was spotless, modern, and surprisingly quiet given the central location. The staff went above and beyond to make us feel welcome, and the breakfast spread was delicious with plenty of variety. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Delhi!"

1) Hotel is Near Station Area.(But in crowded and small lane) 2) Rooms are Small (Neat and Clean) 3) No Separate Geyser (Hot water is made available through common Boiler whenever required) 4) Staff is cooperative. 5) Slightly Expensive ( I was charged Rs 2000 for a room, with a Big + small bed for 2 Adults + 2 Children. 6) Mobile Network Coverage very poor. (Wifi with good speed is available)

Very bad service,on advance booking receiving from rly station but no done, our checkin was 1.00pm but we have provided the room till 7.00 pm as they have no ready room. They have provided prontha of KHATTA ATTA.We have checkout at 12pm, they have asked to give us 100% rating and we will deliver your luggage at Rly station. But at 4 p.m they have refused to do. Qult is also wear and tear. Please be aware while booking room.
Room is neat and clean and bathroom is also clean. I got quick service which I really liked. Overall this is a good place to stay.

hotel_name: Hotel The Magic Tree - Paharganj New Delhi
review_text: Absolutely loved my stay! The property is beautifully maintained, super comfortable, and gives such a warm, homely vibe. Every detail is taken care of, and the hospitality is just top-notch. I genuinely recommend this place to everyone looking for a perfect, hassle-free stay. Definitely a 5-star experience!

hotel_name: Hotel The Magic Tree - Paharganj New Delhi
review_text: Rooms are smaller than images, sevice is not that prompt. Gave me extra mattress having a hole in it. Rooms are cleaner. Taps were leaking Location is not great but manageable.

hotel_name: Hotel The Magic Tree - Paharganj New Delhi
review_text: Hotel rooms were pretty dreary. Our room's bathroom ceiling was covered in mold, and the paint showing signs of damp in the room. The aircon broke down and wasn't addressed when asked so had to come back and change room after our day. Bed sheets also has food debris on them so needed them changed.

hotel_name: Hotel The Magic Tree - Paharganj New Delhi
review_text: A very lovely hotel to stay with the family very warm vibe and affordable. You can come and visit with your family and friends and have a good time.

hotel_name: Hotel The Magic Tree - Paharganj New Delhi
review_text: Disappointing experience wouldn’t recommend I had a very unpleasant stay at Magic Tree Hotel, Delhi. The staff were quite rude and unhelpful, making me feel unwelcome throughout my visit. Even worse, after eating food from their restaurant, I experienced severe stomach upset and loose motion. Overall, the service and hygiene standards were far below expectations. Definitely not worth the price — I wouldn’t recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a comfortable or safe stay.

hotel_name: Hotel Ajanta - Free Airport Pick Up Service
review_text: We stayed in early March 2026. It's a great place to stay so close to the New Delhi railway station (NDLS). It's also vwry easyto get autos to and from the hotel. A taxi can also drop you & your luggage right at the doorstep. It's one of the best hotels in this price range I've stayed across many cities in India. The room was very comfortable although just a tiny bit squeezy - not enough place to keep 2 luggage bags open, but was still manageable. Toilets were very clean with unlimited hot & cold water. The AC was nice and cool but had a bit of a damp smell as they had not been used for a long time during winter but the hotel said that they're slowly servicing all the ACs, which is great. Breakfast was good. Cleaner and more options than most hotels in this price range. We got a middle room, so there was no window but I think that is what made it so quiet.

hotel_name: Hotel Ajanta - Free Airport Pick Up Service
review_text: This hotel was a 10 out of 10 for me. I travel extensively and I have never seen such helpful and friendly staff. Everyone from cleaning staff to reception alto restaurant were absolutely wonderful. Aman the hotel manager went above and beyond to give me helpful tips and arrange for transportation. On the last day he booked a city tour for me The driver was Hardish and he spent the entire day driving me around Delhi from one historical monument to another. As a foreign woman travelling alone in what can be a chaotic city, I felt very comfortable with Hardish. He was really great and I highly recommend him for any in out or out of town tours. I wish I had found him the first day I got here. All in all, this hotel and everyone associated with it was great.

hotel_name: Hotel Ajanta - Free Airport Pick Up Service
review_text: Good hotel. Great tour team - Mr Amaan who arranged our 2 day Delhi tour, with our excellent, helpful and English-speaking driver Mr Riyaz who we got to know and he provided lots of information about sites and culture. The breakfast was nice and restaurant team good, particularly Sarendra and Shyam. Generally the reception team tried to address room issues. The only thing is there were a few times the hot water was not working.

hotel_name: Hotel Ajanta - Free Airport Pick Up Service
review_text: We arrived in Delhi in winter, in January. At first, we stayed in a random hotel without heating, and it was quite cold at night — we even slept in our sweaters. After a few days, we came across Hotel Ajanta and decided to move. The price difference was small, but the conditions were much better: the room was warm, there was hot water, and everything was clean. The staff were helpful and responsive, and they are available even at night, which really mattered. We would also like to mention the hotel’s guide — very charismatic, a bit like Al Pacino 🙂 He was friendly, knowledgeable, and not pushy at all. He explained how to get to many interesting places on our own and gave useful advice. We booked a trip to Agra to see the Taj Mahal through him. The car was comfortable, the driver was professional, and on the way we stopped in Vrindavan, which was a nice addition. Everything was well organized and stress-free. Overall, we had a very positive experience. Prices were reasonable, and the arrangements felt reliable since everything was organized through the hotel.

hotel_name: Hotel Ajanta - Free Airport Pick Up Service
review_text: The hotel service was excellent. I was especially impressed with my packed breakfast that I had requested at 5.30 am in the morning. Location is very close to New Delhi Railway station which has it's own pros and cons - like more traffic jams- but quick ten minute walk to the station. My room was good, maybe except the fact it must've been close to the alley nearby because there was a lot of disturbance at night with people talking, bikes moving. Otherwise- very happy with the stay and the food. Room service was excellent. Food from the cafe nearby was very good. I was late to checkout, but staff were very polite and helpful. Impressed with service overall. Thanks a lot for a wonderful stay!

The room was okay. I have paid 1500 per night, so considering the Payment, the room was fine. I have travelled solo. The best part in the Hotel is their food. The half egg fry, they make is very good. Almost all the items are very very good.

Not worth it. Only book if costs less than ₹1000. Here's why: - Family suite Bathroom had no door lock. - Dirty blankets clear brown & red patches on both blankets, even the replacement blankets aren't clean. - room had broken electrical plugs. - they didn't even provide water. Attaching pictures for your reference

The room service is excellent and the staff are very friendly. Odia-speaking guests can communicate in their native language, as the manager is from Odisha. I recommend this hotel to anyone visiting New Delhi for its affordable rates and luxurious stay.

Hotel is really very nice, rooms are neat and clean. Staff was co-operative. Only thing i have a problem is that parking space is very less and conjusted but not a big deal. Overall experience was good.

Very good hotel. Staffs are friendly. I liked the malayali aunty in the reception who is very friendly and helpful as I am also froms Kerala. I really recommend this hotel to anyone visiting New Delhi.

Happy with this hotel,Its an excellent peaceful property for all kind of travellers. Its strict about any disturbances to travellers and are very caring like a home family member. Miss Kaur Mr Anish and all the reception personnel of the hotel are very perfect about making travellers have a comfortable stay Everything is perfect. Food of hotel is exceptional Great location! The street is crazy busy and fun and very central. We had a lovely room, it was a haven from busy Delhi! Enjoyed a nice meal on the rooftop bar, the staff were great and there was a great choice! As female travellers we felt completely safe there!

The stay was good for the budget. Rooms were neat too. Hotel staff were accommodating. Only downside would be the room service food which was technically prepared outside the hotel in a small space right beside the main entrance which I found to be a lil odd and not the cleanest since the kitchen is right off of the road. Otherwise pretty good.

I would not recommend this hotel based on my experience. Hotel to Hospital journey The check-in process was smooth and the room itself was decent. Room service staff were polite and responsive. However, there are serious shortcomings that overshadow these positives. The hotel provides hot water only in the morning between 6 am and 12 pm. There is no hot water available at night, which is extremely inconvenient, especially during winters. This limitation was not clearly communicated at the time of booking. The biggest disappointment was the restaurant. They advertise a rooftop restaurant, but it exists only in name. Service was extremely slow and unprofessional. Orders took anywhere between 45 minutes to one hour, with no accountability or clear communication from the staff. We were so frustrated that we decided to leave and eat outside, but the staff convinced us to stay and assured quick service. Eventually, food was served after another long wait, but the quality was extremely poor. Every family member faced severe digestion issues, including vomiting. The situation was serious enough that we had to rush to the hospital the very next day. This was a disturbing and unacceptable experience. We informed the reception about the food quality and the health issues caused. While they assured us that action would be taken, no one ever followed up or contacted us again. Overall, this stay caused stress, health issues, and disappointment. Due to poor restaurant hygiene, lack of accountability, and misleading claims, I would strongly advise others to avoid this hotel.

Booked this hotel for family trip. The rooms were good and well maintained. There were no windows in the room but still rooms were very well ventilated. The room service was good they cleaned the rooms almost daily and food was also good. There is a roof top restaurant we mostly had dinner there as it had cozy garden roof top ambience. My stay here was comfortable. Definitely recommend this hotel if someone wants to stay near the new Delhi railway station area.

If you already know this location, you might be able to manage staying here — but if you’re a first-timer in Delhi, never choose this place. It’s located in the middle of a very crowded local road. If you stand even for a second on or near the roadside, there is a 200% chance a bike or rickshaw will hit you. There are countless two-wheelers, people walking, running, cooking, eating, selling, buying — everything happens on the road itself. In the photos, the hotel looks like a five-star facility, but the moment you enter, you’ll realise it’s a complete mess. If you’re a foreigner who wants to experience the “raw” side of India, this might be the place for you. But if you’re someone visiting Delhi for the first time from outside the city, this experience might make you never want to return. Now, about the rooms: the booking price is around ₹2,000–₹3,000 and advertised as a “premium deluxe AC stay,” but the rooms are actually very basic and worth maybe ₹1,000 at best. The rooms are old, not soundproof at all, and you can hear constant honking, as well as staff laughing and talking throughout the night. They claim the kitchen is open at all times, but the options are very limited. No black tea or coffee during breakfast, and the breakfast itself is just for namesake — nothing proper. All this could still be tolerated, but the front desk staff is not friendly at all, especially the older man who comes in the evening and the lady at the desk. They never smile — unless you’re a foreigner. The older man always talks in Hindi, and often in a rude tone, as if we are staying there for free. I will never choose this place again, and I strongly advise non-Delhi natives not to stay here. You will end up hating this stay — and possibly the city itself.

Great location – perfect for first-time tourists. The area feels very safe to walk around at night, and it’s easy to catch an Uber from the hotel without any hassle outside. The lobby has a relaxed yet business-like atmosphere, which makes it feel calm and professional. The rooms are spacious, and the bed was very comfortable – I had a great night’s sleep. I also liked that there were both soft and firm pillow options. The air conditioning works well too. The breakfast buffet has a very good selection, including live egg and dosa stations, which was a nice touch. The only downsides were that the hotel food and drinks are quite expensive – I paid £25 for two glasses of wine and £20 for a few kebabs and two small lassis. The hairdryer in the room isn’t great, and the shower leaked slightly into the main bathroom area. Overall, I would stay here again because I know I’ll sleep well and feel safe in this location.

Top notch location in the heart of New Delhi. The check in was fast. The room was very weird in its architecture and bed and did not provide me a sense of top star hotel. Maybe it’s time for some refurbishing. Although it had all the amenities one need. I checked in around 1030 pm and ordered food. The service was quick to my liking. The sleep quality was decent too, although I woke up late as I slept late. Unfortunately by the time I reached for the breakfast around 1025 am it was almost being cleared off. Thus cannot comment on the spread. I ordered an o letter , an americano and a few pieces of fruits which was left over. Infact had to fetch my own cutlery as the staff did not hand over after requesting twice. Anyway might be a good pick due to it’s excellent locational advantage

Very comfortable rooms, really nice beds. The best bit about a stay in every hotel for us is attention to detail. The staff especially Harsh and Lham were absolutely great and I hope they continue to be seen and recognised for their hardwork by the team. Location cannot be beaten for anything, you are right there!!!!! From a Happy customer in Delhi…

As always my stay at Park was very comfortable. This property is located right in heart of delhi, walkable distance to connought place and other markets. Check-in process was really quick, smooth and efficient, entire staff were very welcoming, attentive and courteous, ensuring a pleasant stay. They very well understand the challenges of travelling if required they promply help us by providing early check in and late check outs which is one the best gesture by the reception team which makes me always choose my stay at "The Park" each time i visit delhi(Thanks to Ms Ruby for taking care) After a long flight it feels very relaxing. The room was beautifully designed spacious, spotless, and equipped with every modern amenity. They always maintain an elegant ambience throughout the property. Dining at the hotel was very good, thanks to chefs and kudos to the entire restaurant staff, every meal was delicious, beautifully presented and served with a wide variety of options to suit all tastes. The hotel facilities were world-class — from the serene spa and well-equipped fitness center to the stunning pool was the perfect place to relax and unwind. Overall, Exceptional service, luxurious comfort, and genuine hospitality made my stay truly memorable. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a premium experience! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

The Park Hotel, Delhi – Birthday Stay ✨ We stayed at The Park Hotel, Delhi for my wife’s birthday, and the experience was truly wonderful. The hotel delivers a genuine 5-star experience with its elegant ambience, excellent service, and warm hospitality. A special mention to Manish from the hotel staff, who was extremely supportive throughout our stay. His polite attitude and helpful nature made us feel truly taken care of and added a personal touch to our celebration. Our room was clean, modern, and beautifully arranged.Dining at the hotel was another highlight — the food was delicious, and the service was exceptional. Overall, it was a beautiful and comfortable stay, and The Park Hotel made our celebration perfect. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a luxurious stay in Delhi.

Had a wonderful stay at Le ROI Delhi Hotel! ⭐ The location is extremely convenient, especially for travelers since it's very close to New Delhi Railway Station. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The staff was polite, helpful, and always ready to assist with anything we needed. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and the overall service was excellent. The hotel also offers good amenities and the value for money is great for anyone visiting Delhi. I would definitely recommend this hotel to travelers looking for a comfortable and convenient stay in the city. Looking forward to staying here again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

It was nice to stay in the hotel. Felt safe. Room was spacious and tidy. Good room service. Checkin and checkout was easy. Hotel is located close to both railway station and metro and hence good connectivity. Hotel is located in a crowded and live street.

It was comfortable stay and staff are highly cooperative. Room was clean. If you don’t prefer hustle bustle of Pagar Gunj it’s not for you, however, I come from core of Kathmandu, it looked like my own place. Breakfast was good. Price of BF and room are also fair given the cost of living of Delhi.

This was one of the worst hotel stays we have ever experienced. The hotel completely failed to meet even the most basic standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and hospitality. To begin with, the bedding condition was disgusting. The blanket provided was torn, the bedsheet was dusty, and the bed liner was filthy, covered with visible stains and spots. After sleeping on this bed, we developed rashes, which clearly shows how unhygienic and unsafe the bedding was. This is absolutely unacceptable and poses a serious health concern. The room facilities were another major letdown. The hotel website clearly mentions that rooms are equipped with a kettle and fridge, but neither was available in our room. This is false advertising and misleading for guests. The handwash bottle in the washroom was dirty and sticky, making us question whether the bathroom had been cleaned at all. Basic amenities were not provided proactively. No drinking water was kept in the room, and we had to ask for it explicitly, which should never be the case in any hotel. Even after repeated disappointments, the service continued to get worse. The TV connection was cut off before our checkout time, which is extremely unprofessional and inconvenient for guests who are still staying in the room. The behavior of the receptionist was equally disappointing. Instead of being polite or helpful, the receptionist was rude, uncooperative, and lacked basic courtesy. There was no apology or concern shown when we raised issues, which reflects very poor customer service and management attitude. Overall, this hotel shows complete disregard for guest comfort, hygiene, and honest service. It is not worth the money, time, or stress. I would strongly advise travelers to avoid this place unless they want to risk their health and deal with extremely poor service. This hotel does not deserve a recommendation under any circumstances.
