review_text: Had a wonderful stay at Hotel Glow Inn. The rooms were clean, well-maintained, and very comfortable. Staff members were polite, cooperative, and always ready to help, which made the stay even better. The location is convenient and peaceful, perfect for both business and family stays. Overall, great value for money with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommended—would definitely stay here again!

hotel_name: Hotel Glow Inn-3 Mins Walking From Ndls
review_text: Had a fantastic stay at Hotel Glow Inn Paharganj-3 Mins Walk From NDLS Rail Station. The location is perfect—just a 3-minute walk from New Delhi Railway Station. Rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. Staff was polite, helpful, and ensured a smooth check-in. Great value for money and highly recommended for anyone visiting Delhi!

hotel_name: Hotel Glow Inn-3 Mins Walking From Ndls
review_text: I had a great stay at Glow Inn Hotel, located right in the heart of Paharganj, New Delhi. The location is perfect — it’s very easy to commute to different parts of the city and the New Delhi Railway Station is just a short walk away. The staff here are friendly and helpful, always ready to assist with anything you need. The food is really good, and the service is excellent too. Overall, it’s a comfortable and convenient place to stay for travelers.

hotel_name: Hotel Glow Inn-3 Mins Walking From Ndls
review_text: Pros: Location is 10 min walking to New Delhi station and all restaurants are nearby. Cons: Non AC room doesnot justify Rs 1400 per day at the condition of the furniture and room. Room No 312 had nearly 50 cockroaches at checkin which was later brought to control through repellent. Do not be deceived by the colourful photos posted by the property, as reality doesn't go close to that. Rs 300 was charged for early check-in at 8am instead of 12pm, which is pure business, as we checked out at 7am instead of 12pm and we stayed for less than 24 hours paying additional Rs 300. Hotel is a lot shabby and so so, but definitely the price doesn't justify the amenities.

hotel_name: Hotel Glow Inn-3 Mins Walking From Ndls
review_text: Recently, I had an opportunity to stay at this hotel during my visit to New Delhi, and I must say that the overall experience turned out to be extremely pleasant and comfortable for me and my family. I would definitely consider this hotel as one of the best options available near New Delhi Railway Station, especially for travellers who are visiting the city with family members. The location itself is one of the biggest advantages. It is situated just around 500 meters from the New Delhi railway station, which means you can simply walk to the hotel without having to spend money on a cab or auto. This becomes even more convenient when you are carrying luggage or travelling with children and elders. Another highlight of the hotel is the spacious room arrangement they provided. The room we booked had six beds, and this was something that suited our big family perfectly. Many hotels claim to offer family rooms, but very few are actually prepared to accommodate large families comfortably. However, here we were provided with a room that was absolutely suitable for all of us, with enough space for everyone. The room was neat, properly arranged, and very comfortable for a long stay. Spending time inside the room was actually relaxing, something we did not expect in such a busy and crowded locality like central Delhi. One of the most impressive aspects of this hotel is the behaviour and nature of the hotel owner. He is a very humble, polite, and genuine person. From the moment we contacted him for booking, he communicated everything clearly and honestly. Whatever he promised before arrival, he fulfilled after we reached. There were no hidden charges, no last-minute changes, and no confusion. The room that he assured us was exactly the same room that we received. Nowadays it is difficult to find hotel owners who speak kindly, keep their word, and actually treat customers with respect, so this was truly appreciated by us. We also liked the hospitality of the staff. They were helpful, responsive and treated us with respect throughout our stay. Every time we needed anything, they attended to us quickly with a friendly attitude. The cleanliness of the room as well as the washroom was maintained very well, and we could clearly notice that hygiene was given importance. This added a very positive feeling to our stay. The hotel is also located right in a well-known shopping market area. So, if you are someone who enjoys shopping or wishes to buy clothes, accessories or gift items, this location is very convenient. We could easily go out, walk around, explore shops, and return without needing any transport. After checking out items in the nearby marketplace, we realized that staying here gave us a lot of convenience compared to staying in other parts of Delhi. Overall, I personally felt that this hotel is highly suitable for large families who want a safe location, comfortable rooms, and a helpful hotel owner. The combination of spacious accommodation, excellent location, and polite service makes this hotel a very good option. So if you are planning a family trip to Delhi, especially near New Delhi Railway Station, I would strongly recommend choosing this hotel. Our stay was extremely satisfying, and we truly felt our money was worth it.
The hotel had a very pleasant atmosphere and was extremely comfortable. The travel manager, Anil, was a very nice person and treated us kindly. He provided the service at a very reasonable price.

​The hotel was close to some really delicious restaurants and in a very convenient location. Anilo was so kind and even showed me around Delhi. It was a wonderful stay and very reasonably priced! He was very kind,

Great location and service staff were good. Hotel is situated near multiple foodie hotspots. However, the cleanliness of the rooms were appalling. The floor and bedsheet/blankets was sticky. Even sighted some blood stains on the bed sheet.

Very neat and clean hotel Staff is good, and plus point is prime location.There is no resturant inside the hotel but they allow zomato Swiggy and all good restaurants available near the hotel like Nazeer and all.

During my visit to India, I had the pleasure of staying at Hotel Bright, and I couldn't be more satisfied with my experience. From the moment I arrived, the staff made me feel incredibly welcome with their warm hospitality and genuine professionalism. The room was spotless, well-maintained, and very comfortable, offering a perfect space to relax after long days of exploring. Every detail showed their commitment to cleanliness and guest comfort. What truly made my stay exceptional was the staff — always attentive, friendly, and ready to assist with anything I needed. Their welcoming attitude made me feel right at home. I highly recommend Hotel Bright to anyone visiting India and looking for a clean, comfortable stay with top-notch service. Thank you to the entire team for making my trip so memorable 💖

Second room had no hot water, the toilet was extremely dirty. The door had no lock, even when the guest house owner tried to prove that it can be locked from the outside.

The managers Lokesh and Naveen are so kind and professional. If any problems they will solve it quickly. This is an affordable hotel with good price and good people. I really enjoyed my stay. Everyone has good energy and very respectful. They will accommodate you the best they can. I stay here while recovering from an accident and I felt safe. Everyone here truly cares about your well being.

“Sorry sold out” scam: We booked the room the same day and when we arrived late at night, they pretended that they already put everything on “sold out” early in the morning and that they do not have rooms left. I already know that scam so i just waited till he could finish his theatre performance and accepted the “oh we found one room” offer. The room was 10times worst than on the pictures, hot water not working, wifi is a rare seen guest. But we did not really had an other choice because it was late at night and we already payed online. I don’t think they do it with everybody but just be aware this may happen when you arrive late.

As some of you may know, India is one of the most disorganized places in the world. This "hotel" in Delhi practically demonstrates that reality! To begin with, the rooms are dirty and old, the Indian diners are very noisy and don't let you sleep at night. To top it off, the manager made the mistake of assigning me a violent taxi driver to take me to the bus terminal, tried to charge me an extra 200 rupees to turn on the AC, and drove aggressively and rudely the entire way. Also important is that the hotel is right next to a garbage recycling center, so you can imagine the smell... In my opinion, never go there!!

A bit tricky to access, narrow lane off busy Main Bazar this is a very peaceful, quiet place only 2 minutes from the Bazar. Very close to Metro & Rail. A bit tired but clean with really helpful staff. Great value also.

When we arrived, main bazar and area looks terrible but hotel is very good. Staff is very polite cooperative and very nice, it is family hotel and budget friendly they provide warm water at any time and hygienic food . Rooms are nit very aesthetic but still its very nice hotel overall for stay

Great staff and quiet Hotel. Just remember it is Delhi so as long as you know what to expect then this is a good choice. It is quiet and safe. Linen is clean for Delhi. Toilets are basic but it is no worse than elsewhere. Spacious room. Good prices. Good location for this. This is the real Delhi.

When we arrived at the hotel, we initially felt a bit uneasy as it wasn’t located on the main street of Paharganj bazaar. However, after calling the hotel staff, they guided us to the property, which was about a 100-meter walk. They also kindly helped us with our luggage. To our surprise, the room they provided was excellent , far better than we had expected for that area. It was clean, and the air conditioning worked perfectly. After several days of travel, the cozy and comfortable atmosphere was just what we needed. The rates were also quite reasonable. When it was time to leave, the staff once again assisted us by carrying our bags to the main road and loading them into our cab.

The Corus Hotel is perfectly located in Connaught Place which makes travel very easy. However, room size is small and maintenance can be improved. Cleanliness was average. Staff support was decent. Good for short business stay but price feels slightly high for the room quality.

The location is the best for a tourist in Delhi. We were a family from Goa visiting Delhi for just two days & wanted to shop. Booked two rooms. The Hotel is placed on the first floor right next to Cafe Coffee Day above Out of the Box restaurant. The Metro station is right outside. This hotel is just a one station metro ride to Chawri bazaar, Chandni Chowk, Delhi main railway station, Red Fort, etc. Palika Bazaar is just 400 metres away, Connaught Place is full of amazing branded shops & fantastic eateries. The rooms were comfortable & clean for double occupancy but no windows. Thankfully we were given rooms away from the restaurant below as there was loud music played late in the night on Christmas Eve. They provide basic toiletries & hot kettle with tea coffee in the room. We got a great deal on Agoda. The vibe is young & happening in the area. We were there for the Christmas weekend & area was extremely crowded. They also have room service. Reception staff were cordial & helpful. Ample street & Palika Bazar parking.

I had an excellent stay last night! The room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The staff were incredibly polite and helpful, always ready to assist with a smile. The ambiance was peaceful, and all facilities worked perfectly — from the Wi-Fi to the room service. I truly appreciate the attention to detail and warm hospitality. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a relaxing and comfortable stay!

A small hotel at prime location, at inner circle of Cannaught Place has given us perfect comfort for family stay in comfortable budget. Service was excellent. Staff was very helpful, specially Ms. Meena at reception desk. The only shortcoming was that walls inside rooms were just simple and decent, not decorated in fancy system. But it didn't affect our quality of stay.

Good hospitality by the hotel and very good staff, especially Meena and Khushi. Location is also very good. Got transport services from hotel itself through Anil Sairam travels, which is also very good. Overall, very good experience.
Very dirty hotel and very poor service washrooms, rooms , beds, insects all over the room
Staff is very irresponsible Rooms are not clean No working of geyser Washroom very dirty

Rooms are very dirty, Bathrooms are not at all clean full of bad smell, And moreover I booked a hotel through goibibo, intending to stay at Hotel Pink City. However, due to an goibibo app error, my booking was made for Hotel Vishal in New Delhi. From March 3 to 8, I checked into Hotel Vishal, and they verified my booking details before providing me with a room. Later after one hour that morning , the hotel staff informed me that while my voucher mentioned Hotel Vishal, the payment had been credited to Hotel Pink City. They asked me to vacate the room and move to Hotel Pink City. When I contacted Hotel Pink City, they confirmed receiving my payment and asked me to check in there. As a result, I was unnecessarily charged ₹1001 for 30 minutes stay at Hotel Vishal. Despite the mistake not being mine, they insisted that I pay, claiming I had occupied the room for hour, The staff was harsh in their approach, and I ended up losing ₹1000 unnecessarily at both hotels.

Filled with cockroaches, dirtiest linen ever, disgusting place. One cannot pay and stay in such a filthy place. I booked for 1 night from Goibibo. Remove this property if you don't want your rating to drop.

Its my 2nd time visit in this hotel. I was here in 2018.. This time i came here as solo traveler. The room was good... In my room floor tiles was broken. They didn't provide any toiletries. No Soap, No Shampoo.. TV wasn't working. washroom fitting was old. Room wasn't that clean. Overall its an average hotel to stay in Delhi Paharganj. Room rent was 1200 rs for a night. One good thing is Hotel Located at good place... Nearest metro access is only 3/4 min walking distance. Stuff behaviour was very good and helpful..

hotel_name: The Leena International- By Haveliya Hotels
review_text: We stayed at Leena International when we reached Delhi. Our train was delayed, so we arrived quite late, but despite that, the staff was extremely supportive and understanding as we already had a booking. They kindly allowed us to freshen up, which was very helpful as we had to leave for Pushkar soon after. We also enjoyed a very tasty lunch there. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. Overall, the service and hospitality were excellent, and everything was smooth and pleasant. A good place to stay, especially when you need a supportive and convenient stopover.

hotel_name: The Leena International- By Haveliya Hotels
review_text: Stayed here for two day business trip, it shows that hotel is 4 star but it is not. No clean towels, they dint even clean the room. When I went to reception to ask for water they told call kitchen and ask, when I mentioned you dint clean the room or gave new bottles he rudely told okay I will send upstairs. If your room is towards road side then there is so much noise throughout the night. Bathroom doesn’t have proper divider. Bedsheets are also dirty. During check out not even offering to help with bags or basic etiquette to open the door. Wouldn’t recommend

hotel_name: The Leena International- By Haveliya Hotels
review_text: Absolutely terrible stay! This hotel was a complete disaster from start to finish. The room was filthy — the toilet was brown, the towels were dirty, and the shower didn’t even have a proper divider, so the entire bathroom got soaked every time we used it. The showerhead was broken with a big hole in it, and the door wouldn’t even lock properly. We gave our key for room service, but the room wasn’t cleaned the entire day. Meanwhile, the staff were hanging out and laughing right outside our door. When we tried to speak to the manager, he was rude, dismissive, and completely unprofessional. To make it worse, we booked and paid a rate that was three times higher than usual, yet when we went for breakfast with four people, they refused to serve us, saying it was only for two — even though we paid much more. We’re now also dealing with a payment dispute because the hotel refuses to take responsibility. Honestly, this was one of the worst hotel experiences we’ve ever had. Avoid this place at all costs!

hotel_name: The Leena International- By Haveliya Hotels
review_text: Stayed multiple times in Leena Hotel mainly because of the hotel's location as it is in the main road. rooms are also good & comfortable. Food is consistently great, all of this makes me come back here. A special thanks to Gaurav in reception - for accommodating special requests every single time I have visited. Highly recommended, one of the best place to stay in Paharganj area.

hotel_name: The Leena International- By Haveliya Hotels
review_text: This property is located on main road one of the delhi market. (Paharganj) which is very busy and crowded, good for family and solo travellers who come for shopping and exploring markets, hotel is nice, clean and well maintained offering hygienic rooms, The reception team and entire staff are warm and welcoming, always guiding us with the right information based on our needs. they have 24/7 restaurant and kitchen service, they ensure safety of travellers. And thanks to sevaz for your service.
Nice hotel for family and friends near to railway station, clean and well maintained rooms they arrange our tour for delhi local sight seen and agra,
Very well maintained and clean rooms, All facilities such as AC, Geyser and drinking water has been provided👍👍
BEST ROOM AND ALL FACILITIES AVAILABLE

Every rooms of this hotel is not really good with security and comfortability, nevertheless not value for money. Really had a worst experience in this hotel and also they are not refunding the money. After all they already mentioned about 100% refund in AGODA APPLICATION and many more, though they ain't giving back...👎

At the price the rooms are offered, the hotel is fine. The locality is not high class but okay in vicinity of New Delhi railway station. You may have trouble finding this hotel but the rooms are very affordable. If you are short on budget, this will offer you a descent deal. The rooms are small but you are also paying less. There are better and bigger rooms as well for which you should contact hotel staff.

No hygiene, there is no proper ventilation in the room. Very congested rooms , also blankets and pillows with bad odour. The management is poor , they don't even provide the dental kit for free, you need to pay even 10 rs for the colgate toothpaste. Bad experience. Not recommended for family and couple. Room stinks. Lift doesn't work properly.

The hotel is very old, and the room provided was not clean. There was dampness and mold on the ceiling and walls, which was completely unhygienic. Water was also constantly dripping in the bathroom due to dampness, making the hotel unsuitable for staying in.

Property is very nice. But their TV doesn't work. If we have to ask for the tv staff says we can give free channels only. If you are calling that we have to book room, TV is working . Staff says they are sold out, but booking shows online. Rather th They do not even provide just a TV to Guest. Unbelievable and unexpected.
Hotel rooms are near and clean and staff also very good. Overall experience was amazing

I recently stayed at Hotel Nirmal mahal in Delhi Paharganj and had a fantastic experience. The hotel's location is ideal, with easy access to Nearest Metro Ramakrishna ashram Marg metro and New Delhi Railway station and local attractions. The rooms were clean, spacious, and well-maintained, offering a comfortable stay. The staff was exceptionally courteous and attentive, always ready to assist with a smile. The service was prompt, and the hospitality made us feel right at home. The ambiance of the hotel is both peaceful and inviting, making it a perfect place to relax after a day of exploring Delhi. Overall, Hotel Nirmal mahal exceeded my expectations, and I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area. I look forward to staying here again on my next trip!

The worst hotel I ever seen. I lived in this hotel for 4 night there is so many cockroaches in their room when you going to complaint not any help occurs.. The high speed internet they claimed 😂😂 is less than your 2g internet speed when I complain about it after some time they come and said now recheck when I check in front of them they were gone after looking condition. Prices of food is so high.. Also the all staff and specially receptionist is very very rude. If you complain about anything they misbehave with you and said this is very small problem.. But when you go for any help he say this is not dharmshala. Attitude like hotel services like toilet. No hot water nothing that they claim

The room itself was not up to standard. It was not properly cleaned . dust on surfaces, and the bathroom had a noticeable odor. Basic amenities were either missing or not functioning properly. For the price paid, this was completely unacceptable. I raised my concerns with the front desk, but the response was dismissive and no effort was made to resolve the issues. Overall, the stay did not meet even basic expectations for comfort and service. I would not recommend this hotel and will not be returning.

I booked through one of the trusted online platform, Agoda. Saw the pictures of the room, selected and booked. The payment was to be done at the hotel itself, no advance booking. As soon as we reached the hotel, they asked for the payment first in full. You cannot see the room first as you have already booked. They gave us a small room hardly any space to walk around. Damp smell, not even clean bed sheets, no ventilation or window. Phone lines not working, tv not working, AC was broken. Washroom was worst, flush not working properly, sink pipe was broken so the water was flowing all over the washroom floor. We went for a business trip and had no other option but to book online before reaching. Do not trust blindly.

Rooms are in very bad state. Need urgent basic renovation. Found flies and mosquitoes in room. No hot water in taps in month of Jan. Many other better options nearby. Only positive was that location was good, near to NDLS railway station. The staff was also ok.

From the moment I arrived, the service was unwelcoming and disorganized. Check-in took far too long, and the staff seemed uninterested in assisting guests. Very disappointing stay. The room was not clean, staff were unhelpful, and the overall service did not match the price paid. Noise levels made it hard to sleep, and issues raised were not properly addressed. I would not stay here again.

Hi Very disappointing stay at Hotel Harsha International. I stayed here for 3 days and faced multiple issues. Hot water was not available at all, the bathroom lock was not working, and the blanket provided was extremely dirty. On top of that, the staff was very rude and unhelpful. Overall, it was an uncomfortable and unpleasant experience. I would not recommend this hotel to others.
Things like are Good but It was better if bedsheets were changed with cleaned one. You may find cockroach roaming. Otherwise, people on duty listen to their customers.
All is well, for management staff and owner also , Neat and clean, low price, Best rooms

I recently had the pleasure of staying at this hotel, and I must say, it was an exceptional experience. The staff member Shobhit Singh and Rishi were incredibly friendly, helpful, and went above and beyond to ensure my stay was comfortable. The room was spotlessly clean, spacious, and well-appointed with all the necessary amenities. The hotel's location was perfect, within walking distance to all major attractions. Given the high quality of service, amenities, and location, I found the hotel to be excellent value for money. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a comfortable and enjoyable stay. Rating: 5/5 stars. If you're seeking a top-notch hotel experience, look no further! This hotel exceeded my expectations in every way.

I stayed at Harsha International Hotel on the night of January 11th, and my experience was unfortunately very disappointing for several reasons: Poor Location and Accessibility: The hotel is located on a narrow, congested, and poorly maintained street, making it very challenging to find. The lack of proper signage or directions further added to the frustration of locating the property. Unhygienic Conditions: The cleanliness standards were unacceptable. The towel provided in the room, as well as the bedsheet and blanket, were visibly dirty and seemed not to have been cleaned or replaced in a long time. This level of hygiene is far below acceptable standards and raises serious concerns about guest safety and comfort. Lack of Basic Amenities: The hotel failed to provide essential amenities that every traveler expects. There was no small handwash soap, which are basic necessities for any guest. Even there is no towel, further highlighting the lack of attention to guest needs. Inadequate Room Size and Comfort: The room was extremely small, offering minimal space and making the stay uncomfortable. The cramped environment left little room for movement or relaxation, detracting from the overall experience. Unsuitable for Families: The area surrounding the hotel is not ideal for families. It felt unsafe and unwelcoming, making it unsuitable for guests traveling with children or elderly family members. Overall, my stay at Harsha Hotel did not meet even the most basic expectations. The lack of cleanliness, essential amenities, and a family-friendly environment, combined with the poor location, makes this property far from ideal for any traveler. There is an urgent need for improvement across all aspects to provide a satisfactory guest experience.

I stayed at this hotel before I returned to Israel. It's not a good hotel. The rooms and reception are neglected, the employees are not very nice, the clerk asked to see a Booking.com reception code that I received in the email. Only in retrospect, after I showed him the code, did I think why he asked for it, probably to cancel my reservation from their system or to try to steal my credit information (my card was not saved in the system, so it was impossible to harm me, at most he could have improved his personal situation somehow). At first he wanted to put me in a room on the first floor that was filled with mothballs (they use them to kill insects). After five minutes, I started to get a headache because of them and I told him that I couldn't stay in the room and asked to change. He resisted at first, saying that they would clean the room of the mothballs, but I insisted and then he offered me another room with fewer mothballs, and after I refused the second room as well, he put me up on the third floor and offered me a room with only two mothballs, so I agreed to stay in this room. After the clerk left, I collected the two pills with toilet paper and got rid of them, aired the room, and was relieved. But this is a place I would have avoided. The nearby Casa Central is much better, and in general it is better not to stay in this neighborhood and maybe give up Delhi altogether. New Delhi is the only place I have traveled to in the world that I do not want to return to (and I have traveled to over twenty different countries and hundreds of cities). Maybe if I stayed in a different neighborhood in Delhi and did not travel alone or with a local, it would be a different experience, but I have no desire to return to Delhi under any circumstances.

People who rated >2 stars must have been paid otherwise I can't explain. Normally I never leave a negative review but I hope that this will help all the people that searching for the next stay in Delhi. 1) this hotel is in one of the worst part of Delhi, where the smell, noise, people screaming, cows mooing at night it's regular 2) bedsheets had stains, I found hairs, I only hope there weren't any bedbugs..I wouldn't be surprised in case.. 3) the bathroom was not clean, and no amenities were given, toilet paper was missing for example 4) although I paid for the breakfast, they only had one dish out of the entire list they show. Either you eat that or you don't have breakfast, unbelievable 5) they haven't cleaned the room at all the day after This is not how a 3 star hotel should be, or at least this is not a 3 star European standard hotel. And I paid more than 40€ a night which is quite a lot for being in Delhi I wouldn't suggest to go although the receptionist we're all kind, which is maybe the only reason why they deserve 1/5 and not 0.

The bed was dusty. The hotel situated in a worst area beside the public toilet and you can smell it whenever you go out of the hotel. The staffs are waiting to charge you for everything, like keeping your luggage for an hour in the reception. The bathroom seems like you will get viral disease if you used it, it's very unhygienic. It's the worst terrible time of my life booking that hotel. They charged me 3000 rupees for 2 days where i don't feel like it worth even 400 rupees. If you value your life, please don't book this hotel. Thank you

The hotel itself is decent with a helpful team, and for the price it is okay, though the AC did not work well and the bathroom cleanliness could be better. While the inside of the hotel is fine, the biggest drawback is the location and outside atmosphere, which is extremely unhygienic due to an open male toilet right outside, causing unbearable smell and pollution. This makes it very uncomfortable and unsuitable for families, especially for women travelers, despite the advantage of being near transport and other hotels. It is surprising that a three-star property in such an area has not taken the initiative to resolve this serious concern by at least covering the toilet and providing proper facilities.
Worst experience as the staff is rude and arrogant and not allowing online bookings to check in. There are plenty of good hotels near by, please avoid going here if you want to save your money

This hotel offers clean, comfortable rooms with decent amenities and good value for money. The staff is friendly and helpful, and its location near New Delhi Railway Station makes it very convenient. Breakfast is tasty with a fair variety, though service can get slow during busy hours. The main downsides are the noisy, crowded surroundings and occasional maintenance or service delays. Overall, it’s a reliable mid-budget choice worth 4 stars.

Rooms are exceptional for the price. Really clean—among the cleanest I’ve seen in this price range in all of India. Bathrooms are huge, and the shower has excellent water pressure. The staff is also very friendly and ready to assist with anything. The breakfast offers a lot of variety; I just had some fruit, but everything else looked fresh and well-prepared. There’s also a coffee machine that makes great coffee.

We was there for 3 nights and couldn’t complain one bit. The staff was kind and useful they helped with booking private taxi for tour around new and old Delhi and at a reasonable price. The room was nice and comfortable and catered to all are needs. Only thing I could complain about is the price of the beer lol. Highly recommend if you are staying in Delhi for a few nights

Very bad behaviour of the staffs and the manager . The room rent is too high according to other hotels nearby .The food quality is too bad .i could not stay more than a day.There was no hot water available at the bathroom there was always a problem of gyeser . I would never suggest anyone to stay here .

Overall a great stay. The staff were fabulous, very attentive and very friendly. The rooms were also great, very clean and spacious and with lots of good facilities. The only downside to this hotel was the breakfast, but it certainly didn't ruin our stay. It was just a bit chaotic (hence why we have still rated it 4 stars). We went for breakfast at different times throughout our 4 nights staying at the hotel in the morning, and it was the same every morning, apart from the last morning which was fine. Each morning, we arrived in the seating area to no/very little cutlery, no plates, no mugs or glasses for a drink and some of the food running low. The wait for an omelette was quite long that by the time you got it, you had finished your breakfast.

A very good property in the price range. The rooms and bathroom was very clean. And the staff was friendly and helpful. Only drawback is that it's not on the main road and there's a 100m walk through an inside lane. You can surely book this one if you want a good reasonably priced hotel in Paharganj.

If you are looking for a clean hotel in bazaar with good price and you dont expect too much, I can deffenetly recommend this place. the hotel is clean and the location is ok. it is in the small alley not in the main street, but still when they give good offers I prefer to stay here. the alley has many shops and other hotels in it so you wont feel unsafe. generaly I recomend this place to people who dont expect much facilities from hotel but want to stay in a safe and clean place.

The hotel location in a tiny alley , few seconds from main Bazar street . Area is active and busy all day with locals and tourists . Good service and reception people . Room is fine . Hot water on demand , ask the reception 5 min before showering . Quiet room , Lift is available .

My stay at this hotel was very disappointing. The air conditioning was switched off in between, leaving the room hot and uncomfortable. The TV did not work either, which was frustrating. On top of that, the staff showed no proper manners when I raised these issues — their attitude was unhelpful and unprofessional. I expected much better service and basic facilities to function properly. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone.
Highly recommend to stay in paharganj area, clean and comfortable rooms, good bathroom, and excellent staff !!! Very close to main bazaar but silent because it's in the alley ;)

I recently stayed at this hotel and had a mixed experience. The room itself was clean and well-maintained, which I appreciated. However, the overall service was disappointing. The staff showed rude behavior and were not welcoming, which made the stay uncomfortable. Additionally, basic toiletries were not provided in the room. Simple amenities like soap and other essential items were missing, which was inconvenient. Because of the staff attitude and lack of basic facilities, I would not choose to book this hotel again.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly Recommended Stay in Paharganj! I had such a wonderful experience staying at this hotel in Paharganj. It’s one of the best and most affordable places I’ve stayed at — clean rooms, fresh fragrance everywhere (unlike many other hotels around that smelled musty), and truly welcoming vibes. The staff was very helpful and kind throughout my stay, and the owner was humble and genuinely caring. What impressed me most was their service — they even helped me check in at 3 AM without any hassle, which is rare to find these days. Everything from cleanliness to comfort was just perfect. The room was cozy, peaceful, and smelled amazing. I really felt at home here. If you’re visiting Delhi and looking for a budget-friendly yet comfortable and clean hotel in Paharganj, this is the place to stay! You’ll be treated like family here. 💖

Absolutely disgusting hotel. Worst experience of my life. They shamelessly exploit women, especially during periods—charging money or forcing guests to wash bedsheets when they themselves don’t provide clean ones. Food hygiene is terrible; found hair in the food. No cleanliness, no humanity, no respect. Do NOT stay here under any circumstances.
Location is good. But when we reserve rooms it has hot water, but no hot . Rooms not clean , bedsheets and others are used. Doors cannot lock properly. Cannot satisfied 😥
Was not able to sleep roperly as my room was near to the frontdesk of the hotel. The staffs were making very noise at late night. The washroom awas not so clean.

Very good hotel and at very good location just 5 min walk from new Delhi railway station. No sound pollution. Rooms are clean and hot water available. Tripple bed was available for me and my parents for complimentary. Must stay .

Pathetic experience at Sterling Inn. First, its a very shady path to reach the hotel and then the amenities are not provided properly. The room was very dirty and all the toileteries were not of good quality. The bathroom door was not getting closed and was not aligned. Also the staff was very rude and fraudulent in terms of overcharging for food than the menu card and including a service charge and not providing a bill for it. Never recommend this hotel.

I don't know how to express my frustration after spending a day and night here. We have not stayed anywhere in Paharganj before however this is worst hotel I have ever booked. Rooms are old and well maintained, toilets are not spacious and clean. Water outlets are not in good shape. Everytime you have to request at reception to switch on Air conditioner in room because they did not provide any switch for AC in the room and they switched off it even without asking the guest. Its so disgusting, I have not found any hotel which having AC switch for every room at front desk. They provide RO water free of charge however charges 30/- per liter a mineral water bottle. They provide breakfast lunch n dinner on request. They also charge special charges on final bill of any ordered food. Please don't go on the pictures it has posted on Google like I thought it would be a great choice at this price but I had a real bad experience here. I requested them to switch on AC multiple times day and night as they were switching off by their own without my consent. They don't even have gyser in bathrooms.
Clean and comfortable room really nice staff and Good behaviour manager and very good food 🥘
It was a great experience and very well maintained hotel and they are very cooperative and and it was budget friendly.
Room is airy,well decorated, deluxe ac,service, caretaker's behavior is also awesome. Thanks to Hotel LAV KUSH, ARKASHAN ROAD, Paharganj administration.
I had an incredible stay! The hospitality was unmatched. The room service was quick and efficient. Highly recommend it for anyone visiting delhi

If you’re unable to accept bookings through Agoda, you should inform customers in advance. Why allow booking through Agoda if you can't accept it…. My parents had to suffer because of this. I would definitely not recommend this hotel.
Excellent service.. Responsible and kind staff.. And perfect hospitality.. Very budget friendly with all services available

Hotel staff behavior is very bad I will never book this hotel And i will recommend also ither to never book and stay im this hotel Very very bad service in this hotel Theire staff behavior is very very bad

It is not a family hotel, the way to hotel is also a garbage place, it has too much smell. The rooms are too bad in condition, I stayed in room 201 which has ac facility but it only get switched on, the temp was constant at 25 after changing several remotes too. It only have one wall fan with no rotation. The TV in the room also don't have recharge. Rest rooms are more bad than this. The behaviour of staff is also not upto the mark, they delays everything and hotel don't have its own kitchen. Online it has cheap rate but it also provides money to cab and auto drivers. Beware of that fraud too. Finally it's a 2/10 hotel. You can visit nearby other hotels after having a check. Highly suggtion to have a full check before paying.

I booked this hotel online without knowing that it is located near a red-light area. I was traveling with my family, so it was not a suitable or comfortable place for us to stay. When I requested a refund, the staff denied it, which was disappointing. I’m writing this review so that other families don’t face the same situation. Please check the location carefully before booking.

I have stayed at Hotel Kaushal Palace for 3 nights with my family and totally loved our stay, satisfied with the hospitality provided and staff behaviour. Also, the location of the hotel is good which includes a number of restaurants nearby.
Worst experience I have got from this hotel . All promises they have made before check in , results to be lie . Not gonna suggest it to anyone . I will definitely ruin your hotel staying experience.

I have stayed here once, all was fine, so I have booked again a month in advance. Confirmed again one day before arrival. Came 5 am (exactly the time I said I will arrive) just to be told there is no room for me. Zero assitence with finding me a room in some nearby hotel. So as a solo female traveller I had to go off to the streets at 5 am to find accomodation myself. Zero appology from anyone. Do not book here.

This is the worst hotel ever. Neither the washroom is clean, nor is the service good, and the staff is also very bad. The rooms shown on MakeMyTrip, Agoda, and other apps are not even 1% like the actual rooms. Neither the room nor the washroom is clean. The washroom and room smell all the time. The shower is not working, the flush is not working, and even the TV is not working. I would say never book this hotel. They mention breakfast as a buffet, but there is no breakfast at all, and the food is completely tasteless and pathetic. This is the worst stay of my life. Even the bed is not comfortable for sleeping.”
All over experience is good. I recommend everyone to stay here. you have to stay nearby by railway station than must book this only. In this budget it is best hotel surroundings. Thank you 🙏

Staffs are good. Smooth checked in. Location is nice. Room service is very good. The best thing is kitchen is open 24/7. But only thing is bothering that rooms need to be improved. And should maintain cleanliness.

Visible dust was present on the wooden bed frame and other surfaces. There was no wardrobe or hangers for clothes, and no dustbin in either the room or washroom, which was inconvenient. The main door lock was broken, and only the upper sliding latch was working, which did not feel secure. The TV was not functioning properly. Staff turned it on with a master remote, but paid channels showed no subscription and free channels were not working either. One of the power sockets was also not working. The washroom fittings were shaky, and there was continuous water leakage in the toilet area causing constant noise. The environment was quite noisy even around 10 to 11 PM. review_text: Apart from the location, nothing about the stay was satisfactory. The property feels poorly maintained and does not meet basic hotel standards. They were replaced only after we specifically requested it, which should not be the case for any paying guest. Overall upkeep of the room was subpar and gave a very uncomfortable impression. The interiors do not feel welcoming, and the hygiene standards are well below expectations. The stay did not justify the price at all and felt more like a low-grade lodge rather than a hotel. The location is the only positive aspect of this property. Other than that, the experience was disappointing and not worth the money. Significant improvements in cleanliness, maintenance, and basic service standards are required before this property can be recommended.

hotel_name: Fabhotel Marble Arch - Hotel In Karol Bagh, New Delhi
review_text: Fab Hotel Marble Arch isn’t just bad — it’s a full-blown educational experience. If anyone wants to study how to ruin a guest’s day, this place should be the syllabus. Let’s begin with the rooms — absolute works of art. I walked in and genuinely wondered if I’d entered a museum dedicated to dirt. The dust on the floor was so thick I almost left footprints like Neil Armstrong landing on the moon. The bedsheets? Oh, stunning. They’ve clearly been passed down through generations. I’m sure even the hotel staff don’t know what the original color was supposed to be. The bathroom was a whole different adventure — like a science experiment that went rogue. The water stains created beautiful abstract patterns, the smell was a mix of “why” and “how,” and the shower looked like it was moments away from filing a resignation letter. The lights kept flickering like they were trying to blink in Morse code: “Run. Save yourself.” Then comes the food — cooked with the same enthusiasm someone has while filing taxes. Truly tasteless. Even hospital food tastes like a 5-star buffet in comparison. The staff, though… incredible. Their skill to be rude without even trying is next-level. I’ve seen customer service nightmares, but this place has turned it into an art form. Ask a basic question and they’ll stare at you like you interrupted their meditation. And the cherry on this already rotten cake? Fab Hotel support. I accidentally booked for single occupancy and needed it for two. They charged me ₹700 for an “extra occupant.” So I checked the app, and guess what? Booking the same room directly for two people shows a difference of ₹200. Meaning the hotel basically said, “Let’s cheat him because we can.” And support replied with those robotic copy-paste lines that solve nothing — classic Fab style. Overall, Fab Hotel Marble Arch deserves an award for excellence — Excellence in Disappointment. Dirty rooms, zombie food, rude staff, and support so useless it might as well not exist. Zero logic. Zero hospitality. Zero shame. Never again.

I stayed at Mayfair Hotel for three nights and four days while attending the book fair, and honestly—it turned out to be a fabulous decision. The location itself is a massive win. The railway station is literally a two-minute walk away (yes, actual two minutes, not Google Maps optimism). Facility-wise, the hotel is top-notch—from basic amenities to cleanliness and hygiene, everything is impeccably maintained. What truly stood out, though, was the service. I was welcomed warmly at the reception, and since I was travelling with my child, the kitchen staff went out of their way to customise meals according to my daughter’s needs—something that instantly earns extra points from any parent. The housekeeping staff was equally attentive, readily available even after 9 p.m., and happy to assist whenever needed. Late-night hunger? Not a problem. Even after placing a meal order post 10 p.m., the staff was prompt, polite, and genuinely eager to help. To top it all off, the receptionist was kind enough to arrange for someone to walk with me and help carry my suitcase to the station—an unexpectedly thoughtful gesture that made a big difference. I can confidently vouch for this place. If I’m travelling to Delhi again and need accommodation close to the railway station, this hotel will be my first choice—no second thoughts. This is not a paid promotion, just an honest, well-earned recommendation. And yes, I think others should absolutely consider it too.

The most immediate issue was the extremely low ceiling height, which I estimate was not even six feet. This unconventional and restrictive design made the room feel incredibly cramped and claustrophobic. Pervasive Foul Odor: The entire room smelled distinctly like a bathroom, suggesting severe plumbing or ventilation issues. Damp and Unpleasant: The room was also noticeably damp, which contributed further to a musty, unpleasant atmosphere. Damaged Furniture: The furniture was in a state of disrepair, with several items appearing broken or heavily worn. Overall Atmosphere: The combination of low ceilings, dampness, the foul smell, and poor furnishings gave the space a deeply negative ambiance, reminiscent of a cell rather than a comfortable hotel room. The "heritage" feeling was present only in the sense of brilliant neglect. 🧑‍💼 Staff and Service The staff interaction was equally frustrating. The receptionist was notably rude and displayed a general lack of professionalism and courtesy. There was a palpable sense that the hotel management and staff were indifferent to the quality of our stay and the concerns we raised. 🌟 Conclusion I would strongly caution prospective guests against choosing Jukaso Down Town. The poor condition of the accommodation—particularly the uniquely low-ceilinged room, the pervasive foul odor, and the state of the furnishings—coupled with the unhelpful and rude staff, made for a highly negative and uncomfortable stay.

Title: Disappointing Experience at Hotel Manat Inn - Unpleasant Rooms and Overpriced Rating: ⭐ Review: My recent stay at Hotel Manat Inn left me thoroughly disappointed and regretful. This review reflects my honest opinion about the subpar quality of the rooms, exorbitant pricing, lack of basic facilities, and an unsatisfactory location. Firstly, the rooms at Hotel Manat Inn were far from satisfactory. The accommodations were cramped, poorly maintained, and lacked basic cleanliness. The furniture was worn out, and the overall ambiance was gloomy and uninviting. The beds were uncomfortable, and the linens seemed unwashed, making for an unpleasant sleeping experience. It was evident that minimal effort had been made to ensure guest comfort and satisfaction. Adding insult to injury, the prices charged by Hotel Manat Inn were outrageously high for the quality of the rooms and services provided. The rates were completely disproportionate to the substandard facilities offered. It felt like a blatant attempt to exploit unsuspecting guests, taking advantage of the hotel's location without delivering commensurate value. Speaking of facilities, Hotel Manat Inn fell short in that aspect as well. The amenities promised on their website were either nonexistent or poorly maintained. The Wi-Fi was unreliable and slow, making it difficult to stay connected. The room service was sluggish and unresponsive, failing to meet even the most basic requirements. The lack of attention to detail and the apparent disregard for guest satisfaction were truly disappointing. Furthermore, the location of Hotel Manat Inn was far from ideal. It was situated in an unappealing and inconvenient area, lacking any nearby attractions or conveniences. The surrounding neighborhood felt unsafe and uninviting, adding to the overall negative experience. It was not the kind of place one would want to explore or spend leisure time in. In conclusion, my stay at Hotel Manat Inn was marked by disappointment and regret. The inadequate rooms, exorbitant pricing, lack of basic facilities, and unattractive location make it impossible for me to recommend this establishment. I advise potential guests to explore other options that offer better value, comfort, and a more pleasant experience overall.

I stayed at Hotel Golden Grand for 2 days during a family vacation, and unfortunately, it was a very disappointing experience. To begin with, the hotel does not have a proper keycard system. They asked us to leave the keycard at the reception every time we went out, which felt highly insecure and inconvenient. Due to this poor management, our room was not cleaned, and instead, the staff cleaned someone else’s room by mistake. When I raised the issue, all I received was a casual apology — not something you’d expect from a 4-star rated hotel. The food experience was equally bad. On the first day, we had dinner which was supposed to be a buffet, but most of the trays were empty, and the staff asked us to take “whatever was left.” They only refilled items after everything was completely finished, which made it a very unpleasant dining experience. The next morning’s breakfast was no better — again, empty trays, and the food was being prepared only upon request. I saw around 25 guests waiting for food despite it being a buffet setup. That evening, the hotel cancelled the buffet dinner entirely, claiming low occupancy, and asked guests to order from the menu. However, most items were unavailable, and we ended up getting only naan, dal, and a small portion of rice. For dessert, they only offered gulab jamun and ice cream. When I asked for tea, I was told it wasn’t included and I’d have to pay extra, which felt unreasonable for a hotel of this standard. Overall, the service is extremely poor, and the restaurant staff seem disorganized. The hotel appears overstaffed but poorly managed, and the reception staff were rarely available and not very pleasant or approachable. If the management truly wants to improve, I would suggest better restaurant supervision, training the staff on hospitality, and ensuring the reception is always attended by helpful and polite personnel. Definitely not recommended for family stays.

The door lock wasn’t working working properly, the room phone wasn’t working at all, the bathroom was smelly, the towels were bad, the shower stopped working in between and on top of that the room was small. Plus the breakfast wasn’t up to the mark and nothing seemed ok in this place. I would strongly suggest and recommend everyone to avoid this place at all costs. It will save you a lot headaches

Finally, i found one room where I took the risk to spend a night. Totally disappointed. Though hotel location and staff behaviour is good but hotel maintenance is not at all good.
Really good experience at Le mem Hôtel in Delhi. Good location, near railway station and near Chandni Chowk. Providing good foods and good facilities.

Very disgusting unhygienic and extremely dirty rooms. Layers of dust on wall. Rajnigandha spits on wall and near dustbin. Towels and bed-sheet cannot be touched. Excellent stay! Clean and comfortable rooms, friendly staff, and a great location. Everything was well organized, and the service exceeded my expectations. I would happily return and recommend this hotel to others.

I would not recommend this hotel. The reception staff wrongly accused me of a missing blanket during refund processing, and later confirmed it was their mistake. The room was also very small, cleanliness was poor, lights had issues, and the washroom door did not close properly. Overall, a disappointing and unprofessional experience.

Banana Tree hotel services and staff is undoubtedly better than near by hotels..food quality is supreme ..overall a very nice experience for all the guests came in the wedding ..I have booked rooms and hall for marriage function...extremely satisfying experience..

Very good Hotel and Banquet for wedding purpose, first I was seen some negative feedback back but some reason I was booked there Banquet and rooms , they take care very well as I expected, good job madhusudhan jii and your team keep it up!!
Worst service. Stale food bad rooms and poor service. Booked it for a wedding but disappointed

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5) Visited Ginger and overall had a good experience. The ambience is neat, calm, and suitable for both family dinners and casual outings. The food quality was good—flavors were well balanced and dishes were served fresh. Pan-Asian options stood out the most. Service was polite, though a bit slow when the restaurant got busy. Portions are decent, but prices feel slightly on the higher side for the quantity served. Cleanliness and presentation were well maintained, which adds to the overall comfort. A good option in the area if you’re in the mood for Asian cuisine, though service speed and pricing could be improved.

I recently stayed here for four days, and the experience was truly wonderful. The service was excellent throughout my stay. I’d especially like to appreciate the room attendant, Puneet Kumar, who was very helpful and responsive, taking care of all our requirements promptly every time. His support made our stay even more comfortable.

Absolutely comfort and memorable stay not only of mine but my entire team which was staying over a week. Excellent job from the house keeping team, quite a few names I remember - Puneet Kumar, Nannu Pal and others are served me with due respect and perfectly. Food was also excellent ! Must recommend this hotel ! Keep up it Team Ginger East

I recently stayed at Hotel Ginger, Delhi, and had a pleasant experience. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The staff was polite and helpful throughout my stay. The location is convenient and well-connected, making travel easy. Overall, a good stay with value for money. Would recommend for both business and short trips.

I had a wonderful experience at Ginger Hotel, east Delhi The staff was very courteous and helpful, especially Mr. Anil kumar Agnihotri, who went above and beyond to make my stay comfortable. His professionalism and friendly nature truly made a difference. The rooms were clean, well-maintained, and the overall service was excellent. Highly recommend this hotel for a pleasant and hassle-free stay

A restaurant is only as good as its staff and the guys on duty were excellent taking time to chat and make us feel welcome. The food choice was amazing and catered for all tastes. If it wasn’t so far from the UK we’d definitely return. Definitely recommend.

Worst hotel experience ever. The only thing this hotel has going for it is its location near Kaushambi Metro. Apart from that, everything is terrible. The rooms are extremely unhygienic and dirty. The bed sheets looked used and were clearly not cleaned or changed. The bathroom was the worst part—very dirty, badly maintained, and filled with a horrible smell that made it uncomfortable to even step inside. Overall cleanliness is zero, and basic hygiene standards are completely ignored. I would strongly advise everyone to avoid this place unless you want to ruin your stay.

Unhygienic and filthy rooms. Bathrooms are even worse. There is a very strong smell in the entire room. I just left even though I had reserved the place. Thankfully had booked for just a day. Doesnt even deserve a 1 star rating.
Excellent hospitality by all staffs . Excellent location , just behind the he Kusambi metro and well maintained rooms... Will come again. Great experience. Thanks.
Had a great stay! Very comfortable room, and very quiet. Almost no street noise. Staff was very friendly!

It was such a pathetic experience staying at IP Royal. Have never experienced something like this before. The staff is so unprofessional and the pictures they have put is nowhere near how the hotel looks. There were multiple instances in our 18 hours stay. We checked in around 4pm and our room was not ready until then. Post check in we found that our room size is so small even a kid won’t fit in. Washroom didn’t have a tap and geyser was not functional. We had to call room service multiple times to get warm water. There were no amenities at all. Called for a bed cover and they asked for the blanket back - told us you cant use both things. We had to leave at 7 in the morning and wanted warm milk, we confirmed the previous night and was ready to pay extra. When we called the room service in the morning, they did not answer. After 4th try they told they’re getting it. 7:40 we called again and told us sorry we forgot to get your milk - can we bring now. There is no parking space - our car was parked on the moving road. I swear if it weren’t the circumstances we had - would’ve left the hotel no matter what amount we had paid. Don’t waste your money in this place.

This was one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve had. The bathroom and toilet were filthy, the bed and clothes felt dirty, and the entire room smelled heavily of cigarette smoke from previous guests. It was clear that the room had not been properly cleaned. The lack of hygiene made it impossible to relax or feel comfortable. I strongly do not recommend this hotel.

Absolutely disappointing stay – would give zero stars if possible. The lift is pathetic, filthy, sticky floors and walls that haven’t been cleaned in weeks. The housekeeping is practically non-existent: no room cleaning service at all during my 2-night stay, rooms were very untidy on arrival and only got worse. Dustbins in the room were overflowing and never emptied – disgusting. On top of that, the place is extremely noisy because the staff shout and slam doors even late at night (2-3 AM); impossible to sleep. Overall cleanliness is shocking – dust everywhere, stained linen, dirty bathroom. There seems to be no proper management; no one cares or responds to complaints. Save your money and avoid this hotel completely. One of the worst places I’ve ever stayed in.
The staff were courteous , attentive and always ready to help.. check in and check out were hassle Free , house keeping did a great job everyday..the room was spotless nd well maintained impressive

No parking space available, car parked at main road. No welcome at entry, no assistance in carrying the luggage. We traveled with family and the receptionist said only same gender people are allowed in one room - which shows the low standard of this hotel. This is how they judge their guests. Room was not ready even after calling and confirming 2 hours before arrival. Room was very very small and smelled very bad. The pictures are deceiving - do not believe them. Very poor room service. The quality of bed is so poor that you would feel the springs when you sleep. They kitchen staff won't respond to your requests, the staff doesn't wear any uniform, they talked very loudly in the lobby. There was a cat roaming around in the lobby - which definitely didn't look like a pet. Washroom taps are broken. Very bad experience.

hotel_name: The Leela Ambience Convention Hotel Delhi
review_text: I recently stayed at The Leela Palace and had a really great experience. What stood out the most was the level of service from the staff. Everyone was extremely warm, attentive, and genuinely helpful throughout the stay. A special mention to Bhaskar Sharma, who was serving during cocktail hours. He was incredibly polite, attentive, and made sure everyone was well taken care of. You can tell he really cares about the guest experience, and it wouldn’t be surprising to see him move into a management role in the future. If you're deciding between properties in Gurgaon, I would definitely recommend considering the suites here over Leela Ambience Gurgaon if you're looking for a more price efficient option while still getting equal or even better service. Overall, a wonderful stay and I would happily recommend it to anyone visiting the city.

hotel_name: The Leela Ambience Convention Hotel Delhi
review_text: This is a Great hotel for East Delhi Folks I was part of a function hosted and the foods was good. The starters specially were excellent. Main course definitely needs a lot of improvement but variety was there. Rooms are good well Maintained and quiet spacious. Staff are good

hotel_name: The Leela Ambience Convention Hotel Delhi
review_text: The hotel itself is great and feels very premium. However, the reception staff is not very friendly and lacks a sense of hospitality. We had to call 4–5 times for very small requests. We had also clearly discussed over the phone that we needed two adjacent rooms, but upon arrival we were given rooms at completely different corners of the hotel. The staff eventually agreed to change the room the next day (possibly because part of our payment was still pending), but even for that we had to make multiple calls and visit the reception several times just to get the exchange done. Overall, the experience with the front desk was not professional and needs improvement.

hotel_name: The Leela Ambience Convention Hotel Delhi
review_text: This hotel is a gem!! Staff were very professional, yet warm and approachable. Rooms are spacious and clean. The older rooms do show a bit of wear & tear but as we were out most days it was no big thing. Pros: Great staff (Antoush, the manager is a credit to this hotel) We were always greeted so warmly by him & his team that we felt like 'part of the family'. It's not very often you can say this about big hotels. Prisha & Yashwant at breakfast always started our day with a huge smile and lovely service (cannot thank them enough). Service in the Royal Club was also exceptional (my apologies I cannot remember the short chap who was very knowledgeable about wines and had great conversations with my husband and again provided bespoke service-thank you. We had such a memorable stay and cannot wait to return.

hotel_name: The Leela Ambience Convention Hotel Delhi
review_text: Chef Himanshoo! He made our trip so special! We were traveling with a baby and every single day he made something special for her that made her so happy! His creations were all so beautiful, from Mickey-shaped pancakes to artsy dosas and croissant sandwiches! Staff were all very friendly and accommodating. They changed the whole fridge in the room simply because the other one was warm! They provided a nice crib with very cute blanket for the baby, even delivered complimentary chef-special pastries!! Thank you, chef Himanshoo, restaurant staff, reception staff, and the concierge staff! You are all very much appreciated. I recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Delhi!

review_text: Absolutely the worst hotel experience ever. The room was filthy and stinking — insects crawling around, piles of paan spit inside, dirty and unwashed bedsheets/pillow covers, and no lock provided for safety. The entire place was unhygienic and unsafe. To make it worse, there was no board or signage for the hotel, making it nearly impossible to locate. This property is disgusting, a complete scam, and should be avoided at all costs.

hotel_name: Townhouse Dilshad Garden Near Dilshad Garden Metro Station
review_text: The rooms are absolutely filthy. The linens, including the pillows, were black and dirty. There were hairs everywhere and stains on the bedsheets and mattress. The bathroom and sink hadn’t been cleaned at all. The towel holder was broken, switches were damaged, and even the furniture was falling apart. The AC sounded like a generator. The entire place is pathetic and unhygienic. It might be okay for low-class couples looking to spend 2–3 hours for ₹300–₹400, but even then, it's a disgrace. On top of that, they charged me extra for being a solo traveler at midnight. The amount on the OYO app was ₹699, but they forced me to pay ₹1,298. I had no option but to pay in cash since it was 12:30 at night and I didn’t want to go searching for another hotel. They are cheaters, looters, and absolutely unprofessional people who have no idea what hospitality means.

hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Radisson, Sahibabad, Distt Ghaziabad (U.P.)
review_text: 5 stars - Out of this world veg buffet! Just had an amazing dinner buffet at Country Inn Sahibabad again, and it was pure bliss! The all-vegetarian spread is incredible, featuring a huge variety of continental, North Indian, South Indian, and Italian dishes. Lavish selection with tons of desserts, ice cream, and unlimited drinks – everything tastes divine.Ambience is top-notch and consistent with my last visit two years ago. Prices have doubled since then, but it's absolutely worth every penny for the quality and quantity. Highly recommend this gem of a hotel restaurant! 😊

hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Radisson, Sahibabad, Distt Ghaziabad (U.P.)
review_text: Was here for a cousins wedding and the entire wedding party stayed here. We had a pretty good time here and the food was great on every service. We did struggle with the water turning off every now and then in the bathroom post regular use and the faucet not being fully functional. Apart from that, we were well taken care of. It’s also conveniently located next to the Vaishali station which is great for connectivity

hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Radisson, Sahibabad, Distt Ghaziabad (U.P.)
review_text: I absolutely loved the vegetarian buffet here! 🥦 The spread was quite elaborate, offering a fantastic variety of dishes. But the real highlight for me was the rose-flavored ice cream 🌹🍦 – it was truly a showstopper! Definitely a must-try. 👍

hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Radisson, Sahibabad, Distt Ghaziabad (U.P.)
review_text: We did not have a good experience in this hotel. We stayed here for 4 nights and we did not get to sleep properly even for a single night since people will be shouting in the corridor at 3 am in the morning and there was not much help or monitoring from the hotel staff to keep the noise levels down. I understand that it is the wedding season but there are other folks in the hotel as well who would like to sleep! Moreover, the refrigerator in our room was not working and we complained about it to the hotel staff like 6 times!! They would say that they would look into it but there was no remedy till the end of our stay! One important note: this is a completely vegetarian hotel and honestly we did not know about it. Their breakfast buffet is completely vegetarian and they should properly mention this in their ads but they did not! It is not a deal breaker but the stay was expensive and maybe non veg people wont appreciate it. The rooms were standard, clean and ok. Personally I wont recommend this hotel for the price and the laggy service. The Radisson Blu which is like a klick away is more worth the money!

hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Radisson, Sahibabad, Distt Ghaziabad (U.P.)
review_text: Disappointing experience – Poor management and misleading pricing I recently stayed at this hotel and was quite disappointed. The property was severely overcrowded due to ongoing parties, making it incredibly loud and chaotic. To make matters worse, the staff was uncooperative when these issues were raised. There was also a lack of transparency regarding charges. I was asked for a ₹3,000 security deposit, and despite being promised a 20% discount on in-room dining, I was charged the full amount. I would not recommend this hotel for those seeking a peaceful or professional stay.

hotel_name: Fortune Park, East Delhi - Member Itc Hotels' Group
review_text: Wehad a wonderful experience at Hotel Fortune East Delhi. The housekeeping was excellent, and the rooms were cleaned daily, making our stay very comfortable. The room service was prompt and well-organized. A special mention to Chef Harikesh who prepared his signature dishes, Laal Maas and Chole, especially for us. The taste was outstanding and truly memorable. The buffet dinner was delicious and offered a wide variety of dishes Overall, it was a pleasant and satisfying stay. I highly recommend this hotel for its great service, cleanliness, and amazing food. Looking forward to visiting again! Excellent hospitality. Appreciate the service of Mr.Sandeep and Mr. Pankajabd Sakshi

hotel_name: Fortune Park, East Delhi - Member Itc Hotels' Group
review_text: I went to ITC Fortune in Vivek Vihar. The food there is excellent for dinner; it's even better than the food I've had at The Leela, many times tastier. And the best part is that there was a chef who was going to every table, and he came to my table too and served me food according to my preferences. You rarely see this kind of service. He served me exactly what I wanted, and I felt compelled to give my feedback. If I ever go out to eat again, it will be at ITC Fortune Delhi, Vivek Vihar. I met a chef there who is truly remarkable, and the best thing is that he even let me try one of his specialty dishes, his signature dish. I thank ITC Fortune, where there is such a humble chef, Mr. Sharma. Thank you so much, Mr. Sharma.

hotel_name: Fortune Park, East Delhi - Member Itc Hotels' Group
review_text: I had a very pleasant stay and was impressed with the overall quality of the hotel. • The rooms are well maintained and almost fully furnished, offering a comfortable stay. • The hotel provides a wide range of facilities. The gym, in particular, is well equipped with all essential fitness equipment. • The food served was consistently fresh and tasty. • The staff members are courteous, polite, and highly supportive. I would like to extend a special mention to Mr. Abdesh for his attentiveness and helpful attitude throughout my stay. His service truly enhanced the overall experience.

hotel_name: Fortune Park, East Delhi - Member Itc Hotels' Group
review_text: Staying here was a lovely experience. The staff is very friendly, and the food is delicious. The rooms were great - my only issue is that the gap in the shower door allows a ton of water to gather and fall onto the shower floor. There's not a ton of towels that can be spared as bath mats so they get pretty soaked, which is not pleasant to stand on. Location-wise, I wish there was more around in terms of restaurants or bars as most require a drive to get to. There is no ATM in the hotel which is not great for foreign tourists. Maybe both of these things are something that will improve with time!

hotel_name: Fortune Park, East Delhi - Member Itc Hotels' Group
review_text: Had a wonderful experience at ITC Hotels. The hospitality was excellent, staff were very polite and helpful, and the rooms were clean and comfortable. The food quality was also amazing, especially the buffet. Overall a great stay and I would definitely recommend it. Service by Tanmay & Sandeep

I recently attended an event at L’Elegant Hotel & Banquet, and while the entrance looks quite lavish and impressive, the experience inside was a bit different. The hall at the backside is quite small and congested, especially if your guest list crosses 150–200 people. It tends to feel packed very quickly, which can be uncomfortable during peak event hours. The food was just okay, nothing extraordinary. Overall, it’s suitable for small gatherings, but if you're planning a bigger event or expecting a seamless flow of guests, you may want to reconsider the hall size beforehand.

My stay at Roomshala 156 Hotel Mannat Inn was fantastic! The location was convenient, the room was clean and comfortable, and the staff was friendly and accommodating. Overall, a great experience – highly recommend!

I arranged marriage of my daughter at this hotel and banquet. Management did a great job in organising the events for 2 days. Kitchen staff did a great job in food department. We did not get any complains. Food was fresh and tasty. Room service was good and prompt. Banquet hall management of the events was exceptionally good. I endorse and recommend this place for big / small events and stay.

So we booked 21 rooms for the Haldi event for 3 days for our guests. We had told them a different menu for every day and what all decoration that would take place in their hall. Every expectation ours were met. Dunno about the other reviews but majority of our guests were pleased. The food was nice and freshly prepared and if there was something off menu they made it too. The rooms were clean and spacious. Since it is a winter season, cooling wasn't needed but yes hot water was available. The venue arrangements were also nicely taken care of and were beautiful. We frankly had no problems there whatsoever. If we did get any hiccups the staff corrected it. Very happy with our decision. So in the sea of many negative reviews here's a positive one. Also before booking, think about everything what you want and communicate it to the manager. That will be much better.

I had a very pleasant stay at this hotel. The staff was courteous and helpful throughout. Rooms were clean, well-maintained, and had all the basic amenities. The location is convenient with easy access to nearby markets and transport. Highly recommended for business or short stays. Excellent service and beautiful ambiance! The hotel exceeded my expectations in terms of cleanliness, hospitality, and comfort. The breakfast spread was delightful and the front desk team was always responsive. Definitely coming back!

hotel_name: Qotel Comfort Ip Residency East Delhi Preet Vihar
review_text: I booked this hotel based on its rating, but my stay was terrible. The floors were not clean at all, and the door locks were in very poor condition—honestly, unacceptable. The only positive thing I can mention is that the hotel has plenty of parking space. Apart from that, there is not a single thing I can say was good about this hotel.

hotel_name: Qotel Comfort Ip Residency East Delhi Preet Vihar
review_text: 4k+ for 2 nights is not worth wasting here. The rooms are in terrible conditions. The floors are not clean, the walls have dampness and mold with rust. The ACs do not work. There is dust sitting on the bed and the cupboard, like it hasn't been cleaned for ages. The staff comes after calling 10 times for help. There are no toiletries provided. We asked for a second towel and the person denied the same. We asked for toothbrush and toothpaste which other 3 star fabhotels provide but they denied. The bed has disgusting stains and they don't even try to hide it. The bathrooms are so disgusting you can only get dirtier if you are taking a bath there. We switched the rooms which we were provided, twice, but it kept getting worse. The only good thing about this hotel - it has a door that you can use to get out from this filthy place. Public restrooms are much more maintained and clean than the rooms here.

hotel_name: Qotel Comfort Ip Residency East Delhi Preet Vihar
review_text: I had one of the worst hotel experiences here. We checked in around midnight, and the process was extremely frustrating — the staff had no common sense, and their policies were completely illogical, making everything unnecessarily difficult. review_text: Our host in Delhi booked us here solely based on the fake ratings. We assumed that it is of the Fab group the rooms will be good.
